titles.titleEn: Destined Love of the Hidden Billionaire
titles.description: تدور أحداث مسلسل ملاحقتك عبر السنين حول رحلة طويلة وشاقة من البحث والملاحقة التي تتجاوز حدود الزمن والمسافات. تبدأ القصة بموقف مفصلي يغير مجرى حياة الأبطال، حيث يجد البطل

titles.title: She Dumped Me Too Early
titles.description: Before graduation, the narrator's girlfriend ends their relationship without warning. As a parting gesture, she leaves him a villa, a Bentley, and ten million, along with her thanks for the four years they spent together. What she does not realize is that he is the foremost heir of the Imperial's richest family and has no need for any of it.

titles.title: I Fix Cursed Books, I Keep Their Powers
titles.titleEn: I Fix Cursed Books, I Keep Their Powers
titles.description: A talented restorer of ancient texts takes on the task of protecting a strange library, drawn by the promise of a substantial income. The volumes in their care have been corrupted by malevolent shadows, and mending them allows the restorer to absorb potent abilities belonging to monsters. Alongside central figures who step out of the books, this restorer confronts shadow creatures born from the resentment of secondary characters, gradually overturning the fate that had been laid out for them. Those interested in following the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Conqueror's Return
titles.description: After three years of marriage into the Shen family, Ye Tiance reclaims his true identity. At a classmate's grand opening, Master Hu's marriage proposal and a socialite banquet, he stands firmly behind his wife, Shen Zhuxin, slapping those who mock her, helping the Shen family resolve its difficulties and finally revealing who he really is. That revelation turns Shen Zhuxin into the focus of everyone's attention, and the bond between the couple grows stronger than before. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Dumped in Public, Back as an Heiress
titles.titleEn: Dumped in Public, Back as an Heiress
titles.description: After Ethan Yale lands Mr. Sullivan's huge investment, he casts Mia Moore aside and takes up with Wendy Lynn. Zane Sullivan finds Mia, who then discloses her true identity: she is Sophie Sullivan, the Divine Moon Hall Master, and she has pledged herself to vengeance. The situation turns urgent when Lily Chang poisons Zane, forcing Mia to hurry after the Nine-Turn Golden Pill before time runs out.

titles.title: Burning Love
titles.description: Sold by her gambling father as a child despite Jiang Yingqiu's frantic attempts to stop him, Lu Nanyan grew up far from her origins. Jiang's fury over the loss drove her to stab her husband, and she then reinvented herself, rising from housewife to a formidable businesswoman who built her own enterprise from nothing. Using that wealth and influence, she searched without pause for her missing daughter. Lu Nanyan, meanwhile, was sold repeatedly before finding refuge with a cleaner named Zhang Mei. Her childhood memories gone, she kept a half jade pendant, which became the key to Jiang Yingqiu's reunion with her biological daughter.

titles.title: Burn It All, Mom
titles.description: After six years away, Sloane Breen—the real force behind the Breen Group—comes back to visit her son Ethan and his wife Nina. Ethan's mistress Veronica misidentifies her, setting off a chain of events that pulls the family's hidden tensions into the open.

titles.title: Take Me Home
titles.description: Helen Walker lives in a small town, and on the day her son Adam turns six, a brief errand separates her from him: she steps away to buy a birthday cake. The source text breaks off at this point, so what follows remains unclear. The story appears to hinge on that ordinary moment and its consequences for a mother and her young child. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Married to My Savior
titles.description: Cast out from home on the day she turned twenty, Isabella encounters Diego, a wealthy heir weighed down by loneliness, during a downpour. What begins as an impulsive marriage soon becomes a partnership: together they work to dismantle conspiracies woven by the elite, discover the truth about where they each came from, and ultimately establish a family legacy that reaches across the world stage.

titles.title: My Favorite Model Is An Undercover Billionaire
titles.titleEn: My Favorite Model Is An Undercover Billionaire
titles.description: Nancy Sinclair is an ambitious designer whose sketches at Starluxe pull her into the glamorous yet perilous realm of high fashion. There she encounters Evan James, a charismatic model who secretly happens to be Italy's youngest billionaire. Their mutual attraction and professional drive become entangled in ways neither can manage. As their separate worlds meet, long-standing wealth rivalries, a love that is off-limits, and hidden scandals put everything they have achieved at risk of falling apart.

titles.title: The Ask-out Hitman
titles.description: Mu-ryuk is driven by a desire to avenge his boss, and after witnessing Gogong’s bold confession attack, he finds himself inspired, wishing he could approach his own boss with the same daring. He seeks Gogong’s guidance and begins training to execute the ideal confession attack. Yet the plan does not unfold smoothly. Gogong’s repeated rejections have instead earned him a reputation as a seasoned expert in the field. In the end, the confession attempts succeed in persuading his boss to go out with him.

titles.title: Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire
titles.titleEn: Pregnant and Spoiled by the Billionaire
titles.description: Amelia, a diligent college junior, is struggling to make ends meet. With rent due, she has no choice but to look for a job, and her roommate gets involved in helping her find one. The story follows her efforts to secure work and the unexpected turns that come with it. For those interested in following how Amelia's situation develops, the series can be watched on Dramzio.

titles.title: Famine? Here Comes the Fishing Tyrant!
titles.titleEn: Famine? Here Comes the Fishing Tyrant!
titles.description: Starving and abused, a man from another world awakens a Fishing System. From impossible waters he draws out weapons, allies and justice alike. Bandits, corrupt lords and even a rebel king are pulled down from their thrones one after another. The boy who once had nothing and went hungry rises to become a marquis. Yet once a man has fed an entire empire, the question lingers whether he can ever stop casting for more.

titles.title: The Mad Heiress Came Back to Tear Them Apart
titles.titleEn: The Mad Heiress Came Back to Tear Them Apart
titles.description: After enduring three years of torment inside a psychiatric ward, Grace, the genuine heiress, comes back to her family home equipped with a brilliant intellect and a second, violent persona. When Chloe, the impostor heiress, sets her sights on Luna, the cat that has been Grace's anchor to sanity, Grace reaches her breaking point. From that moment, the Winston family's deceptions, wrongdoings, and business empire all face imminent destruction.

titles.title: The Don's Obsession
titles.description: Elias, a student, finds himself in debt to loan sharks. Don Lucius seizes the opportunity and binds him to a contract that makes Elias his plaything. As Lucius eliminates his rivals and works to crush Elias's spirit, Elias refuses to give in. After...

titles.title: The Witch Empress
titles.description: Lena Payne enters the imperial palace with five spirit creatures, driven by one goal: avenging her sister. She lives by a single principle—never doubt herself, only strike without mercy. The arrogant noble consort is brought down, and the hypocritical empress is crushed under her assault. Everything shifts when Mario Shane, the tyrannical emperor, falls in love with her and turns into her most devoted defender. The two of them forge a bond that cannot be broken. Those interested in following the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Forgive Me, Forget Me Not
titles.description: Lottie gives up the man she loves to keep him alive. Years afterward, their paths cross again, and he has become a powerful lawyer with vast wealth at his command. He also carries a bitter grudge against her, convinced she once stabbed him.

titles.title: My Bad Girl Act Ruined My Tragic Fate
titles.titleEn: My Bad Girl Act Ruined My Tragic Fate
titles.description: After transmigrating into a story, Wen Ruan finds herself cast as the male lead's and the villain's short-lived first love—a figure who dies young yet is never forgotten. Her situation comes with a fatal order attached, leaving her to navigate a doomed role she never chose. Dramzio is where the series can be followed.

titles.title: Sorry Pays Well
titles.description: He was humiliated by the woman he loved and the wealthy rival she picked over him. Then a system powered by regret began converting every insult into money. In a single night, he burned through millions, brought gold-diggers to their knees, won back what had been taken, and left everyone who had dismissed him stunned. The same people now plead for his forgiveness, yet he refuses to glance back.

titles.title: The Mafia’s Dangerous Secretary
titles.description: A mistress consultant is compelled to seduce a mafia Godfather and uncover his secrets, yet the mission she has been given turns out to be a lie. Rather than betray him, she puts everything on the line. As his enemies are brought down and trust is gradually rebuilt between them, he gives up his throne for the woman who was originally meant to deceive him. The story asks whether a love that began in deception can become the truest devotion of all. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The true heiress returning is the grand priestess of fat
titles.titleEn: The true heiress returning is the grand priestess of fat
titles.description: Elena, the High Priestess of the Hidden Order, finished her last trial only to discover that pieces of her soul had gone missing. Recovering them meant going to the Sterling and Forrester families, where her birth parents lived. A marriage alliance between the two households was already in the works, giving her the opening she needed to return. What she found instead was a web of plotting on both sides, along with enemies who wanted the Hidden Order's power and the Forrester fortune for themselves. As she struggled against these schemes, she also hunted for the lost fragments of her soul. In the end, she exposed the truth, safeguarded who she was and the person she loved, and brought her fate to its close through self-redemption.

titles.title: My Wife's Sugar Baby Destroyed Her Future
titles.titleEn: My Wife's Sugar Baby Destroyed Her Future
titles.description: Elliott Grey has spent years quietly shaping his wife Tessa's career from behind the scenes, while she remains convinced that her success is entirely her own doing. The balance shifts when he presents her with a Hollywood contract and she refuses it. Her rejection sets off a chain of events that puts everything he secretly built for her at risk. The story follows the fallout as the hidden foundation of her career begins to surface and the couple must confront the truth behind her rise. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Fate's Sweet Embrace(Dubbed)
titles.description: Luna Blake, a college student, suddenly wakes up inside a novel as its doomed villainess. In the original story, that character loathes her mute CEO husband and ultimately meets a tragic fate. Refusing to accept this ending, Luna resolves to value her marriage, her work, and her family, choosing a life driven by love and purpose. Her steady determination begins to reach her silent husband, and the two gradually draw nearer to each other. Together they push back against the destiny laid out for them, forging a future filled with affection and achievement. The series, including its dubbed episodes, can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Year I Disappeared
titles.description: After three years in a marriage without love, Cecilia walks away once Nathaniel signs the divorce papers without a moment's pause, his heart still fixed on Stella, his first love. Her own mother betrays her, while her mother-in-law pushes her to disappear, and so she does, leaving no trace behind. Those left behind brace for the worst, unaware that Cecilia has started over in secret, holding something Nathaniel never learned. He now searches for her with growing desperation, yet the woman he overlooked is no longer there, and what she kept hidden might bring everything crashing down.

titles.title: Raised My Bully’s Baby, Reclaimed Everything
titles.titleEn: Raised My Bully’s Baby, Reclaimed Everything
titles.description: After being bullied in high school by Chloe, Emma—then overweight—was left with Chloe's baby and paid to vanish. She raised Noah as her own child and built a new life by the sea. Six years on, a chance encounter brings Chloe back into her life, now with a rich fiancé named Adrian. The couple begins prying into Noah's background, aiming to take him from Emma. But the facts emerge: Adrian is not Noah's father. In the end, Emma and her exceptionally gifted son leave the country, finally unburdened and looking ahead to a hopeful future.

titles.title: Winds of Change
titles.description: After the death of his mother, Christopher Bennett finds himself locked in bitter conflict with his father, David. Their relationship frays as long-buried secrets come to light, pulling the family into turmoil and forcing both men to confront what has been hidden between them.

titles.title: Sacrifice? I'm a Walking Armory!
titles.description: A young man from the modern era is transported to another world, where he finds himself cast as a human sacrifice. Just as things look bleakest, a weapon system awakens within him, granting him access to contemporary firearms such as Gatling guns and mortars. His path later crosses that of a female general, from whom he gains insight into the oppressive rule gripping this world. The question becomes whether he can rescue himself from his predicament, and whether he might also be able to free the people living under that tyranny. Those interested in following the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Apocalypse Mart: S-Rank Horrors on the Payroll
titles.titleEn: My Apocalypse Mart: S-Rank Horrors on the Payroll
titles.description: Cast aside by his own family, the protagonist makes his way through the apocalypse by running a supermarket whose staff consists of S-rank horrors. He deals in Dreadcoin, using it to improve the shop and unlock increasingly powerful goods, while his monstrous employees remain bound to follow his rules. Through cunning, he sees through deadly plots and ultimately brings down the Cosmic Evil God by relying on unbreakable contracts, emerging as the most improbable savior imaginable. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: This Time, I Choose Me
titles.description: In her previous life, Olivia spent five agonizing years as Ethan's wife. He took control of her wealth, destroyed her professional path, and repeatedly made clear that her survival depended on him. Given another chance, she resolves to put herself first.

titles.title: Beauty Meets Destiny
titles.description: York Yonder came down from the mountain carrying marriage contracts arranged by his masters. One of them had picked out an ordinary, unassuming wife for him, while the rest selected women of the highest caliber. On his journey he rescued Queenie Morgan from an ambush, and later treated her father Todd, who hoped to match him with Queenie. Along the way, York also crossed paths with Lily Sorkin and Francis Lorne. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: I Was Only His Substitute—Then His Brother Made Me Luna
titles.titleEn: I Was Only His Substitute—Then His Brother Made Me Luna
titles.description: Omega slave Elara discovers that Alpha Ronan, the man she loved, only ever saw her as a stand-in. She is then forced into marriage with Damon, the former heir, and what begins as duty slowly turns into genuine love between them. When Ronan abducts her, Damon calls upon the Black Guard, overpowers his brother, and brings the truth to light: Ronan had been using poison. With that exposed, Damon takes his place as Alpha, and Elara stands beside him as Luna.

titles.title: My Disciples Are All Overpowered II
titles.titleEn: My Disciples Are All Overpowered II
titles.description: Thirty thousand years after a demon invasion, the creatures hold sway over seventy percent of the planet. With conflict brewing, humanity has pledged to take back what was lost. The story of My Disciples Are All Overpowered II unfolds against this backdrop of looming war and resistance. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Don's Baby Made Me Win Everything
titles.titleEn: The Don's Baby Made Me Win Everything
titles.description: After discovering her boyfriend's infidelity, Emma is left with only nine dollars. Her fortunes shift when she saves a kidnapped heir to a mafia family and realizes she can hear his thoughts. This ability helps her earn the confidence of the boy's father, a powerful don. Emma's position evolves from nanny to contract wife, and she outmaneuvers her adversaries on a path toward both love and independence.

titles.title: Addicted to Sinful Love
titles.description: What began as a deep love between Cheng Yiyi and Ji Jing'an ended in separation when a misunderstanding drove them apart. Facing bone cancer, she chose to leave him and claimed she was only after money, hiding her real reason for going. A year on, she takes a job at his company, only to discover that his resentment has not faded. Meanwhile her illness is getting worse, and she wants to mend things with him before time runs out.

titles.title: Twenty-Twenty
titles.description: At twenty, Dahee finds none of the fresh start that adulthood is supposed to bring. She remains stuck in her mother's shadow, and rebellious thoughts keep rising from somewhere deep inside her: the wish to live as herself rather than simply as her mother's daughter. She is only one step away from leaving the fence behind, and now, having just come of age, Dahee begins to summon the courage to take that step. The series Twenty-Twenty can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Robbing the Emperor Before My Exile
titles.titleEn: Robbing the Emperor Before My Exile
titles.description: Claire comes back to life on the very morning she is to wed Shure, a war god sent into exile. With her rebirth come two gifts: the power to heal by divine means and a space that can hold without limit. Rather than let a tyrant strip them of everything, she clears out his treasury first. What follows turns banishment into a journey fit for royalty, as she and Shure travel with supplies, magic, and a score to settle. She mends his wounds, secures the loyalty of the north, and eventually returns to bring down the throne. Dramzio is where this series can be followed.

titles.title: They Mocked Mom. Now They Beg!
titles.titleEn: They Mocked Mom. Now They Beg!
titles.description: Eleanor, a retired medical expert of considerable reputation, endures relentless cruelty at the hands of her son's household. They overlook her birthday entirely, choosing instead to throw a celebration for their dog. What they fail to realize is that this mistreated elderly woman serves as godmother to three powerful tycoons. When their clumsy attempt at an apology goes disastrously wrong, it results in the father-in-law's death, while the son is diagnosed with lung cancer. The question remains whether Eleanor can bring herself to forgive the family that caused her so much pain. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Substitute Bride: Rhys Sterling's First Beloved Wife
titles.titleEn: Substitute Bride: Rhys Sterling's First Beloved Wife
titles.description: To cover her mother's medical expenses, Willow Ashton accepts an unusual arrangement proposed by Seraphina Vance: she will stand in for the other woman and become involved with Rhys Sterling. What Willow does not anticipate is that Rhys sees through the substitution and knows exactly who she is. The story follows this tangled situation, built on a secret identity and an unexpected recognition. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Shadows of Valeria
titles.description: Rowan, pozornie tylko pozbawiony spadku młody panicz, w rzeczywistości potajemnie rządzi przestępczym światkiem Valerii. Zaraz po pogrzebie jego matki, ojciec Victor sprowadza do domu przebiegłą Elenę wraz z jej synem Leo. Udając łagodną i bezradną, Elena przejmuje rezydencję, którą zmarła matka zapisała Rowanowi. Zamiast od razu ich zabić, Rowan postanawia wciągnąć swoich wrogów prosto do piekła. Losy serialu można śledzić na Dramzio.

titles.title: Love Misplaced, Hearts Reunited
titles.description: Five years after a car accident that badly injured Ralf and caused Jenna to disappear, the two former lovers remain separated by more than distance. Ralf had been led to believe that Jenna was the spy responsible for sabotaging his family’s business. Now Jenna comes back to his city, and she does not return alone: she brings the son she and Ralf share. Her reappearance forces the old accusations and the truth about the past back into the open.

titles.title: The Ashen Covenant
titles.description: Ka nako ya dilemo tse makgolo a mane, Ditoropo tse Supileng tse Halalelang di ne di itshetlehile ka Tumellano bakeng sa pholiso, matla le tshireletso, ba sa tsebe hore ba ntse ba fana ka tokoloho ya bona ho Kereke. Ha Elara a ntse a batla mme wa hae ya lahlehileng, o ikopanya le mohlabani Rowan mme ba sibolla nnete e tshosang: mme wa hae, Marlene, ke senotlolo sa tsamaiso yohle ya Tumellano, ha Rowan e le "setshedi se tsitsitseng" se reretsweng ho tsosa drakone wa kgale Valgrenn. Ha Dikgabo tse tharo tsa Drakone di kopana mme drakone e tsoha, Elara o tlameha ho kgaola Motswedi wa Tumellano ha Rowan a ntse a lwantsha ho senya Dikgabo ka hare ho yena. Qetellong, batho ba lahlehelwa ke mehlolo le tshireletso ya bomodimo—empa ba fumana tokoloho ya nnete ka lekgetlo la pele. Letoto lena le ka l

titles.title: My Zombie Son Is A Wasteland Boss
titles.titleEn: My Zombie Son Is A Wasteland Boss
titles.description: In the third year of the Wasteland Era, Arthur and his son Kyle, who is a mutant, set about turning a wrecked service station into a waste. The series My Zombie Son Is A Wasteland Boss can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Zero from Him, One Hundred from Him
titles.titleEn: Zero from Him, One Hundred from Him
titles.description: Wendy possesses the ability to perceive how much affection others hold for her. After illness caused her to gain weight, her fiancé Henry grew contemptuous and enrolled her at a gym as though she were merely a weight-loss case. There she crossed paths with Luke, a young man she had once encouraged during his childhood. With his assistance she regained her health, and he offered her love without conditions. Wendy ended the engagement and, buoyed by Luke's encouragement, restored her sense of self-worth. Henry came to regret his actions, yet by then nothing could be undone. Wendy and Luke were married. Dramzio is a place where viewers can follow this series.

titles.title: The Snake's Story
titles.description: Margaret built a powerful empire, but scandal brought it down. When her close friend Nancy faced ruin, Margaret chose to take the blame herself. What she never suspected was that her own husband, Stanley, had orchestrated her imprisonment. Once she was released, Nancy added to her pain rather than showing gratitude. At her lowest point, a giant serpent appeared—the same creature Margaret had rescued years earlier—and came to stand beside her.

titles.title: CEO, Your Wife Runs the Game
titles.titleEn: CEO, Your Wife Runs the Game
titles.description: Kang Renran agrees to marry Lu Shian as a way to rescue her first love and her brother. For an entire year, Lu Shian pays her no attention, so she decides to pursue a divorce. Just then, his former love Shu Ran reappears and begins plotting against Kang Renran. Rather than being defeated, Kang Renran uses every scheme against her as a chance to advance, eventually establishing a successful luxury resale enterprise. In the end, Lu Shian develops genuine feelings for her.

titles.title: Divorced, Then Desired by My Stepbrother
titles.titleEn: Divorced, Then Desired by My Stepbrother
titles.description: A single impulsive night with an unknown man becomes far more complicated when the woman discovers he is her stepbrother. Grant is determined to win his independence and settle a score, yet the pull between them only intensifies despite the taboo standing in their way. The story follows that tension as forbidden attraction deepens alongside Grant's own struggle. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Bullied Girl
titles.description: For sixteen years, Eleanor Vance stood by Leo Carter, shielding him—until he repaid her loyalty by making her the target of schoolwide mockery, all to win Savannah's approval. She leaves for California, and there, at a different school, she finds genuine friendships and a kind-hearted captain who help her grow into a version of herself the old Eleanor could never have imagined. By the time Leo locates her and offers his apology, it no longer matters; she has moved on and built a life that has no place for him. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Arranged to Wed, Chosen to Love(Dubbed)
titles.titleEn: Arranged to Wed, Chosen to Love(Dubbed)
titles.description: Emily’s father selects a husband for her: a reserved workaholic. She enters the marriage and discovers he suits her well, so she devotes herself to being Mrs. Collins, approaching her role as a partner rather than a romantic. Everything stays carefully in balance until one night, when her husband starts to desire more than the arrangement they agreed upon. The story is adapted from Nizhou’s Tomato novel "Unfamiliar Marriage in the Capital." Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Her Smile Above All Riches
titles.description: Billionaire Adrian steps back into the role of CEO, while the vain Simon turns his back on Momma. For Adrian, the riches Simon chases carry far less value than seeing his mother smile. To him, real success lies in making sure Momma never has to cry.

titles.title: Escape Before Birth...They’re Taking My Baby
titles.titleEn: Escape Before Birth...They’re Taking My Baby
titles.description: Pregnant Serena Su rescues The Snake, only to discover that her husband and the Zhou family have been putting on an act of love all along—their real aim is her unborn child. She tries to flee, but they catch her and drag her back as the scheme tightens around her. Just as the Zhous move to seize the baby, The Snake reappears. Whether Serena can break free before her child is taken remains uncertain.

titles.title: The Retired Beast God
titles.description: In an age ruled by beast-taming, Lin Hai—a celebrated war hero—quietly steps away from the battlefield. His reason is personal: his wounded beast companion needs time to recover. To keep his true identity hidden, he adopts the guise of an idle, unmotivated slacker. Yet his remarkable talent remains difficult to conceal. The series follows this retired fighter as he balances a deliberately low-profile existence with the abilities and instincts he cannot fully suppress. Dramzio is among the places where viewers can follow the series.

titles.title: Beastbound: The Girl Who Tamed Their Wild
titles.titleEn: Beastbound: The Girl Who Tamed Their Wild
titles.description: After fleeing a brutal existence on Earth, Tessa wakes in a galaxy where beastmen face the danger of transforming into monsters forever. She is thought to have no abilities, yet her mere touch is able to soothe the savage darkness consuming them. A lion general, a wolf doctor, an injured black mamba, a severe marshal, and an enigmatic white kitten all find themselves pulled toward her. Amid these bonds, Tessa has to discover her own power and decide the course of her life.

titles.title: Our Forbidden Love at 20 and 41

Gossip spreads, relatives push back, and each of them wrestles with private uncertainty. The question hanging over the pair is whether their bond can withstand the mounting disapproval or whether the strain will tear them apart. Those interested in following this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Inner Thoughts & Outer Schemes

She learns that Sarah can eavesdrop on people's inner thoughts, so Natalie binds herself to a Thought Modification System to launch her counterattack. Combining the system's abilities with her own intelligence, she steadily reveals Sarah's true nature. By the end, Natalie earns a graduate admission offer, receives an invitation to the Victor family's banquet, and finds love as well.

Even after Fiona left, Sarah kept finding ways to degrade her, at one point sending her to the hospital. Throughout it all, Joel remained at Fiona's side, shielding her, until he persuaded her to put her own wellbeing ahead of her son's. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

Old friendship collided with present-day hatred and love, and an unrestrained argument broke out at once.

As they endure blizzards and the daily struggles of frontier life, the emotional distance between them gradually gives way to genuine affection. Their bond is tested when a letter goes missing and threatens to undo everything they have built, prompting Clark to take a desperate risk to bring Mattie back.

The old Arden blood running through her veins holds the sole means of undoing the curse laid upon him. What begins as mutual distrust gradually shifts into a perilous connection between the two.

Once Lucy is freed, Victor embraces her with theatrical warmth, yet she notices another woman's perfume on him. Whispering to her dead mother, she asks why he told the rescuers to leave Mommy behind, and Victor freezes in terror.

A surprising partnership with a wealthy billionaire brought to light startling revelations about her missing son, along with a secret nobody could have anticipated.

titles.description:
In Aslan, a realm ruled by magic, Princess Rosalind—the eldest daughter—possessed power no one could detect, so the kingdom dismissed her as a worthless failure. Though bound by oath to shield her, the three turned on her at her coronation, raising Lily—the sister Rosalind cherished, who had grown up in refugee camps—to the throne in her place.

The question lingers: can someone who has already lost everything still take up arms for the very world that stripped it all away?

She is caught inside a covert program that manufactures, substitutes, and wipes out synthetic spouses, and through it she pieces together what really happened to her marriage—along with the identity of the woman she was designed to stand in for. To break free of Project Eternity, Clara has to bring its architects into the light and show that neither love nor human nature can be reduced to code.

titles.description: Reborn as an abandoned heiress, Sera possesses the ability to hear the voices of objects. After she narrowly escapes an assassination attempt, she rescues Lord Edmund, the patriarch of a vampire family. Her act of saving him brings her six vampire brothers at Ravenmoor Ma...

No longer bullied, she became the royal family's cherished little princess. Gifted with the ability to hear animals and speak with ancient trees, she uses mice, birds and hidden magic to expose killers and rescue the innocent. Yet the question remains whether her secret can withstand the traps of palace life.

titles.title: Seal Unbound, Back to Power
titles.description: Maleficent uses her gaze to imprison 200,000 orcs, saving Arlant before falling into a deep sleep. When she awakens two decades later, she learns the king violated his promise and slaughtered the elves. Diana and Selena subject her to brutal torture, tearing away her scales and pouring molten gold over her. After Diana destroys the seal, the orcs are set loose. Maleficent transforms into a dragon and observes their defeat. Together with Ilian, she sets out to find whoever truly abducted the elves.

titles.title: My New Man OWNS You, Fake Fam!
titles.titleEn: My New Man OWNS You, Fake Fam!
titles.description: A wealthy heiress seems to have it all, until the two people closest to her—her fiancé and her stepsister—deceive her and shatter the life she knew. Left with nothing, she unexpectedly becomes the wife of an icy, influential CEO who enters her world like a force of nature. With his backing, she takes down those who wronged her and climbs the corporate ladder, transforming into a self-reliant woman along the way. What began as a marriage of convenience slowly deepens into genuine feeling. Yet the question lingers: can a love rooted in vengeance endure?

titles.title: The Mafia's Caged Swan

When her father throws himself in front of the stepmother's bullet, he loses his life, and Josiah is wrongly blamed for the killing. Unable to clear his name, he holds Elsa close and shields her for three years without ever revealing the truth behind what happened.

She responds by immediately marrying Marco Romano, a wealthy and influential billionaire. Unaware of how much her situation has changed, her former fiancé and his calculating assistant assault her and set her up. Marco wastes no time striking back, exposing the corruption tied to their official positions and driving them toward total ruin both publicly and legally. With her harassers collapsing, Brigid learns that Marco's loyalty is rooted in a history they both share.

What begins as a practical arrangement gradually turns genuine. The real question is whether a bond forged in such chaos can withstand the truths hidden beneath it.

On the very day his company is set to go public, he is transported back to the year 2000. Armed with the knowledge of his previous life, he resolves to alter his destiny, mend his broken family, and find success once more.

titles.title: My CEO Girlfriend Feels What I Feel
titles.titleEn: My CEO Girlfriend Feels What I Feel

When the weather turns cold, Leonard is unaffected while riding his motorcycle, but Liliana shivers inside her heated luxury car. The arrangement appears to work until Liliana traps Leonard in her office, seizes his tie, and insists he look at her directly, asking whether he has sensed anything unusual about his body recently.

Following a year of gentle care, Ella recovers and comes back with Valen, who rewrites the old laws and offers her vow rings again, pledging themselves to each other forever. Those who wish to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: A Spring Yet to Come
titles.description: The daughter of the Shangshu Mansion set her sights on becoming queen. After her engagement, she devoted three years to supporting the third prince, only for him to force her to step aside in favor of his sister. Refusing to accept this, she resolutely shifted her allegiance to the eldest prince. She helped him overcome a long-standing illness, and through her efforts he rose to the position of crown prince.

titles.title: Before Your Love Reached Me
titles.description: Mason Innes is convinced that Thea Kane caused the death of the woman he truly loved. Driven by a desire for vengeance, he carefully works his way into Thea's life, and his scheme ends with her taking her own life. Only after she is gone does Mason learn the shattering truth: the person actually responsible was someone else entirely. Consumed by remorse, he comes to understand that the past cannot be reversed. However violently his grief and guilt spill out, the damage is beyond repair and it is far too late for anything to be put right.

titles.title: From Shame to Honor
titles.description: Wu Fu, though raised in poverty, earned a place at a prestigious university through her intelligence. Her parents knelt to beg for the tuition money, and the humiliation of it drove her father to his death. Ten years on, she has risen to become CEO of Huaxia Group. She gives 500 million to her home village for road construction, yet instead of gratitude she faces slander from the villagers, who do not realize that she is the benefactor they have been looking for.

titles.title: I Turned Omega at the Wolf King's Duel
titles.titleEn: I Turned Omega at the Wolf King's Duel
titles.description: In the Blackstone Wolf Clan, a throne duel ends in defeat for Alpha Kane, who is transformed into an Omega and discovers a fated mate bond. Exiled from the clan, he combines his Alpha fighting skills with an Omega's heightened perception to endure the schemes of the Elder Council. Political conflict tests his bond with Drake, yet their love endures. After Kane's true identity comes to light, Drake gives up his crown to rescue him, turning his back on a hierarchy built on gender. Using Kane's strategies, the two overcome corrupt Elders and outside invaders.

titles.title: Fatal Sisters
titles.description: Sylvia discovers that her twin sister Yvonne has been shattered by abuse and betrayal. Determined to help, Sylvia steps into Yvonne's life by assuming her identity. She confronts the mistress, outmaneuvers the unfaithful husband, and takes back control of the company. Working side by side, the sisters collect proof that ultimately lands Nathan behind bars. Their shared goal is simple: rescue one another and begin again, together.

titles.title: Scarred Lady Returns, Three Kings desire my love（updating）
titles.titleEn: Scarred Lady Returns, Three Kings desire my love（updating）
titles.description: Betrayed by Warwick, her knight husband, and manipulated by Elena, a scheming maid, Lady Catherine endures contempt from her children and cruelty from her mother-in-law. Scarred and driven to a fiery suicide, she is reborn through her family's enchanted ruby necklace. Once awakened, Catherine exposes Elena's vicious lies and the estate's deep-rooted corruption, heals the disfiguring scar on her face, and bravely rescues Sebastian, the Duke's son, from drowning. As repayment for her heroism, she asks the Duke to annul her loveless marriage, leaving Warwick crippled by remorse that comes too late, while three powerful men are drawn to the reborn, unyielding Catherine.

titles.title: The Bride Who Came Back
titles.description: Betrayed by her fiancé and her stepsister, Ava runs away and lives through a terrible accident that leaves her disfigured. Five years on, she comes back under a new identity, Evelyn, a successful and influential designer, and she is raising a son whose existence she keeps hidden. Her former fiancé, now a billionaire, wants her in his life again. As hidden truths come to light, she faces a choice between taking revenge and giving him a second chance. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: (Dubbed) Mocked at Home, Rich at Sea
titles.titleEn: (Dubbed) Mocked at Home, Rich at Sea
titles.description: His unusual ear condition made him a target of ridicule, yet this young fisherman carried a hidden ability: hearing beneath the water far beyond ordinary human range. After his own family turned against him, he left to make his way alone. That gift became the foundation of his fortune, and as his success grew, so did the prosperity of his village. Along the way, he came to understand his own identity and purpose.

titles.title: The Fierce Lion Awakens
titles.description: Born illegitimate into nobility yet gifted with extraordinary strength, he spent years bearing humiliation in silence. Betrayal finally caught up with him: framed, left crippled, and slain in the arena. But death was not the end. Reawakened with the power of two bloodlines, he takes up the holy sword and storms a wedding to settle the score. His vengeance does not stop there, as he tears down a bloodline order that has stood for a thousand years, rising from outcast to crowned king. Audiences can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Shared by Three Alphas
titles.description: Audrey, an eighteen-year-old high school student, finds herself selected as the shared mate of the three Alpha brothers of the Lancaster wolf clan: Fenrir, Skoll, and Hati. Her role is tied to bearing an heir, and she spends passionate nights with the brothers as part of this arrangement. Dramzio is a place where viewers can follow the series.

titles.title: Spokesman of Heaven
titles.description: After a rescue leaves Evan Chase in a coma for 100 days, he wakes to find he possesses divine healing abilities. At Oakwood Hospital he brings an elder back to life, then goes on to help several influential families. While staying with Mia Voss, he launches a herbal clinic and earns renown for his remarkable cures. The two share a string of adventures that gradually dissolve their initial tension, giving rise to a gentle romance. Dramzio is a place where viewers can follow this series.

titles.title: Sacred Bone Fragments: The Wolf King's Hunt
titles.titleEn: Sacred Bone Fragments: The Wolf King's Hunt
titles.description: Episode 1/30 — Sacred Bone Fragments: The Wolf King's Hunt. In a midnight interrogation room, undercover agent Marcus is subdued by wolf-king Gabriel and framed

titles.title: I Kissed His Father
titles.description: Claire is moments away from her livestreamed wedding when she discovers her fiancé in bed with her stepsister, the two of them scheming to take her hotel from her. Rather than walk away quietly, she turns the cameras on them and, in full view of the audience, kisses Gabriel, her fiancé's billionaire father. That single defiant act sets off a chain of consequences none of them can control. For viewers who want to see how the story unfolds, the series can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The True Heiress Saves the CEO
titles.titleEn: The True Heiress Saves the CEO
titles.description: A decade after Arielle, heir to the Moore family, was taken by human traffickers and vanished, she comes back home. In the years away she has built a formidable set of abilities, mastering medicine and martial arts, accumulating great wealth abroad, and earning the backing of an influential CEO whose life she saved by chance. Her return has a purpose: she intends to discover what really happened surrounding the unexplained death of Maureen, her biological mother. Those following this story can watch it unfold on Dramzio.

titles.title: OMG! The Real Heiress Is Faking Crazy!
titles.titleEn: OMG! The Real Heiress Is Faking Crazy!
titles.description: Anna has left the asylum behind, only to find a different kind of madness waiting for her at home. Everyone adores the enemy she faces, and any attempt to reveal the truth only makes her look like the liar. So she keeps her knowledge to herself and plays the obedient daughter, smiling while her adopted sister takes over her life piece by piece. Those around her believe they have finally subdued her, but they are mistaken. The real Anna is only now starting to make her moves. The story is adapted from Shi Tu Jiu Jiu's short story "Jia Qian Jin Shi Xi Jing, Dan Wo Shi Shen Jing A," published on Fanqie Novel. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Forbidden Stepdad: Claimed by the Demon Prince
titles.titleEn: Forbidden Stepdad: Claimed by the Demon Prince
titles.description: Fallen angel Ezreal goes to Hell posing as the male consort of Demon King Moloch, driven by a desire to avenge his family. There, Prince Xavier purchases him to serve as a piece in his own uprising, yet the arrangement neither anticipated turns into a forbidden love bound by blood. As the two scheme to seize the throne, Ezreal keeps searching for what really happened to his family. The question that emerges is where his vengeance leads once it points not at Hell but back toward Heaven.

titles.title: Mind-Reading Boss: Game On!
titles.description: A workplace newcomer finds herself up against a boss with the ability to read minds, turning her first days on the job into a tense contest between calculation and honesty. Shen Yiyi must work out how to keep her private thoughts concealed while navigating this unusual dynamic, and the story builds toward the question of who will come out ahead in the psychological struggle between them.

titles.title: I Can See My Husband's Loyalty
titles.titleEn: I Can See My Husband's Loyalty
titles.description: Claire possesses an unusual ability: she can perceive the degree of loyalty that others hold toward her. This gift becomes painfully clear when her father betrays her mother, and Claire witnesses his loyalty score drop sharply to twenty-three percent. A similar moment follows involving her sister, revealing how those closest to her truly feel. The story centers on Claire's burden of seeing devotion measured so plainly, and the emotional consequences that come with such knowledge. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Five Years of Cold Violence — My Ex-Husband Knelt in Remorse After My Death
titles.titleEn: Five Years of Cold Violence — My Ex-Husband Knelt in Remorse After My Death
titles.description: Vivian, once a wealthy heiress whose family had fallen, married Victor as a way to rescue her family from ruin. Their union brought her five years of cold neglect and emotional cruelty at his hands. The source text breaks off at this point, so the later events implied by the title cannot be confirmed from the available material. The drama can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Better Marriage
titles.description: Claire Linwood discovers that her marriage rested on deception, and that her closest friend had taken her position as Mrs. Sutton. She chooses to leave it all behind and instead weds Mark Sterling, a man of considerable influence. Their union starts as a practical arrangement, yet it gradually deepens into genuine affection as the two face and surmount every obstacle in their path. Meanwhile, her former husband is left to grapple with regret. Those interested in following the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Boss, Your Girl Packs a Punch
titles.titleEn: Boss, Your Girl Packs a Punch
titles.description: Nina rescues Tristan from serious injuries, yet by morning he has no memory of the incident. Believing their paths will not cross again, she is startled when he turns up as her employer. Their everyday interactions are marked by friction and misreadings, and beneath the surface a risky, intimate bond gradually takes shape.

titles.title: The Dragon King’s Rejected Prince
titles.description: Three years back, Lynn rescued Caesar, a black dragon whose Dragon Soul was in chaos. As the sole elf capable of soothing him, Lynn was bound to Caesar through a Dragon Bond. Yet the return of Isabella, Caesar’s first love, made Lynn see he had never been genuinely chosen. With a broken heart, he departs for the frozen lands to seek a future of his own. Caesar only then understands how irreplaceable the elf he had overlooked has become. The question remains whether the proud Black Dragon Prince can reclaim the love he let slip away.

titles.title: Forced Into an Abortion, Her Revenge Begins
titles.titleEn: Forced Into an Abortion, Her Revenge Begins
titles.description: After marrying Klaus, Grace stepped away from the business world entirely, leaving the company in his hands and avoiding public events so completely that the press had no photographs of her. When a shareholders’ meeting brought her back, she greeted Klaus warmly, but his secretary, Mia, mistook her for a mistress pursuing her boss. The situation worsened once Mia learned Grace was pregnant, and she went as far as attempting to force Grace into an abortion. Falsely accused of abuse, Grace must now decide how to take revenge on the secretary who wronged her.

titles.title: The Millionaire Wife Strikes Back
titles.description: For a decade, Anuradha devoted herself to looking after a mother-in-law she believed was paralyzed. The truth turns out to be far crueler: the woman is not Rajiv's mother at all, but the mother of his mistress, who has been passing herself off as his sister. Rather than break down, Anuradha quietly assembles proof of the deception. She liquidates the villa that came to her as dowry, brings the fraudulent scheme to light, ends her marriage to Rajiv, and starts over, building both a new career and a new life.

titles.title: Our Love Never Grew Old(Dubbed)
titles.description: Born with a rare condition that makes her age in reverse, Xu Zhiwei has spent her life being treated as an oddity by those around her. Her one source of warmth was Jiang Jinghe, her childhood sweetheart, but the two were repeatedly separated by forces beyond their control. The story follows their bond as it endures across these partings. For viewers who want to follow how their relationship unfolds, the series is available on Dramzio.

titles.title: Last Blade of the Desert
titles.description: Last Blade of the Desert is a series whose story, characters and episodes are waiting to be discovered. Viewers can follow the unfolding narrative at their own pace and form their own impressions.

titles.title: Embraced by My Cunning Playmate
titles.description: On her wedding day, Daniella Harper finds herself framed for arson by her stepsister Joyce. The accusation comes as her husband, Alexander, stands at her side, though the source material cuts off before revealing how he responds or what follows. The story centers on Daniella's entanglement in a betrayal orchestrated by someone close to her family, unfolding against the backdrop of what should have been a joyful celebration.

titles.title: Engaged to My One-Night Stand
titles.description: A one-night stand abroad connects Shen Yugui and Fei Nancheng after she comes to his rescue. Once back home, he moves to call off the marriage that had been arranged for him.

titles.title: Empire in His Grip
titles.description: To the city, Daniel is a nobody—someone whose failures invite sneers and whose downfall draws laughter. What they fail to realize is that he is anything but ordinary: he is the long-lost heir to a billion-dollar empire. Each insult and every trap laid for him only hones his instincts further. Those who believe he is prey are mistaken; in truth, he is the predator, biding his time until the perfect strike.

titles.title: The Godfather's Wife Is a Top Assassin
titles.titleEn: The Godfather's Wife Is a Top Assassin
titles.description: Elaine leads a quiet life as a kindergarten teacher, but behind that role she works as Phoenix, a highly skilled assassin. Her current assignment is to eliminate the mysterious Black Duke, a target she cannot seem to pin down. What she does not realize is that the Black Duke is actually Julian, her own husband. The situation unravels when Julian's lieutenant, whose fixation on him borders on obsession, uncovers their connection and subjects a pregnant Elaine to torture. Only when a broken necklace comes to light does the truth of their identities emerge, leaving them to confront whether their love can withstand the deception of their double lives. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Immortal's Modern Love Chase
titles.description: A hundred years ago, foreseeing that spiritual veins would run dry, Noah King sealed a betrothal agreement with the heirs of the Scott ancestor Layla. In the present day he returns with vast resources at his command, only to learn that Grace, the woman pledged to him, is about to wed someone else. Winning her heart is not merely a matter of romance: her Magic Vein depends on it, and he must earn her love in order to save it.

titles.title: The Imposters' Downfall
titles.description: Lucy, an intern, is involved with Mike, an older man who happens to be the uncle of Grace, the CEO of Smith Group. Mike asserts that he is Grace's father and therefore holds the authority to name the successor. Lucy takes this claim at face value and begins wielding influence she does not have, dismissing senior executives, sabotaging important business deals, and even attempting to remove Grace from her position. The scheme collapses once the facts surface, and both Lucy and Mike face consequences for their actions.

titles.title: Flower Adornment, Hidden Blade
titles.description: A nobleman’s illegitimate son, long treated with contempt, takes on the guise of a fragile performer and vows never again to draw a blade, a promise made to shield his maltreated mother. That resolve is tested when a demonic fiend lays waste to the martial world. Abandoning his disguise, he draws his ancient sword and stuns onlookers with his strength. The question that remains is whether he can avenge his mother and bring down the ruthless family that humiliated him.

titles.title: The General's Return: A Daughter Replaced
titles.titleEn: The General's Return: A Daughter Replaced
titles.description: General Jenkins comes home after a decade at war and is met outside the city by the crown prince and court officials. When he sees his four adopted sons gathered around a girl, he assumes she is his biological daughter, Julie. In truth, the sons have sent Julie to a brothel. The general rescues her and, enraged, punishes the impostors, but the crown prince protects them and goes so far as to stage a coup. General Jenkins and the emperor join forces to put down the rebellion and secure justice for his daughter. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: One Man, Too Many Women
titles.description: A solar storm hurls Ye Tian, an ordinary man, into a parallel reality where men are so rare that he instantly becomes the most coveted bachelor around. Three women pursue him: CEO Lin Yue, diva Su Qingyu, and the alluring older woman Song Wanting. Ye Tian settles on Lin Yue, only for the other two to show up and disrupt the wedding. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Sun God’s Beloved
titles.description:
Kallydia serves as head priestess at the Temple of Philotia, but her mother pressures her into using her position to lure the Sun God Helios for financial gain. After enchanted incense brings them together for a night, Kallydia slips away before sunrise, leaving behind a silver armband inscribed with her name.

Helios develops feelings for her, yet a misunderstanding convinces him she is merely an opportunist who manipulates men. His fury leads him to sever all ties with her.

Kallydia then learns she is carrying his child. Isolated, she endures public shame and cruelty from her family while protecting the fragile golden spark of life within her. When the God of War and the Goddess of Wisdom appear, they expose the truth—the gentle servant they recall is the very woman Helios denounced.

titles.title: The Devil Who Sponsored Me
titles.description: Lucia's father needs surgery, so she accepts an au pair position in Los Angeles. Richard, her charming sponsor, seems like the answer to her financial troubles. Once she is under his roof, however, the arrangement turns sinister: he confines her by locking the doors, seizes her passport, and uses her younger sister as leverage against her. What began as a way to pay for medical care becomes a trap she must find a way out of.

titles.title: Reunion at Midlife, Like First Sight
titles.titleEn: Reunion at Midlife, Like First Sight
titles.description: At fifty, Irene has spent three decades raising Jack, her adopted son. Yet the bond she devoted her life to is now being tested by pressure from those driven by greed. The story follows Irene as she confronts the strain placed on her relationship with Jack and the forces threatening to pull them apart. Dramzio is where viewers can follow this series.

titles.title: Anniversary from Hell: Wife vs. Mistress!
titles.titleEn: Anniversary from Hell: Wife vs. Mistress!
titles.description: Helen Hart moves the venue for her third wedding anniversary to the villa where her husband William Chase once proposed. She has no idea that another celebration, a birthday party, is being planned for the same place. Over the course of one night, two women and a truth nobody is prepared to face come together.

titles.title: The Drunk Who Ruled the West
titles.titleEn: The Drunk Who Ruled the West
titles.description: The legendary gunslinger Luke Graves, known as “Peacemaker”, has lived under an alias for ten years. On his deathbed, his old friend Ethan entrusts him with protecting Cl...

titles.title: Wake Me Up, My First Love
titles.titleEn: Wake Me Up, My First Love
titles.description: Cathy, who leads the Scorpion Gang with a fierce hand, is left comatose by a car crash that was staged. On regaining consciousness, she finds that her family's elders have tricked her into taking Prince Alexander of Monaco into her home, supposedly as a sperm donor so that she can secure an heir. The two get off to a hostile start, yet attraction gradually builds between them. What neither knows is that Alexander is the childhood sweetheart Cathy lost touch with long ago, and that each has been looking for the other all this time.

titles.title: Using Him, Loving Him
titles.description: A year back, Fu Mingyue developed feelings for Fang Yuchuan, a senior student, but discovered he was already engaged. In retaliation, his fiancée Chu Yue destroyed Fu's life. Determined to get even, Fu sets out to seduce Li Huai'an, the most influential heir in the city. Their relationship starts as a calculated arrangement for both sides, yet genuine affection gradually emerges amidst the payback. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: No Mercy for the Protagonist
titles.description: Waking up inside a female-oriented story, he finds himself cast as the pitiful, groveling villain whose fate is an early death. When a mere Foundation-stage cultivator has the nerve to slander someone at the Tribulation Crossing stage, he answers with his Great Wilderness Heaven-binding Finger. His warning is blunt: neglect your cultivation now, and you will end up in his Soul Banner later. Should the Chosen One try to interfere, he threatens to send that entire clan to the afterlife together. And when a foe too strong to beat appears? In this line of work, raw fighting skill is not everything, so he steps back and lets someone else handle the lesson. As a villain, he embraces having no morals and no scheming.

titles.title: End Of Days, Only She Stayed
titles.titleEn: End Of Days, Only She Stayed
titles.description: She rescued him at great personal cost, sacrificing her own appearance, and then raised his exceptionally gifted son far from home. A decade passes before he becomes fascinated by the boy's abilities, yet he inflicts suffering on the woman without realizing who she truly is. Once the deception collapses, their son comes into his power, mends her wounds, and brings back her former looks. Side by side, they bring down a despot. The lingering question is whether a love dormant for ten years can govern a transformed world. Dramzio is a place where this series can be followed.

titles.title: Broke? I'm the Strongest Beast Tamer!
titles.titleEn: Broke? I'm the Strongest Beast Tamer!
titles.description: The era of dangerous monsters is believed to be finished, leaving only cute, fluffy creatures behind. That assumption is challenged by Chad Loney, an eighteen-year-old tamer who awakens a violent beast bloodline thought to be long extinct. With this power, he battles through nightmare zones with the force of an entire legion on his own. Once a poor young man with nothing to his name, he becomes a figure no one can hold back.

titles.title: My Brother is a Top Cultivator
titles.titleEn: My Brother is a Top Cultivator
titles.description: A man who has been drifting without direction, feeling detached from the world around him, finds himself pulled into an unusual inner experience while playing a calming video game. What begins as a quiet pastime turns into a dreamlike journey through his own mind, one that ultimately brings him to a deeper understanding of what gives life meaning. The story follows this unsettled figure as the surreal passage within his thoughts reshapes how he sees his own existence. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: A Son's Journey to Forgive
titles.description: After losing her husband and receiving a cancer diagnosis, Zhou Hongxia makes the painful choice to send her son Lin Feng away, hoping a wealthy family will take him in and give him a better life. Two decades pass before their paths cross again, when she is employed as a maid and comes face to face with the son she let go. Lin Feng carries years of bitterness toward his mother, yet the two eventually confront their shared history and find a way to mend their relationship. Those interested in following this story of separation and reconciliation can watch it on Dramzio.

titles.title: What? My Janitor Dad Is An SSS Hero!
titles.titleEn: What? My Janitor Dad Is An SSS Hero!
titles.description: After spending twelve years frozen while protecting a city, Atlas—an SSS-rank awakener—comes back to discover that his wife has died and that his son Noah resents him for having been away. Concealing his identity as a janitor, he steps in to protect Noah from bullies, and his true power becomes clear when robots submit to him. The former villain reappears, this time commanding a more powerful Frost Titan. Father and son join forces in battle, and Atlas ultimately destroys the creature before returning home in time for his birthday.

titles.title: My Fiery Empress
titles.description: Tessa Whitmore is murdered by her husband’s mistress, yet death does not hold her. She returns with powers drawn from Hell, and those around her have no idea what she truly is. With those abilities she settles the score against those who wronged her and even shields the Whitmore family from disaster. Her plans proceed smoothly until the Human Emperor turns his attention toward her, raising the question of what will unfold when the two finally come face to face.

titles.title: A Mother's Love Never Fades
titles.description: Five years earlier, Jian Mingyue was abducted while pregnant, sold to a distant village and poisoned in a way that left her unable to speak. She learned that someone had orchestrated the kidnapping, and her captors used the threat of the truth staying buried to keep her compliant. For her daughter Jian Xinxin's sake, she endured years of mistreatment. Eventually she fled with the child during a violent rainstorm, but Wu Quan rescued them and lied that Xinxin had died. In fact, Fu Ciyuan had taken the girl in, and a jade pendant found on her made him wonder about a connection to Jian Mingyue. Pressed into a village marriage, Jian Mingyue escaped the ceremony and stopped Fu Ciyuan's car, recognizing him as her daughter's father. Their fates then became entangled.

titles.title: Reborn, I Crushed Them All
titles.description: Betrayed by a boyfriend who cheated on her and a friend whose affection was never genuine, Luna Carter lost her life to their scheme, framed and then murdered. She is reborn with one purpose: revenge. The cruel trap they set for her becomes the weapon she turns back on them, exposing the falsehoods they built their betrayal on and making certain they answer for every wrong they inflicted on her. The story follows her calculated payback against the two people who destroyed her in her previous life. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Reborn: Trading Canned Goods for Airplanes
titles.titleEn: Reborn: Trading Canned Goods for Airplanes
titles.description: Gideon Hayes rose from poverty to rule Bay City as its top crime figure, yet that position came at the price of everyone he loved. He believed his struggles were finished—until Declan Shaw, a man who had once stood by him through extreme hardship, turned against him in a surprise attack. Declan was not alone in that ambush; Gideon’s longtime enemy Silas Thorne joined forces with him. The betrayal leaves Gideon facing the wreckage of both his family and his closest alliance. Those wanting to follow the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Wish Makes Him Suffer Twice
titles.titleEn: My Wish Makes Him Suffer Twice
titles.description: Lawrence finds himself transmigrated into the body of a villain destined for a bad end, bound to a wishing system whose every rebound strikes his adversary, Gavin, with double force. Through cunning reverse wishes, he steadily dismantles Gavin's protagonist fortune, brings his plots into the open, and erodes his hold on power. As this unfolds, Lawrence develops feelings for Selena, gathers devoted allies around him, and at last overturns the fate laid out for him, while Gavin is made to answer for all he has done.

titles.title: The Heir Who Came from Nothing
titles.titleEn: The Heir Who Came from Nothing
titles.description: Delivery driver Su Ming discovers his girlfriend Zhao Fangfang with Qian Shuo, a wealthy heir, leaving him humiliated. He then learns that his own grandfather is the billionaire Jin Quan. Concealing his true identity, Su Ming sets out to take revenge during a banquet, while also drawing the affection of both Wang Lin and Luo Tingting. The story reaches a turning point as he picks up the wedding ring and walks toward an uncertain future.

titles.title: Cheap Food, High Price
titles.description: Wei Ying, a CEO, has been quietly preparing meals for her company's employees without revealing who she is. Her secret comes to light in a painful way when she walks in on her husband Zou Rui with his mistress Ai Li. Ai Li then spreads false claims about Wei Ying's cooking and seizes control of the business, replacing the food with inexpensive pre-made meals. The workers eventually suffer food poisoning, and in the aftermath, they learn that the woman who had been cooking for them all along was in fact their company's CEO. Those interested in following the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Reclaiming My Stellar Glory (English dubbed version)
titles.titleEn: Reclaiming My Stellar Glory (English dubbed version)
titles.description: The English-dubbed series Reclaiming My Stellar Glory follows a comeback story in which a figure who once enjoyed great fame sets out to recover that lost prominence. Across its run, the narrative traces this effort to win back past glory, focusing on the struggle and the events surrounding that return. Further details about the plot and characters are not provided in the available information. Viewers interested in the series can follow it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Captive du duc
titles.description: Darius brings forward evidence suggesting the Cross family has committed treason, a revelation that drives a wedge between Seraphina and Killian. Amid the fallout, Killian confesses that he has been reincarnated. The story follows the consequences of these disclosures as the two are pulled apart. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Fallen Prince? I Married the Warrior Queen
titles.titleEn: Fallen Prince? I Married the Warrior Queen
titles.description: Reborn as the Ninth Prince, disgraced and facing execution, he finds himself accused of treason and the slaughter of 100,000 soldiers. A letter written in blood becomes his means of turning the situation around, though it also forces him into a marriage with the empire's most powerful female war god. Concealing his real strength, he navigates the emperor's suspicions, wins over his formidable wife, defeats all who betray him, and ultimately ascends as the supreme martial master. Those interested in following this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Billionaire Ex Wants Me Back
titles.titleEn: My Billionaire Ex Wants Me Back

titles.description: Branded cursed from the moment she was born, the Empress's daughter was banished to the Cold Palace, until an unexpected fire wiped away that fate entirely. Five years on, a mysterious girl named Belle surfaces, using strange abilities to transform each meeting into destiny. She rescues a great many members of the royal family, yet the question lingers of who might rescue them from her. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Tides of the Heart
titles.description: Three years back, Emily endured a devastating family loss. Enzo, who leads the Lombardi family, pulled her from peril, yet her injuries were grave and her memory wiped clean. In that fog, she came to believe Nathaniel of the Hayes Group had been her rescuer. Time passed, and as she and Nathaniel neared an engagement, a business partnership reunited her with Enzo, stirring a strange, persistent familiarity. Piece by piece, Emily discovered that Nathaniel and Ivy, her adopted sister, were scheming to take the family's wealth. Backed by Enzo, she assembled proof that laid bare Ivy's past wrongs. When her memories at last came flooding back, Emily saw clearly where her love belonged and chose Enzo, the man who had never stopped protecting her. Together they preserved the family's legacy and fo

titles.title: The Young Master They Called Useless
titles.titleEn: The Young Master They Called Useless
titles.description: Born into a legendary warrior clan, Chen Feng is a martial prodigy whose true strength goes far beyond the mortal peak, yet he keeps this hidden and lets the world see him as crippled. His enemies destroy his family, and at the funeral his fiancée breaks off their engagement. Neither they nor anyone else realizes the force they have stirred.

titles.title: A Fake Magistrate Saves the Throne
titles.titleEn: A Fake Magistrate Saves the Throne
titles.description: Empress Ye Qingyao finds herself the target of staged rescues and assassination attempts orchestrated by General Gu Sinan, all designed to push her off the throne. After she escapes, a scholar named Wang Fugui comes to her aid, and the two end up trapped in Lian'an County, where she must pose as a magistrate. As hired killers close in and infiltrate their ranks, they have to find a way to outmaneuver Gu Sinan—especially once his own deputy begins to waver in his loyalty.

titles.title: Runaway Bride
titles.description: John is left reeling when his fiancée Samantha gets cold feet on their wedding day and vanishes before the ceremony. The shock proves too much for him, and he collapses, requiring urgent medical attention. What was meant to be a celebration instead becomes a painful turning point, as John must come to terms with Samantha's sudden disappearance and the uncertainty she leaves behind. The series follows the emotional fallout of that abandoned wedding and the questions it raises about love, trust and what happens when someone simply walks away. Viewers can follow the unfolding story on Dramzio.

titles.title: Trapped as a Housewife
titles.description: Gu Qingcheng has handed over the reins of the family enterprise to her husband, Wang Kejie, and settled into the ease of a housewife's life. That comfort proves fatal: Wang Kejie and her friend Ni Na conspire against her, driven by greed for her fortune, and she loses her life to their betrayal. In her final moments, she is haunted by a bitter realization—she held knowledge but put it to no use, and she owned wealth while shirking every duty that came with it. Those who wish to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Blessed Baby Protects Mom
titles.description: A twist of fate follows a dragon’s awakening: the blessed Jiang Xing is placed in Shen Zhijiu’s womb, while the cursed Jiang Yun is placed in Lin Yue’s. Lin Yue frames Shen Zhijiu and takes her fortune for herself. With Jiang Xing’s guidance, Shen Zhijiu discovers a valuable stone. The dragon then brings the truth to light, revealing Lin Yue’s schemes.

titles.title: Nowhere to Belong
titles.description: A woman discovers her status as an outsider in her own family after stumbling onto a WeChat group chat her cousin left open on her computer. A notification announces a family dinner celebrating her younger brother Haohao's improved exam results, and when she clicks into the conversation, she finds the group contains only four members: her father, her mother, her brother, and her cousin. Her brother's reply makes the exclusion explicit, stating that only the four of them should attend and that Song Ximeng should not be invited, adding that she is petty and once fought with their cousin over a single apple. The discovery leaves her frozen, confirming what she had long sensed about her place in the family.

titles.title: My Ex-CEO Hubby Cries For Remarriage
titles.titleEn: My Ex-CEO Hubby Cries For Remarriage
titles.description: She entered a fake marriage with him solely to grant her dying grandfather’s final wish. Over time, however, she discovered that he had never stopped caring for his first love. Hurt by this, she asked for a divorce. Meanwhile, he was scouring the country for renowned physicians to help his first love, and his search eventually led him back to her with a request for treatment. Though she wanted to keep her distance, she found her feelings for him impossible to suppress.

titles.title: Rebirth in Blood and Moonlight
titles.description: Emma Shawn, betrayed in a previous life, refuses to become a bride and instead embraces widowhood. She defies her merciless family and sets her wedding dress ablaze. Yet just as punishment is about to strike, General Oliver Sterling—believed dead—reappears bearing a royal decree. The question lingers: who is this woman actually grieving? And what explains the Emperor’s personal interest in watching their every step? Dramzio is where the series can be followed.

titles.title: Love That Never Fades
titles.description: What does love truly mean? For Song Muye and Shen Tang, it becomes clear when their paths cross once more after five years apart. Love lives in the silences between them, in the untruths they felt forced to tell, each one leaving its own wound. It also lives in a single declaration: that Tang Tang is the only one he wants. Against the vastness of the world, the only thing worth asking for is the person you love. Those wanting to follow this story can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: [Dubbed]Melody of Redemption
titles.description: Betrayed by her husband Blake Carter and her younger sister Genesis Morgan, Sarah Morgan chooses divorce. She then steps forward to disclose that she is the true author behind his successful songs, a revelation that allows her to take back the copyrights to her work. The story follows her path as she rebuilds her life and career after the double betrayal. Those interested in how her journey unfolds can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Reborn at the Final Play: You Lost Me for Good
titles.titleEn: Reborn at the Final Play: You Lost Me for Good
titles.description: After sacrificing herself to save her football team, Katlyn Baker was met with betrayal and lost her life. Given another chance, she returns determined to reclaim what was taken from her and to make those who wronged her face the consequences. The series follows her path of revenge and renewal as she refuses to let the past repeat itself. Those interested can follow the story on Dramzio.

titles.title: I'm My Husband's Divorce Lawyer
titles.description: Lucy Archer was a top attorney who set her career aside for love, only to be betrayed by her husband John, who sued her for divorce. Representing herself in court, she takes apart the false evidence and fabricated videos he presents, brings his adultery and financial fraud to light, and secures the entirety of their marital assets, a victory that ends with him imprisoned. The series follows her transformation from submission to fierce retaliation in a story of legal revenge. Viewers can follow the drama and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Two Mates Never Loved Me
titles.titleEn: My Two Mates Never Loved Me
titles.description: Evelyn remembers dying in a previous life: Alpha Caden and Beta Zane treated her as nothing more than a plaything for their cherished Sera, then abandoned her to wild wolves. Given a second chance, she removes every gift they gave her and escapes into the snow without shoes. Sera, seemingly flawless, is revealed to be Asher, a male warrior living under disguise, who gives up years of his own life to rescue Evelyn. Just as she begins to love him, Caden and Zane come pleading for forgiveness, but Asher's sacrifice leaves him dead young. Evelyn must now decide whether she can avenge him and free herself from the two Alphas.

titles.title: Shattered Hearts Rekindled
titles.description: A vengeful man and a guarded, secretive woman are brought back together by pasts that have left them both broken. As he pursues her with fierce determination, their reunion stirs up intense emotion and inner conflict, and each of them is searching for a form of redemption. Their story blends passionate love with deep heartbreak, with desire and resentment running equally strong.

titles.title: The Duke's Shadow Mistress
titles.description:
Eva served as both a maid and the secret lover of the ruthless Duke Ashford, clinging to the naive belief that they might share equal love. That hope collapsed when the duke cast her aside to pursue a politically advantageous marriage, leaving her destitute and abandoned. Using her exceptional embroidery skills, she began earning a living in secret, which soon drew the duke's angry notice once more.

Lady Cecilia, the duke's scheming legal wife, saw Eva as an enduring blot on her family's honor and schemed repeatedly to remove her, at one point paying arsonists to burn her alive in the Yorkshire wilds. Thomas, a kind and faithful carriage driver who showed her true respect, rescued her and committed himself to her protection. With Cecilia's unwilling assistance, Eva staged an elaborate fak

titles.title: In Search of Jade
titles.description: Ye Liangyu longs for a quiet, unremarkable existence, so she hides who she really is and gets married. It soon becomes clear, however, that her husband is not the person she believed him to be. Driven by resolve, she sets out to rescue her daughter, drive out invaders, and defend her country. In the process, she builds a happy home and gains recognition as a wise and virtuous ruler.

titles.title: Sisters Have Crush On The Same Man
titles.titleEn: Sisters Have Crush On The Same Man
titles.description: Rosa and Emma are sisters who live in a castle inherited from their father, enjoying what seems like a fantasy life. Rosa is engaged to Edward Douglas, but an unfortunate accident leaves her in a coma. The marriage is not cancelled; instead, Emma's name takes Rosa's place. As time passes, the couple face difficult situations, and after six months Rosa regains consciousness. When she opens her eyes, the mounting tension pushes Emma to confess the truth to her sister.

titles.title: The Amnesiac Puppy
titles.description: Mae'r arwres yn cuddio ei gwir hunaniaeth ac yn cytuno i briodas gontract dair blynedd gyda'r prif gymeriad gwrywaidd, sy'n brif swyddog gweithredol i deulu Bai. Oherwydd sibrydion a chamddealltwriaethau ynghylch teimladau'r prif gymeriad gwrywaidd tuag at ei gariad cyntaf, mae hi'n colli ffydd yn y briodas.
