Pan fo cydweithiwr iddo'n awgrymu ysgariad, mae'r arwres yn cytuno. Ar y ffordd i ffeilio'r ysgariad, fodd bynnag, mae'r prif gymeriad gwrywaidd yn cael damwain car ac yn colli ei gof. Pan ddaw ato'i hun, mae'n credu mai'r arwres yw ei wir gariad. Gellir dilyn y gyfres ar Dramzio.

titles.title: Princess Jane's Daddy Makeover
titles.description: Jane Young, Eldest Princess of the Vermilion Kingdom, is reborn on her fifteenth birthday into the body of an eight-year-old girl in the modern world. The child she now inhabits was the true heiress, secretly swapped at birth, who grew up neglected at home while a fake heiress took all her parents' affection and eventually left her to starve. Furious but smiling bitterly, Jane reflects that fathers are meant to give love and children to return filial devotion—so if this father has none to offer, she will simply find a new one. A father everyone despises, a worthless man? For the prestigious Eldest Princess, turning such a wastrel into a proper parent is child's play.

titles.title: The Royal Scandal
titles.description: Betrayed by her husband, a princess suffers severe injuries—only to endure the ultimate cruelty of watching him cheat with his lover beside her hospital bed. She dies, but wakes again on her wedding day, resolved to rewrite the fate that once destroyed her. How she will strike back drives the story forward, and along the way another man enters her life, leaving open what will develop between them.

titles.title: My Ex's Dad Spoils Me
titles.description: Xu Zhiwei, an intern, discovers her boyfriend Fu Minghao being unfaithful. After drinking heavily, she spends the night with a man she doesn't know, only to learn later that he is Fu Yunshen—her company's CEO and, awkwardly, Fu Minghao's father. The two end up getting married, which places Xu Zhiwei in the position of being her ex-boyfriend's stepmother. Within this new family arrangement, she takes it upon herself to keep her former boyfriend in line, while Fu Yunshen showers her with affection. Their relationship eventually leads to them having a child together.

titles.title: Flirting Through Horror Worlds(Dubbed)
titles.description: Chen Lang, a male escort, is drawn into a world governed by horror rules, where he becomes bound to a beauty conquest system. The description of the series breaks off at this point, so further plot developments are not available. The dubbed version can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Skipped Seven Marriage Signings, I Chose My Bestie’s Brother。
titles.titleEn: Skipped Seven Marriage Signings, I Chose My Bestie’s Brother。
titles.description: Chloe repeatedly missed marriage meetings with Ethan—seven in total—because his childhood friend Lyla kept interfering, all while Chloe was trying to fulfill her dying grandfather’s final wish. Eventually she entered a fake marriage with Zane, the brother of her best friend. After Lyla destroyed a gift from Chloe’s grandfather and then slapped Chloe, Ethan took Lyla’s side. He went on to disrupt Chloe’s wedding and spread online rumors about her, but Zane made evidence public that restored her reputation. Chloe then threw Ethan and Lyla out. In time, she learned that Zane had quietly loved her for ten years.

titles.title: My Fiancé's Powerful Uncle Stole My Heart
titles.titleEn: My Fiancé's Powerful Uncle Stole My Heart
titles.description: On Valentine's Day, Serena, a lawyer, discovers her fiancé Trevor with Amber, his adopted sister, and the betrayal lays bare years of deception. Her family then blackmails her, but she turns to Sebastian, Trevor's influential uncle, whose feelings for her have quietly endured for years. Together they weather acts of sabotage, and Serena manages to recover her mother's shares, finally freeing herself from those who held her down. Sebastian, in turn, openly sides with her rather than bowing to his family's wishes.

titles.title: The Villainess They Died For (English-dubbed)
titles.description: A modern office worker suddenly finds herself inside a novel as Lyra Sterling, the cruel mistress who torments her four beast mates purely for amusement. A system then activates and assigns her a mission: win back the trust of all four mates or die. Desperate to survive, she reverses her behavior entirely. Gradually, their hatred gives way to loyalty, and loyalty deepens into love. Just when everything appears perfect, her mother demands the ultimate sacrifice—the lives of her mates in exchange for a divine ascension. Lyra refuses, even at the cost of her own death. When she falls, however, they burn their own souls to save her, and she finally understands that she was never the one in control; she was always the one they would die for.

titles.title: Don’t Kiss Me on Ice
titles.description: Après sept années passées à se livrer une rivalité acharnée, Kem et Gaff se retrouvent contraints de faire équipe. Ce qui commence par des provocations mutuelles finit par dépasser les limites et échapper à tout contrôle, sur fond de transferts et de blessures. La série Don’t Kiss Me on Ice peut être suivie sur Dramzio.

titles.title: FROM LIZARD TO DRAGON LORD
titles.description: Arya carries the Beast King's bloodline and finds herself reborn at the crucial Beast Selection Ceremony. She remembers the misery of her previous life, when her sister Selena—who likewise recalls the past—employed the same schemes to take Shadow, the Dragon Prince destined for Arya. This time Arya is determined to rewrite what is to come. Lieyan, heir to the Phoenix clan, offers Arya his allegiance willingly, and Shadow, though positioned at Selena's side, covertly assists her. Unable to capture Shadow's affection, Selena makes common cause with the Demon race in pursuit of power. Arya locates the Seal of the Dragon Soul, shatters it, frees Shadow from his binding, and ends the forced contract. In the Great Beast War she unites the two divine beasts to defeat the demons' scheme and bring

titles.title: The Bride They Never Expected
titles.description: Celine Samuel, chairwoman of Samuel Group, is preparing to marry Harry Chase. When she goes to the airport to meet his mother, the gesture backfires: she is taken for Harry's mistress, while Amy, his glamorous actual mistress, is welcomed as the future daughter-in-law. Harry's mother, unaware that she is insulting the real boss, publicly humiliates Celine.

titles.title: My Two Dangerous Roommates Crave Me
titles.titleEn: My Two Dangerous Roommates Crave Me
titles.description: Eli’s secret is out after he is caught watching gay porn, and soon the entire campus knows he is attracted to men. Among those aware is the guy Eli actually likes, though he is not the only one paying attention. The other roommate insists he hates Eli, yet his feelings keep deepening little by little. Both roommates are now consumed by desire for him—one relying on sweet manipulation, the other on blunt possessiveness. Eli’s response is to hold them both under his control. His rule is clear: he will not choose either of them. Anyone who wants to remain must accept his terms.

titles.title: (TV Series) Mariana & Scarlett [Original]
titles.description: Mariana e Scarlett sono due donne di classe media, entrambe "cachesudas", ma con personalità agli antipodi. Mariana è una persona seria, dolce e riservata, che cerca sempre di fare le cose nel modo giusto. Il testo originale si interrompe a questo punto, quindi non è possibile aggiungere ulteriori dettagli sulla trama. La serie può essere seguita su Dramzio.

titles.title: Turning Tides: Underdog's Gamble
titles.description: Cove Leeson, a fisherman in a small coastal village, found himself isolated after his own family turned against him and the locals mocked him. With nothing left to lose, he stumbled upon a secret, ancient fishing ground and honed his skills in deep-sea fishing. Braving deadly perils, he came back with a haul valued at $43,000, leaving the village stunned. His triumph, though, sparked envy in his uncle, who interfered with Cove's sales, damaged his name, and even tried to kill him. Cove refused to back down: he gathered proof, pursued justice, and won the community over to his side. By building premium sales networks and putting together a fleet, he broke the village's monopolies and claimed victory. This is the story of an unlikely fisherman who defied the odds and seized command of the op

titles.title: The Crown She Deserves
titles.description: Lydia Ashcroft's wedding day turns into a nightmare when her fiancé, Edward Sterling, betrays her, humiliating her and bringing harm to her family. With her heart shattered, she seeks out a mysterious figure from her past: Prince Maxwell Sterling, the one who once saved her as a child. Drawing on her sharp mind and concealed resilience, Lydia faces down her enemies, uncovers schemes within the palace, and seizes command of her own fate. Those who wish to follow this story can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: He Stole My Formula, I Took His Empire!
titles.titleEn: He Stole My Formula, I Took His Empire!
titles.description: Betrayed by his own cousin, Ray Zhao lost everything when Felix seized his special formula feed and abandoned him to die. Yet from the cursed waters of Deadwater Cove, Ray has emerged again, carrying a superior shrimp capable of rescuing the very empire now crumbling under Felix's control. His return serves no purpose of rescue, however. He has come to reclaim all that was taken from him.

titles.title: The Whistleblower's Debt
titles.description: Six years earlier, bus driver Charles ran red lights to get a sick Su to safety. She repaid him by reporting him for a $20,000 reward, and the consequences stripped him of his license, his job and his home. Now Su has turned up at the firm where Charles's son Liam works as head of HR. Liam resists, but she goes public, forcing the company to give way and then using its own rules against his family. Digging into the old case, Liam uncovers forged signatures, a paid witness, erased dashcam footage and money trails. In the end, the weapon she wielded turns against her.

titles.title: An Unexpected Upgrade
titles.description: Just before her wedding, Yuna Ji learns that Christopher Lu, her fiancé, has been carrying on a long-term relationship with her stepsister Yvonne Ji, who is pregnant. Christopher even expects Yuna to go along with the situation. Devastated, she calls off the engagement and instead marries Sebastian Shen, the Shen family’s second son, who is hiding behind a false disability while keeping a low profile. The two make a pact: Yuna secretly collects proof of Yvonne’s plots against her and assists in Sebastian’s supposed recovery, while Sebastian shields her from behind the scenes. Their arrangement gradually turns into real affection. When Sebastian exposes the truth of his feigned crippled state to rescue Yuna, Christopher, stung by Yvonne’s betrayal, is overcome with regret and pursues vengea

titles.title: Island Diary with My Stepmother
titles.description: After a shipwreck leaves Jack, a veteran, and Marcy, his girlfriend’s stepmother, stranded together, the two must depend on one another to get by. Their ordeal deepens when the dictator Richard frames them and forces them into exile. With Mia, a follower, they establish a rival camp, where they confront the fugitives Lucas and Ron. Mia’s sacrifice and a rescue from outside ultimately deliver justice and allow them to survive.

titles.title: My Stepfather’s Living Doll
titles.description: Evelyn notices something strange about her late mother's doll: each time it is touched, she feels the contact on her own skin. Arthur, her intimidating mafia stepfather, keeps his distance during the day yet guards the doll in secret after dark. Once Evelyn grasps that the doll is bound to her, she begins to see the emotions and hidden truths Arthur has kept buried for years. Then the doll disappears, setting off a search across the city that leaves Arthur no choice but to show how deeply he cares.

titles.title: Sacrificial Pharaoh's Queen
titles.description: Nora, an Egyptologist, finds herself the victim of betrayal and abduction, with her captors after a treasure map hidden within a submerged pyramid. What they do not realize is that she carries the soul of an ancient queen, once wed to Pharaoh Ramses. When her blood is spilled, it rouses the pharaoh from a slumber lasting five thousand years. Those who sought riches instead have awakened something far more terrifying.

titles.title: SSS-Rank Talent: The Nerd Mage Incoming
titles.titleEn: SSS-Rank Talent: The Nerd Mage Incoming
titles.description: Eleven years after a war’s end, the leading magic academy has reopened its doors. Ezra, a bookish young man dismissed as a novice by his teachers, descends from the mountains to join its ranks. During the entrance trials he meets his childhood sweetheart again, only for her betrothed to subject him to cruelty. When she rescues Ezra, she falls into a deathlike coma. His search for a cure forces him to question everything he believed, especially once he begins to wonder why the entire magic realm bows before him.

titles.title: (Dubbed)Daddy's Almost Home
titles.description: Carol Jones comes to the aid of Robert Wilson, an injured billionaire, and the two fall in love. When Carol becomes pregnant, Robert must depart because of a family crisis, though he vows to come back. Carol's father, however, compels her to wed Daniel Brown, a jeweler prone to violence. Although years go by, the two former lovers remain apart.

titles.title: Robot Warrior Ki Wapsi
titles.description: A warrior sacrifices his powers to fund his wife’s medical treatment. Three years later, both his wife and his brother betray him. Following a divorce, he sets out to reclaim his mecha strength and confront his enemies.

titles.title: The Unbreakables: Super Son Returns
titles.description: Kit disappears at seven during a robot attack and is taken in by his abductor Voltage, who raises him under the name Ash. Years later, Ash enters his own family’s tryouts, where Spark—Voltage’s son—frames him. His birthmark almost gives him away, Aura grows suspicious through intuition, and their father remains doubtful until Spark burns the mark off. Once Voltage publicly declares Ash his, the family is plunged into conflict. Ash demonstrates his true lineage and aids their escape. At the crater his memories return, and he takes back the name Kit Unbreakable, though Spark’s betrayal is left unsettled.

titles.title: Married a Farmer, Got a Billionaire
titles.titleEn: Married a Farmer, Got a Billionaire
titles.description: Pressured by her biased parents into taking her sister’s place in a rural marriage, Ye Jiayi stands her ground against hostile relatives while gradually forming a close bond with her mother-in-law. Before long, she learns that her husband, Huo Jingchuan, is secretly a billionaire. What begins as an unwanted arrangement turns into love, a triumphant return, and a complete victory.

titles.title: Surrounded by Wolves
titles.description: Bella believed her marriage was flawless—until she discovered that her husband Wilder and his brother Cross had used an astrolabe to stage a fake soul swap. Their aim was to ruin her reputation through a manufactured scandal and take her fortune. Bella played along outwardly while secretly turning the tables: she outmaneuvered both men, took control of their assets, and brought their plot into the open. Along the way, she found genuine love with the real Cross and began a new life.

titles.title: The Man Who Stole My Wedding Night
titles.titleEn: The Man Who Stole My Wedding Night
titles.description: On her wedding day, a bride flees her fiancé and hides in a stranger's car, where the vehicle's owner comes to her rescue. The series follows what unfolds after this chance encounter on what was meant to be her wedding night. For those interested in following the story, Dramzio carries the series and its episodes.

titles.title: Misjudged Mother, Divine Strategist
titles.description: Lena, once the High Strategos of the Order of Aegis and heir to Athena, rescued seven infants from a fire many years earlier. On the occasion of her fiftieth birthday, those sons—turned against her by their biological parents—publicly accuse her of being a trafficker. Rather than accept the betrayal, Lena takes back her authority, discloses who she truly is, and ultimately wins her sons' respect through her command.

titles.title: Poor? I Own the Cure for Everything!
titles.titleEn: Poor? I Own the Cure for Everything!
titles.description: A young man of mysterious origins comes into possession of age-old and highly advanced medical knowledge. After a modest clinic takes him on as its village doctor, his treatments draw in a steady stream of aristocratic patients and earn him a reputation that spreads far and wide. His remarkable abilities, however, also spark envy and ill will among others. The story follows this gifted figure as he uses his healing skills to carve out his own way forward and overcome every formidable adversary who stands against him.

titles.title: The Ultimate Bone's Legacy
titles.description: Long Yao, the eldest son of the Dragon Palace, sees his position threatened by his half-brother Long Teng, who possesses a rare Ultimate Bone. Driven by fear of losing his crown, Long Yao threatens the life of Long Teng's mother to force him to surrender the bone. With the Dragon King in retreat and no aid available, Long Teng has no choice but to comply. Long Yao then betrays him: he takes his mother's life, wipes his memories, and casts him down into the mortal world.

titles.title: The CEO Wants to Marry Me
titles.titleEn: The CEO Wants to Marry Me
titles.description: Finn Chandler, a destitute scavenger, acquires an X-ray Divine Eye capable of discerning worth and authenticity. After a lucrative discovery draws him into the world of Stone Gambling and auctions, he uncovers frauds and earns the affections of Roxanne Lynn and Wendy Sullivan. Yet his pledge to reclaim lost national treasures turns his Divine Eye into a liability, placing him in danger.

titles.title: The Magic Phone: The Immortal Comes
titles.titleEn: The Magic Phone: The Immortal Comes
titles.description: Wang Yang, a food delivery rider, devotes himself to hard work in order to support Li Qian. One day, after a car strikes him, his phone pulls him into the Heavenly Realm, where Sun Wukong, the Monkey King, selects him as a host. Believing the whole experience to be a dream, Wang Yang goes on to achieve both professional success and romantic happiness.

titles.title: SSS Detention
titles.description: In a world overrun by the apocalypse, Lucas Taylor acquires a Zombie Education System that lets him train devoted zombie followers. He joins forces with Dawn Base to take down the mutant Michael. When Eden sets its sights on his undead army, Lucas steps forward as humanity's protector. The question remains whether, with his invincible legion behind him, he can overcome threats that reach beyond the cosmos. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The CEO Reclaims Her Empire and Love
titles.titleEn: The CEO Reclaims Her Empire and Love
titles.description: Wu Shuyao was once a powerful figure in the business world, but her life is upended when she is accused of embezzlement. The betrayal comes from two people she trusted most: her romantic partner, Xu Jiahao, and her closest friend. Together they orchestrate the scheme that brings about her downfall. Stripped of her position and reputation, Wu Shuyao must find a way to clear her name and rebuild what was taken from her. The story follows her determined efforts to reclaim both her business empire and her sense of self after being deceived by those closest to her. Those interested in following this tale of betrayal and comeback can watch it on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Peerless Goddess
titles.description: Athena has turned against the divine order upheld by her father, bringing it down through her own actions. The world, meanwhile, embraces the false brother, while she fights her way through hell itself for the real one. Dramzio offers viewers a place to follow this series and its episodes.

titles.title: The Devil Wears Desire
titles.description: A woman whose heart is failing finds herself at the center of a perilous four-way tangle of love. Her childhood sweetheart has lost his memory, while a cold billionaire hides what he truly feels. A merciless playboy heir also pursues her, and an obsessive crime lord enters her life carrying a transplanted heart. As she moves through a maze of secret contracts, false identities and warped passions, she is caught in a high-stakes struggle for both love and survival.

titles.title: Fake My Death Make Him Pay
titles.titleEn: Fake My Death Make Him Pay
titles.description: Pregnant and coerced into donating her liver for her husband's lover, Jennifer loses her life — only to be reborn with a second chance. She stages her own death to break free, and in the process discovers that she and her husband's lover were switched at birth. Digging deeper, she exposes the Powell family's brutal scheme: they had planned to keep her alive solely as a source of spare organs, and they intended to kill her mother.

titles.title: Accidental Marriage, Surprise Son
titles.description: Daniel Brown and Emily Parker are pushed into an arranged marriage by their families, despite never having met. When Emily becomes pregnant unexpectedly, she chooses to raise their son, Andy, alone. Six years pass before Daniel comes back to the country, where a chance rescue brings him face to face with his own child without either of them knowing the connection. The encounter leaves Daniel wrongly convinced that Emily was unfaithful. Working side by side, however, the two begin to grow closer, and the confusion between them slowly clears. They ultimately find their way back to each other and settle into a happy life together.

titles.title: Experimental Brother
titles.description: Marked by a life brand, the mutant Zane survives only because of his adoptive sister Lila, whose touch neutralizes the poison inside him. A mad scientist pursues the pair, forcing them to escape from an alien laboratory as it collapses around them. Together they must stay ahead of their hunter while depending on each other to remain alive.

titles.title: The Fool’s Gambit
titles.description: Jimmy Nash found himself reborn as the foolish prince of Dayu. While keeping up the act of madness, he quietly instructed the eunuch Li Xuan to move cavalry into position. He dealt with Liu Qingshan, a convict who had broken free, and then brought to light the treasonous plot of the Third Prince. With these obstacles removed, he took the throne for himself.

titles.title: Just a Mechanic — Way Too Powerful
titles.titleEn: Just a Mechanic — Way Too Powerful
titles.description: Luther, once a celebrated figure in racing, has settled into a quiet life as a technology supervisor—until his own protégé, Charlie, sets him up and forces him out. A chance turn leads him to Seraphina's company, where his expertise helps her secure a vital victory over the very firm that cast him aside. In the aftermath, she reveals she is pregnant. Wilma and Charlie keep plotting against them, but Luther remains at Seraphina's side through every new crisis, and his loyalty gradually earns her love.

titles.title: I Died in a Glass Coffin, and My Brothers Lost Their Minds
titles.titleEn: I Died in a Glass Coffin, and My Brothers Lost Their Minds
titles.description: Chloe, an orphan, is reunited with her wealthy brothers, only for their adopted sister Sophia to subject her to a glass coffin test. Chloe accepts the challenge in hopes of earning the family's acceptance, not knowing Sophia has sealed the air holes with desiccant. As she pleads for help on a livestream, her brothers dismiss her cries as an act, and she suffocates. When they later learn she had worked hard to buy them gifts, remorse sets in. Sophia receives a death sentence for murder, but Chloe's soul has already departed, declaring she wants no further family ties.

titles.title: The Unruly Crown Princess
titles.description: Pei Zhiyu finds herself inside a novel, cast as its villainess. Her situation grows stranger when she discovers that Xiao Run, the crown prince and her domineering husband, has likewise arrived from the modern world. Once the two recognize each other for what they are, they decide to work together. Their shared goal becomes finding a way back to their own time, and they learn that a third transmigrator holds the key to returning home. That knowledge sends them into a desperate, nonstop search for this person.

titles.title: Reunion: Blood Over Lies
titles.description: Sold off in childhood by her gambling-addicted father, Calvin Mercer, Anna Mercer grew up while her birth mother, Martha Hale, lost her sanity. As an adult, Anna sets out to find Martha, but is misled into believing Calvin's second wife, Brenda Mercer, is her real mother. Brenda's cruelty eventually jolts Martha back to reason. To drag Martha back to the village and silence her permanently, Brenda and Calvin threaten to sell Anna once more, all while scheming to seize the family fortune. Ethan Whitaker uncovers the truth through a DNA test. He catches the pair abducting Martha but is knocked unconscious. Anna shows up and wrongly accuses Martha. Ethan regains consciousness in time and reveals what really happened. The wrongdoers face punishment, and Anna is at last reunited with Martha.

titles.title: (Dubbed) Wife? No, Queen of Ruin!
titles.description: She played the devoted wife—faithful, silent, willing to vanish into his shadow. Then he picked someone else, and she was simply gone. Now she has returned to Seaville, harder and more distant, beyond anyone's reach. He insists his love for her never faded. It makes no difference to her. She no longer wants that love; what she holds now is control over his future.

titles.title: After Amnesia, I Was Madly Pursued by Four Men
titles.titleEn: After Amnesia, I Was Madly Pursued by Four Men
titles.description: A young woman plunges from a building and is knocked unconscious. Upon regaining awareness, she finds that every memory of her past has vanished. Almost at once, four attractive young men begin pursuing her, pulling her into a life full of drama and romantic attention. Her forgotten history and the sudden interest of these four suitors shape the story that unfolds.

titles.title: The Drunken Deckhand: A Hidden Legend
titles.titleEn: The Drunken Deckhand: A Hidden Legend
titles.description: Eight years have passed since Sea Vanguard Jack, the mightiest warrior of his time, disappeared without a trace. He now lives in obscurity as a drunken deckhand, devoting himself to raising his daughter Mia. Everything changes when the Escort Guild is tasked with bringing the traitor Lord Parker to the capital. Pirates ambush the convoy, eager to seize his treasure map. Their attack puts Mia in grave danger, and at that moment Jack drops his disguise and reveals his godlike strength, annihilating the pirates and the monsters they command. Those wishing to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Claimed by the Deep
titles.description: Researcher Lia encounters Xavier, a lethal Siren, but mistakes him for a solitary merman. She teaches him songs and dances of courtship, and he takes her as his mate. After she escapes, he abducts her, convinced she has betrayed him twice. Lia then learns their history: as children, he rescued her, though she has no memory of it. Xavier intends to keep her permanently. When she realizes she is pregnant, he releases her, but she captures him instead to make him remain. Their child is born, and the two eventually marry. Xavier, who once lived in isolation, at last has a family.

titles.title: The Manor Game
titles.description: Eleanor, a fallen marquess's heir, marries Baron William—who drains her dowry. While away, she falls for Alexander, a castle attendant who's secretly a prince. William returns with a pregnant mistress. Eleanor exposes his debts, demands divorce. Alexander reveals his identity, supports her. She reclaims her title and marries him.

titles.title: I Masked Myself to Save Grandma
titles.titleEn: I Masked Myself to Save Grandma
titles.description: A young woman conceals who she really is when she approaches a rich heir, driven by a single goal: keeping her terminally ill grandmother alive. Pretending to be someone else, she mixes dishonesty with genuine warmth until he comes to depend on her more and more. Around them, bitter family conflicts and buried secrets tighten the pressure, and eventually her pretense falls apart. The story then turns on what remains between them—whether they will drag each other down or find a way to rescue one another. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Family, All Secret Bosses
titles.description: Li Fei earns his living as a delivery worker, putting in long hours for the sake of his family. What he does not realize is that the humble jobs he believes his relatives hold hide far grander identities. His father, seemingly an ordinary laborer, is in truth the Dragon Hall War God. His mother, thought to be a janitor, actually leads the Celestial Medical Sect. His sister, who he assumes waits tables, serves as CEO of the Jiuzhou conglomerate. Thanks to his determination, the family ultimately finds happiness together. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Maid to Madam? No!
titles.description: Roedd hi'n unig etifedd go iawn, ond cafodd ei mam ei labelu fel "y wraig arall" tra bod dieithryn wedi cymryd ei lle fel meistres y tŷ. Ar ben-blwydd y ddynes honno, dathlodd y teulu cyfan y celwydd. Felly gwnaeth y ferch wirioneddol yr hyn a oedd yn rhaid ei wneud, a thalu'r pwyth yn ôl i bob un o'r rhai ffug. Gellir dilyn y gyfres a'i hepisodeau ar Dramzio.

titles.title: I Refuse to Be Your Wife, Mr. Carter
titles.titleEn: I Refuse to Be Your Wife, Mr. Carter
titles.description: Evelyn devotes herself to nursing her paralyzed fiancé Julian back to health, yet once he recovers he turns on her. He tears down the medical legacy left by her mother and shatters Evelyn's hand on behalf of his mistress. Evelyn then reveals that the mistress's pregnancy is a lie, a disclosure that leaves Julian disgraced and paralyzed once more, able only to observe as Evelyn rebuilds her life and climbs again.

titles.title: Flash Marriage To My Billionaire Hobo Hubby
titles.titleEn: Flash Marriage To My Billionaire Hobo Hubby
titles.description: Katie works as an andrologist, and her mother gives her a deadline of one month to get married so the family business stays secure. Nate, who runs Blake Group as CEO, ends up in a humiliating andrology exam meant to confirm he is "functional." When the two cross paths at the hospital, it leads them into a contract marriage. Neither realizes the other's real position: Katie is the hidden Reed heiress, while Nate is living undercover as an ordinary employee. As genuine feelings start to develop, jealous colleagues, interfering mothers, and the danger of their secrets being exposed threaten the arrangement they have built. Dramzio is one place where this series can be followed.

titles.title: Fate Restarted: I Found My Mom a Perfect Husband
titles.titleEn: Fate Restarted: I Found My Mom a Perfect Husband
titles.description: Raised in a society that prized sons above daughters, she spent her whole life being overlooked. College was her dream and her way out, a chance to build a free life with her mother. That hope collapsed at the station, where her father’s rage turned to tragedy and her mother was killed. Whispering that she would follow her, she let the icy river take her. She then woke in 1980 to find her mother alive and standing in sunlight. Determined to change what was coming, she resolved to rewrite their fate and seek justice.

titles.title: His Forbidden Obsession
titles.description: Following her mother's death, Ella leaves home, unable to stay amid her father's affair. On an island, she encounters a man who is secretly a billionaire. When she returns to claim her mother's shares, she discovers that her lover is her... Those wanting to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2
titles.titleEn: Falling for My Ex's Mafia Dad 2
titles.description: Fay Thompson believed she had grasped how the mafia world worked, yet everything shifts when a rival with cunning plans appears, she discovers she is pregnant, and her lover is taken into custody. These events push her toward the role of Mafia Queen she was destined to assume. If she fails to rise to it, Kent Lippert may be lost to her for good.

titles.title: Forbidden Tides : Don't Tell My Stepson
titles.titleEn: Forbidden Tides : Don't Tell My Stepson
titles.description: A weekend getaway upends Lisa’s life when an overwhelming attraction flares between her and Kai, a college friend of her stepson. What begins as a spark soon becomes a tangled pattern of clandestine meetings, forcing her to guard the affair from both her husband and her stepson. The pull she feels for Kai keeps intensifying, and with it comes the danger that her marriage could come apart. Each decision she makes draws her further into a situation from which escape grows harder. For those who want to follow this story, Dramzio is a place where the series can be watched.

titles.title: The Last Thirty Days
titles.description: Zachary learns on his deathbed that his wife and daughter never truly loved him. Given a second chance, he wakes seven years into his marriage and chooses to release them both, turning instead toward medical research. The divorce is painful, and he relocates to Jing City to study brain cancer. There he encounters Coco, a young patient, and her aunt Xena, whose support helps him pursue research overseas. Ten years pass before he comes back as an accomplished scientist. Waiting at his apartment are two women holding flowers and nursing hope: Xena and his former wife.

titles.title: Reborn Immortal: Crushed the Fake Heir
titles.titleEn: Reborn Immortal: Crushed the Fake Heir
titles.description: Chen Xishou, who had lived for ages, was betrayed while undergoing tribulation and was reborn as Rong Zhao, a comatose heir his family had abandoned. Determined to take revenge on the impostor Rong Hao, he first humiliates him and then recovers his sword. With help from Qin Wen, the Qin heir, he brings down the Rong clan, and along the way he develops feelings for Wenren Zhuoling. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: 7000 dollars destroyed 30 years friendship
titles.description: Robert shares his family’s bacon recipe to rescue his friend Frank’s struggling restaurant. The recipe proves hugely lucrative, generating $250,000 in annual profit, yet Robert receives only $7,000 for it. With his family’s backing, he opens his own shop directly across the street and reveals Frank’s greed to the public. Frank’s breach-of-contract fines drive him into bankruptcy, leaving him to sell on the street, while Robert’s restaurant thrives and he cuts all ties with the man who refused to show him gratitude.

titles.title: The Fierce and Fiery Her
titles.description: After three years of unappreciated service to her fiancé’s family, Ivy Bennett is discarded the instant he comes back with another woman. Rather than weep and slip away, she storms through the Hale family business, cancels every order and demands repayment of every cent they owe her. With that settled, she leaves them behind, and her best life is only beginning.

titles.title: Fast-Track to Forbidden Love
titles.description: Aikawa Yuzuki has built her life around quick, practical cooking, but at home she endures constant emotional cruelty from her husband, Shunta. Her situation worsens when her cooking show is taken off the air without justification. In the midst of this turmoil, she grows close to her assistant, Tanimoto Liwen, and the two begin an affair that crosses a line. Their relationship is tested further by the arrival of a new influencer and by an event involving Shunta that leaves Yuzuki close to breaking point. Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: [Dubbed]Gift Return: Humanity's Last Hope
titles.description: Max Foster possesses a Gift Return System that allows him to shower women and elders with gifts in exchange for elite skills and rare meats. Thanks to this ability, he climbs the ranks with startling speed, unsettling everyone in the Arena. Later, within the Exam Hall, he takes on the role of humanity's final hope, confronting invaders and standing up to the Supreme Commander. His defiance ignites a rebellion that becomes an inspiration to many. Dramzio is where this series can be followed.

titles.title: Glass Steps
titles.description: Architect Vanessa Chen works as an accessible public architecture designer, and her career is marked by workplace plagiarism and broader industry injustice. She sets out to defend her original designs and the inclusive principles behind them, pushing back against unfair industry rules. Her struggle unfolds across six arcs, beginning with an initial humiliation and building toward her leading a reform effort for human-centered public architecture that serves all people.

titles.title: My Fake Bride Is the World’s Greatest Chef
titles.titleEn: My Fake Bride Is the World’s Greatest Chef
titles.description: To find a business partner she can trust, celebrated chef Serena hides her identity and pretends to be a beggar. In that guise, she accepts a proposal to act as the bride of Alexander, a man with a good heart who remains unaware that she is the culinary idol he worships. When a merciless tycoon sets his sights on the restaurant belonging to Alexander's family, Serena uses abilities she has kept hidden to reverse the situation. What began as a pretend marriage gradually develops into genuine love.

titles.title: Storm Unchained
titles.description: In a magic-ruled world, Thor is a low-born outcast held in contempt by his clan and abused by Loki, his half-brother. Hidden from everyone is the truth that he carries Odin's divine blood and was born with the power of thunder. Ahead of the Asgard Trials, Loki frames him for the theft of a sacred relic, and Gario, the clan lord, orders him into exile. Thor will not flee. When the rival Fire Clan launches an attack, he steps into the trials convinced of his own weakness, yet the power he releases leaves every noble and mage stunned.

titles.title: You're My Youthful Bliss
titles.description: Siena Reed reaches her breaking point with her husband Jaydon Larson, whose neglect of their marriage pushes her into a hasty divorce. Under pressure from her grandfather, she then agrees to a contractual relationship with a man named Melvin Stark, despite his unusual demand that she wear a blindfold. Jaydon keeps attempting to win her back, but Siena turns him down each time. Growing closer to Melvin, she begins to question who he really is. The truth emerges when he finally removes his mask: her mysterious partner is a figure from her past, now head of the well-known Barnes Group. You're My Youthful Bliss can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Love in the Twilight Breeze(Dubbed)
titles.description: Approaching forty, Jiang Xiaoyu is desperate to fund treatment for her daughter's leukemia and decides to sell her eggs. A misdial connects her to Jin Hancheng, the hospital director, who feigns a harsh warning to steer her away from the risky plan out of concern for her safety. Their paths then cross in an unexpected way, leading to a passionate night and an unintended pregnancy. To provide for the child she now carries, Jiang Xiaoyu takes work at a nightclub, where she repeatedly comes close to running into Jin Hancheng without actually meeting him, and misunderstandings pile up between them. Convinced she has sunk into a reckless life, he has no idea of the hardships she faces. At the same time, her gambling ex-husband torments and abuses her and her daughter, pushing them to the brink.

titles.title: Engaged [Original]
titles.description: Darren, played by Daniel K. Isaac, has one goal in mind: he wants to ask his boyfriend of many years, portrayed by Ryan Jamaal Swain, to marry him. That is the whole of his intention. The story centers on this desire to propose, with the longtime partner at the heart of it. For those interested in following how this plays out, the series can be found on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Heiress & Her Lying Beast
titles.description: Vivian Lawrence, the overlooked and least attractive daughter of the wealthy Lawrence family, agrees to a contract marriage with Aaron, a man she has been led to believe is cruel, ugly, and disabled. Her motive is practical: securing the inheritance left by her late mother. The plan is to divorce after a year. Yet Aaron turns out nothing like the vicious playboy the rumors describe, and as the two grow closer, Vivian begins to suspect that his disability conceals a truth no one has told her.

titles.title: Corrupting My Billionaire Boss's Heart
titles.description: When Lyla Walker takes a job at the most exclusive country club in the world, she has no idea that her arrival will set off a wave of upheaval. Her presence disrupts the orderly world around her, bringing unexpected complications to the people she encounters there. The story follows the consequences of her new position and the turmoil that follows. Those interested can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Adored Little Treasure
titles.description: Pei Yanxi, an heiress, goes against her family’s long-standing feud by secretly running away with a sworn enemy, and before long she is expecting a child. After a tragic accident and a series of misunderstandings, her baby daughter Fu Bao ends up being raised by a harsh man who becomes her unexpected guardian. Kept unaware of her real background, Fu Bao suffers years of mistreatment and constant torment, until her uncles finally discover the truth about her identity, paving the way for a striking turn in her fortunes.

titles.title: Accidentally Pregnant With My Nemesis' Baby
titles.titleEn: Accidentally Pregnant With My Nemesis' Baby
titles.description: Haley, a college student, agrees under pressure to carry a child for a corrupt professor in order to help her ill brother. A mistake in the laboratory, however, results in her becoming pregnant with the baby of her rival, Justin. The story follows the consequences of this mix-up for both of them.

titles.title: Delivered to the wrong address
titles.description: Marcus uncovers that his wife Audrey and her lover Ethan have been siphoning money from the company. Rather than seeking payback, he quietly collects proof and brings them before a court on fraud charges. For the sake of her parents, he also puts his signature to a letter of understanding. He then reorganizes the business, starts a new family life, and steps out of the shadows—composed rather than resentful, and at last free. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Lost Moon Princess
titles.description: A wolf princess loses her pendant to a jealous friend, who then shoves her from a cliff and takes her place by impersonating her. A young Alpha comes to her rescue, and she discovers she can use moon magic to heal the wounded. For those who want to follow this story, Dramzio is a place where the series can be watched.

titles.title: My Enemy CEO Wags His Tail
titles.titleEn: My Enemy CEO Wags His Tail
titles.description: Holly Stone, who runs Cloudcrest Group, has little faith in men or romance, viewing dishonest men as no better than dogs. When her father's business faces collapse, she agrees to a contract marriage with Julian Yates as a way to rescue it. Julian carries a curse that turns him into a Doberman Pinscher for several days every month, and Holly alone holds the key to lifting it. The question lingers over whether he is truly a monster or a man who deliberately arranged to draw close to her.

titles.title: Campus Queen Dropped Her Act
titles.description: For three years, Josie Zouch had played the part of a devoted admirer to Zack Lever, the most sought-after guy on campus, tending to his every whim. Her patience ran out on New Year's Eve, when he humiliated her once more as she confessed her feelings; she simply said "Game over" and left. What Zack never knew was that Josie belonged to the wealthy Zouch family and had been living as a slum girl to settle a wager with her childhood friend Sean Gaunt. Once the bet concluded, she stepped back into her true identity and cut ties with Zack. Learning the truth too late, Zack was filled with regret and, alongside a jealous Willa Shears, schemed to sabotage Josie and Sean's wedding, only to be beaten and disgraced. Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Reclaiming What Is Mine
titles.description: Su Nian, heiress to the Su Group, is betrayed by her adopted sister Su Yao, who frames her and sends her to prison for a decade. After her release, Su Nian has rebuilt herself abroad as a celebrated artist. She comes home determined to settle the score: she reveals that Su Yao is an illegitimate child, takes control of the Su Group, and witnesses Su Yao's descent into madness and eventual death. With that chapter closed, Su Nian begins a new life alongside Lu Zeyan. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Deserted Island
titles.description: Frank and his fiancée’s family were traveling by high-speed rail toward the city to purchase a house when a tsunami struck. The source does not provide further details about what happens after this event. For those interested in following the series, episodes can be found on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare (English-dubbed)
titles.titleEn: My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare (English-dubbed)
titles.description: Betrayed and killed, Silas Hayes wakes again on the eve of an Anomaly Tide. This time his priorities are simple: keep his younger brother Cody safe and avoid the people who betrayed him. In an alley he comes across a scrawny, pitiful stray begging for scraps, names it Grim and takes it in. Grim, however, is no dog but an S-Rank Anomaly, the Shadow Wolf, able to tear through reality with a single howl. Silas unknowingly binds the creature through a power he never knew he had, the Absolute Contract, which lets him tame any Anomaly. Nor is Cody the weak child he appears to be. My Pet Is an S-Rank Nightmare can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Different Names, Same Love
titles.description: In high school, Catherine Mills pressured William Pierce into a relationship that lasted three years before he ended it without feeling. Seven years on, she came back a changed woman going by the name Nina Woods. When their daughter needed medical care, the two were brought together again, and William grew fixated on her. Though she claimed to have a husband, he chose to be her lover anyway, admitting that his love had arrived too late and left him unwell. Dramzio is where viewers can follow this series.

titles.title: Framed Soldier: Blood for Blood
titles.description: After their commanding officer turns on the elite special forces pair known as the Twin Wolves, only Ilya lives through the ambush. He makes his way to the hometown of his dead partner, intending to look after the man's family. What he discovers there is that the same commander holds sway over the region's criminal underworld. Ilya chooses to strike back, determined to settle the score for his partner and himself.

titles.title: THE DRAGON’S BRIDE
titles.description: Elaine, a noblewoman, is taken by a fearsome dragon on the very day she is to be married. What she does not yet know is that the creature is Noah, a young dragon prince suffering under a lethal curse. As secrets about who they truly are come to light, Elaine takes her place as his official dragon contractor. Side by side, the two confront corrupt and ambitious nobles, strive to shatter the ancient bonds that divide humans and dragons, and set out to change the destiny of both peoples. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The God's Descent
titles.description: Cast out by the influential Zhan family, Zhan Tianchen earned his standing through years of combat at the border, rising at last to be hailed as the God-King of the Northern Frontier. His in-laws, however, failed to recognize what he had become and, as their own influence expanded, chose to sever the marriage. Surrounded by the scorn of the nobility and the threatening presence of King Poseidon, he must keep his identity hidden while bringing the latter's invasion plan to light. Through cleverness and resolve, he defeats the plot and preserves the peace of the realm. By the time it is over, neither his former wife's family nor the Zhans can undo their regrets. Zhan Tianchen remains at the summit, untroubled by what they feel, his deeds passing into legend as he journeys on in search of his

titles.title: My Boss by Day，My Submissive by Night
titles.titleEn: My Boss by Day，My Submissive by Night
titles.description: During office hours, he rules as the intimidating Mr. Boss, dressed in Givenchy and demanding obedience. Once the workday ends, the dynamic flips: he becomes the submissive kneeling before his assistant, pleading to be disciplined. When newcomer Evelyn stumbles into her employer's hidden dungeon, she starts to suspect that this man might also be the anonymous male sub she has been talking to online. In public, he holds all the authority; in private, she takes control. Yet the arrangement takes an unforeseen turn.

titles.title: Our Love Was A Setup - Preview
titles.titleEn: Our Love Was A Setup - Preview
titles.description: Tessa, a scholarship student, comes back to the elite North Lake academy and enters a fake relationship with Ronan, the boy who was once her childhood enemy, as an act of defiance against their poisonous social circle.

titles.title: So What? Your Dad Loves me
titles.titleEn: So What? Your Dad Loves me
titles.description: On her twentieth birthday, Iris was drugged by Luke, who then betrayed her. Because the room signs had been switched, she ended up sleeping with Ethan, a mafia boss, by mistake. When they meet again, Iris is stunned to learn that Ethan is Luke's father. Luke had been carrying on with his cousin Mia, and together they torment and frame Iris until she is pushed to her limit. Ethan, drawn to Iris from the moment he sees her, protects her fiercely, taking on Luke and his grandfather Andy's mafia forces to avenge her and help her heal. Luke's real parentage comes to light, and he joins his biological father Victor, making repeated attempts to harm Ethan and Iris. Ethan ultimately removes every threat, and he and Iris, who has suffered so much, finally find their way to each other.

titles.title: Not Your Lovestruck Princess(Dubbed)
titles.description: Diana once gave up everything for love. In a previous life, she chose to marry Mason of her own free will and poured her personal wealth into funding his climb to power. When he came home from war, however, he did not return alone: he brought back a concubine, leaving Diana to face the consequences of her devotion. The story follows her as she confronts that betrayal and the life she built around a man who discarded her. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Village That Wanted My Baby
titles.titleEn: The Village That Wanted My Baby
titles.description: Annie Hughes is drawn to Reed Bay Village by Zion Hunt, only to discover that the marriage certificate she believed in is a forgery—Zion is already married to Cora Dunn. The Hahn Clan has designs on her unborn child and wants Annie out of the picture entirely. The one person who stands between her and that fate is the Dragon Mother, whom Annie once rescued; she puts everything on the line to help Annie escape. A year passes before Annie comes back to set the Dragon Mother free, arriving at the same moment the Dragon Mother returns with a Little Drake.

titles.title: Mom From the Graveyard
titles.description: When Gina’s two children arrive to bury their mother, something else rises from the graveyard in her place: a Bone Demon wearing Gina’s form. Assuming the dead woman’s identity, the demon sets about raising the children while pursuing vengeance on Gina’s behalf. Her actions begin to alter the destinies of women throughout the village, and before long the locals revere her as the Bone Goddess. The central question is whether she can continue to act as the children’s mother without her true nature coming to light.

titles.title: Three Months to Be a Herding Dog
titles.titleEn: Three Months to Be a Herding Dog
titles.description: A burnt-out office worker suddenly finds himself inhabiting the body of Stubby, a corgi, and is immediately tied to the Ultimate Sheepdog Training System. The stakes are stark: secure a Certified Sheepdog post within three months, or his body will deteriorate until he can no longer survive. Dismissed by others as a runt, he leans on the strategic thinking honed in his old workplace to clear the trials, and along the way converts his rival Rusty into an ally. As the deadline looms, the question remains whether he can clear the final exam before time runs out. Those wanting to see how this unusual career pivot unfolds can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: When the Fog Lifted, I Started a New Life
titles.titleEn: When the Fog Lifted, I Started a New Life
titles.description: After enduring domestic abuse, Dr. Seraphina rebuilds her life from the ground up. She finds a fresh beginning alongside a new partner, Gabriel. The story follows her journey out of violence and into a different chapter. For those who want to follow how this unfolds, the series can be watched on Dramzio.

titles.title: Resident Evil
titles.description: A storm cuts off Emily and her wealthy boyfriend from the outside world, leaving them stranded in a mountain villa while a genetically altered black bear stalks the guests. The creature is disturbingly clever: it copies the sound of knocking, breaks through security codes, and never forgets a face that has wronged it. Emily eventually learns that Ryan was involved in the brutal experiments behind the bear, turning mere survival into a settling of accounts. Known as Subject Seven, the animal is driven by a single purpose—making every one of its tormentors answer for what they did. Those following this story can watch it unfold on Dramzio.

titles.title: Taming the Alpha Beast
titles.description: Zoologist Christine follows her fiancé into a forbidden canyon, only to be left behind among a pack of hyenas. Eric, a shapeshifting lion king, saves her, though his tribe's painful history with humans makes him wary and unwilling to let her go. Over time, Christine earns the clan's confidence by using her zoological skills to treat Eric and the cubs and to dismantle poachers' traps. Shared experiences of betrayal draw them together despite ongoing tension, while the jealous warrior Nala schemes against her and fails each time. Simon, the secret leader of the poaching operation, kidnaps Christine; after she escapes to the canyon, mercenaries attack, Eric takes a grave gunshot wound, and Christine risks the tribe's distrust to summon human veterinarians for emergency surgery, briefly soften

titles.title: I Watched Them Love Her
titles.description: Tessa survives being thrown from a building by Chloe, her adopted sister, only to wake up at fifteen with her life starting over. Rather than chase her family's affection again, she steps back. Chloe twists events and accuses Tessa of cheating, but Tessa stays composed and uses surveillance footage to expose the truth, which gets Chloe expelled. Tessa goes on to earn top grades and a Yale scholarship. Her family offers apologies, yet she keeps her distance, then departs for Yale by herself, resolved to build a life on her own terms.

titles.title: When Love Missed Its Moment
titles.description: Howard Judd once married Willow Murphy in a previous life, only to discover that she treated him as nothing more than a blood bank for Simon Wade, her first love. The story follows Howard as he navigates the painful consequences of that betrayal and the lingering question of what might have been. Dramzio offers viewers a way to follow this series and its unfolding episodes.

titles.title: My Heimlich Shocks All
titles.description: Nachdem der Hausmeister Wang Ming den Arzt Wu wegen der Belästigung seiner Freundin, der Krankenschwester Fang Wei, angezeigt hat, wird er von ihr verraten. Er verliert seine Stelle und wird gedemütigt, doch dann aktiviert er ein System, das ihm grundlegende medizinische Fähigkeiten verleiht, die wie Wunder wirken. Er rettet die Erbinnen der Familie Cheng, besiegt Wu in einem Wettstreit und bezwingt den sogenannten „Unsterblichen Arzt“, wodurch er selbst zur Legende wird. Die Serie und ihre Episoden lassen sich unter anderem bei Dramzio verfolgen.

titles.title: Rejected? I'm Bound to the First Wolf King
titles.titleEn: Rejected? I'm Bound to the First Wolf King
titles.description: Betrayed by the man she loved, she turns her back on her former Moon Contract and crosses paths with the silent Wolf King. Unknown to everyone around her, this guardian—seemingly powerless and unable to complete her shift—carries within her the bloodline of the First Wolf King. Her journey takes her from a discarded Omega to the Moon Weaver who commands her own fate, marking the start of a remarkable ascent.

titles.title: I Built Him Up, He Betrayed Me
titles.titleEn: I Built Him Up, He Betrayed Me
titles.description: Vera Nightshade never forgot the boy who rescued her when she was young, and she carried a promise to repay Oscar Bennett for the rest of her life. That vow eventually led her to marry him. The synopsis breaks off at this point, so further developments in their relationship are not described here.

titles.title: Mr. Calculated & Ms. Wildfire
titles.description: Cast aside on the very day everything falls apart, Rosalie Lane sets her grandmother's courtyard ablaze and collides with Lucas Kent. He brings her into his world intending to wield her as a weapon, but she refuses to be controlled, turning his plans against him and setting off every trap he lays. Two damaged people caught in the same risky game must decide whether they will rescue one another or bring down everything they have built. The story is adapted from the Fanqie Novel "Taiziye Ni Jian De Luopo Xiao Meigui Shouqi You Xianzhuo Le" by Miao Zong Shui Bu Xing. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle
titles.titleEn: Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle
titles.description: On her eighteenth birthday, Princess Lia Torres, heir to the Phoen Dynasty, undergoes a strange fate: her soul is pulled from her own world and placed inside the body of another person. The source does not specify whose body she enters or what follows after this transfer. What is clear is that the event happens on the very day she comes of age, marking a sudden and involuntary break from her life as a princess. The story begins from this moment of displacement, leaving the consequences of the soul swap to unfold in later developments. Viewers can follow Pampered by My Silver Fox Uncle on Dramzio.

titles.title: Fury Released From Prison
titles.description: Qin Feng ends up behind bars after stepping in to shield his fiancée, Lin Wan'er, from Zhao Kai. While imprisoned, he survives an attempt on his life and takes up martial arts. Once released, he gets his revenge by defeating Zhao Kai, cures the daughter of Zhang Sancheng, and comes into possession of Xingsheng Group. The conflict continues when Li Shengsan abducts Lin Wan'er, and Qin Feng, joined by Ji Yuan'er, sets out to bring her back. Those interested in following how the story unfolds can find the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Ops! I Married with My Forgetful Ex-boyfriend
titles.titleEn: Ops! I Married with My Forgetful Ex-boyfriend
titles.description: Three years after heiress Monica lost her fiancé Leon in a tragic accident, the bar she runs—still full of his memories—is threatened with demolition by Albert, the son of a tycoon who bears an exact resemblance to Leon. Albert, however, has no recollection of her and accuses her of scheming. Fate keeps pulling them together, leaving open the question of whether they can uncover the truth behind his amnesia and the wreckage of her past.

titles.title: My Fire Captain, My Safe Place
titles.titleEn: My Fire Captain, My Safe Place
titles.description: Anya is stuck in a violent relationship with Nick. To keep her daughter Tasha safe, she escapes, only to find herself threatened with deportation. Out of options, she agrees to a marriage of convenience with Dalton, a firefighter with a formidable reputation. The arrangement starts as nothing more than a practical bargain, yet over time it deepens into mutual trust and genuine affection, opening the way toward a fresh and courageous start for them all.

titles.title: The Teacups Between Us
titles.description: Following her mother's passing, novelist Emily Harris discovers a set of old teacups in a Chicago house, each bearing the name of someone she has never met: Helen Morrison. Digging into the connection, she finds that her mother and Helen had once been the closest of friends until their bond was destroyed by their shared love for one man. When Emily finally meets Helen, now elderly, she uncovers decades of quiet endurance and feelings that were never voiced. What emerges is a reconnection between two women who had been separated by pride and heartbreak.

titles.title: A City Full of Sunlight
titles.description: After relocating to Flower City in hopes of recovering the memories she has lost, Su Meng becomes a creditor to Lin Feng, the heir of the Lin family. To settle what he owes her, Lin Feng hands over his coffee shop, and Su Meng settles into a leisurely existence in the city. Over time, she comes to understand that Lin Feng holds the key to the past she can no longer remember. Those following the series can watch it on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Price of Prejudice
titles.description: Nia keeps her background as the hidden heiress of V.A.R.H. Lux Group a secret so she can stand behind Kane, her impoverished but gifted lover. Over four years she helps him build L-Astra, the brand he dreamed of, and intends to install him as its CEO. Everything changes when Kane comes back with Hila. He turns on Nia, ruins the gift she had prepared and subjects her to humiliation. As she sinks into despair, three golden lion helicopters appear and her real identity comes to light.

titles.title: CEO Daddy's Little Army
titles.description: A single night with Xie Jinghuai leaves Luo Sitian raising three children of her own along with one she adopts. Six years on, Xie learns what happened and pursues custody, a conflict that ends with the two of them marrying. Their wedding day descends into disruption when Xie Qingqing and Wen Hui create a scene, and Xie Jinghuai steps in to defend Luo, revealing who Wen Hui really is. Not long afterward, he discovers that all three children are biologically his, and that the Wen family's genuine heiress is Luo Sitian herself.

titles.title: The Emperor's Envoy
titles.description: After an unexpected journey back in time, Zhang Ye assumes his modern knowledge will allow him to prosper in the past. He soon discovers, however, that life without official standing is grim. The imperial exam becomes his sole route forward, and he secures a place as a scholar-in-training, yet he lacks the funds to make the journey. In a desperate effort to finance his trip, his father sells both Zhang Ye and his sister into servitude. Setting out for the capital, Zhang Ye learns of the sacrifices his family has made on his behalf and resolves to improve their lives. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Hidden Plus-Sized Luna Queen
titles.description: Lirael, the daughter of an Alpha, carries a deadly power concealed beneath a curse that makes her overweight. After her fiancé abandons her and her mother is stripped of the Luna title, she joins the Royal Guard Trials in spite of the mockery she faces. When an eclipse shatters the potion's hold, both her strength and her beauty are set free. Prince Lucian, a figure from her past, stands at her side as she reshapes the laws of the wolves. The Hidden Plus-Sized Luna Queen can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Goodbye, Mr. Foster
titles.description: Following her release from the hospital after giving birth, Samantha Blake discovered Daniel Foster allowing Allison Turner, an intern who closely resembled his first love, to behave beyond her place. Rather than showing any regret, Daniel permitted Allison to provoke Samantha repeatedly. Once she had had enough, Samantha made her divorce filing public and, at the baby's one-month celebration, pulled out all her investments, striking the Foster Group a serious blow. When Allison's plot came to light, Daniel finally understood the years of quiet devotion Samantha had given him and the reality of his own infertility. He went down on his knees to plead for a second chance, but she turned him down and moved forward into a new life with her child.

titles.title: The Lady from the Northeast Season 2
titles.titleEn: The Lady from the Northeast Season 2
titles.description: Leah Foster, whose blunt Northeastern character is impossible to ignore, is set to marry Kyle Preston, heir to Malaysia's wealthiest family. What began as a pretend romance between them has grown into something genuine. Thanks to her fearless and quick-witted nature, the once-divided Preston household has rediscovered its warmth. As the couple prepares for their wedding, Leah also manages to track down Kyle's brother, who had been missing for years. Through her own distinctive approach, she draws the family back together and secures her standing among them. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: BLOOD MONEY
titles.description: Ryan, a former Marine, accepts a dangerous assignment in Sudan worth half a million dollars, intending to fund his daughter's operation and secure a future with his girlfriend. He makes it out alive, but his employer Marcus hands him only $30,000, takes his girlfriend, and mocks him openly. A fresh opportunity then comes his way: guarding Selina, a wealthy journalist, in Mexico. What unfolds involves romance, payback, and considerable wealth.

titles.title: Mafia Queen's Fake Bride
titles.description: FBI Agent Parker takes on a covert assignment that requires her to pose as a mafia heiress and marry into a gangster family. On the wedding day, however, the groom never appears. Standing in his place is his older sister, Thea—the former lover Parker had ruthlessly eliminated three years earlier while working undercover.

titles.title: The Charming Killer with a Soft Heart
titles.titleEn: The Charming Killer with a Soft Heart
titles.description: Lu Qinian's half-brother engineered a car accident that nearly claimed the life of Qu Xiaoan. Lu Qinian went to extraordinary lengths, at real cost to himself, to bring her back from the brink. She pulled through, yet the memories she carries set off neural reactions that plunge her into comas. Those around Lu Qinian pressed him to walk away, but he refused, staying with an amnesiac Qu Xiaoan and tending to her day after day.

titles.title: My Last Thing For You
titles.description: For seven years, Brady Hayes kept a quiet promise to his late fiancée, Jill Hill, by watching over Jenna Hill and clearing her path without ever seeking credit. Jenna, however, credited Chris Holt for every kindness and dismissed Brady as a pathetic hanger-on, pushing him away with rejection, mockery, and cruelty. It was only when Brady staged his own death and vanished that she understood who had really stood beside her all along.

titles.title: Hitman At Your Service
titles.description: After his father's death, Yongtae was left to cope with both poverty and lingering trauma. Matters worsen when a car accident leaves him facing a settlement offer so absurdly low that it nearly breaks him. At that low point, a mysterious figure named Yucheul appears with a dangerous proposition. With no real way to refuse, Yongtae agrees and soon finds himself testing how far he is willing to go. That single choice sets in motion a chain of events that reshapes his entire life.

titles.title: The Lost Wolfless Mate
titles.description: Elena, a girl without a wolf, conceives a child during a full-moon night with the dying Alpha Damon. Cast out while pregnant, she raises their son Noah on her own, while Damon searches for the mate fate has chosen for him. Her family later seizes Noah as a hostage to force her into marriage, and Damon comes back to claim both mother and child. His pack, however, rejects Elena, and a rival schemes to take her position as Luna for herself.

titles.title: Did Mrs. Ye get slapped in the face today?
titles.titleEn: Did Mrs. Ye get slapped in the face today?
titles.description: Drugged by the Qin family, Ye Junlin slept with Qin Wanwan, who had entered the wrong room by mistake. She conceived his child, while her mother Xu Mei was cast out of the family home by her father, Qin Guosheng, leaving mother and daughter to rely on each other. As Qin Wanwan neared childbirth, a car struck her, leaving her comatose and in need of three million yuan for surgery. Xu Mei turned to Qin Guosheng for help, only to be cruelly insulted by him. Then Ye Junlin's mother, Mrs. Ye, stepped in, offering Xu Mei the three million in return for the unborn child. With no other option, Xu Mei took the still-unconscious Qin Wanwan and handed the baby over. Audiences can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Milk That Broke a Marriage
titles.description: For three years, an heiress concealed her true identity and lived as an ordinary full-time housewife. Everything changed once she uncovered her husband's sadistic secret. Realizing the man had deceived and toyed with women's emotions, she confronted him in court and dismantled him there. Her revenge complete, she rose from the ashes and reclaimed the glory she had once known. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Seducing My Employer's CEO Husband
titles.description: A woman finds herself drawn into a complicated situation involving the husband of the CEO she works for. The story follows her as she navigates the tensions that arise from this entanglement, balancing her position as an employee with the personal feelings that develop. The narrative explores the consequences of desire and ambition colliding within a high-stakes workplace setting. Viewers who enjoy tense romantic dramas can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Death Drove My Brothers Mad
titles.titleEn: My Death Drove My Brothers Mad
titles.description: Catherine's three influential brothers—an heir to a business empire, a top medical examiner, and a professional hockey player—reserve all their affection for Nadia, a woman posing as an heiress, while shutting Catherine out. The source synopsis ends there, leaving the rest of the story untold. What follows presumably traces the consequences of that favoritism and the revelation of Nadia's deception. For viewers who want to see how this family drama unfolds, the series can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Lawyers' Broken Love
titles.description: Two lawyers who were once deeply in love now find themselves on opposite sides of the same major lawsuit. Their shared past keeps bleeding into the present, complicating their professional duties as they clash in court. Meanwhile, powerful outside parties attempt to exploit the tangled history between them in order to influence how the case ultimately ends.

titles.title: Fabulous at Fifty
titles.description: Twin sisters are separated as children by a fire and a father whose negligence drives them apart. The elder twin, Zhao Ruoqi, grows up to become a CEO and spends her adult life searching for her sibling. When she finally locates her younger twin, she finds her in danger. Drawing on her intelligence and resources, Zhao Ruoqi sets out to take cunning revenge on the abusive father and the treacherous nanny responsible, seeking to restore justice and the family's honor.

titles.title: The War Goddess of Atlantis
titles.description: Orphaned by the massacre of her family, Seraphina was taken in and trained by the Tidal Queen, growing into the rank of Marshal. She comes back to Eastreef in disguise and discovers that House Reck has taken control of her grandfather's Moontide Temple. Mistaken for a hired sword by Theo, she is drawn into his affairs. When he is nearly killed protecting her in the arena, Seraphina calls upon her moontide power, setting off both a quest for revenge and a fight to defend what remains.

titles.title: Replaced My Guardian with a Werewolf
titles.titleEn: Replaced My Guardian with a Werewolf
titles.description: Elora, a mage of low rank, endures cruelty from her assigned Guardian, Drake, a disabled dragon whose bitterness toward her is constant. Determined to change her situation, she petitions to have him replaced and takes in Griffin, a wild werewolf rejected by everyone else. Griffin proves fiercely loyal and protective of her. Drake, consumed by jealousy, admits to a possessive and warped affection, which Elora turns down before cutting their bond entirely. His wealthy patron eventually casts him aside, leaving him in a shelter. Meanwhile, Elora and Griffin create a warm, devoted life together, with Griffin embodying the gentleness and faithfulness Drake never showed.

titles.title: The Alpha's Quest：Five Cubs Matchmakerrs
titles.description: The Alpha's Quest: Five Cubs Matchmakerrs is a series whose story, characters and episodes can be discovered as they unfold. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Lycan's Savage Luna
titles.description: Wren is branded wolfless and cast aside by Tristan, her childhood love, when he takes the throne. At his coronation he denies their mate bond before everyone and allows his lover to shear her hair. Devastated, she turns her back on the Dark Moon pack and enrolls at the elite Apex Academy. There the rare and formidable White Wolf bloodline sleeping within her comes awake. Aided by Killian, the reserved Frost heir, she overcomes challengers, exposes Vaelen's sinister scheme that feeds on the blood power of wolfkin, and saves her father. Together with Killian, she works to forge a new order in which no one must kneel for power.

titles.title: The Naive Bride's Sweet yet Wild Love
titles.titleEn: The Naive Bride's Sweet yet Wild Love
titles.description: Maria, head of Brown Corp, was betrayed and left for dead by her own family. She survived but lost her memory, regaining it only after being rescued by Anderson, a man who appears frail yet possesses quiet strength. As the two fell in love, the Anderson family and Victoria schemed against them. When Maria's memory returned during a moment of crisis, the truth of her betrayal came flooding back. Determined to seek justice, she faced the chaos ahead, and their bond deepened through every trial.

titles.title: After understanding the mice's speech, I became a super detective
titles.titleEn: After understanding the mice's speech, I became a super detective
titles.description: Buried under a mountain of student debt, Fiona suddenly gains the ability to comprehend the speech of rats, flies, and cockroaches. What begins as a strange gift soon pulls her into a murder case unfolding right next door, and the trail of whispers points toward Theodore, a billionaire heir who is also a serial killer. Relying on a covert crew of tiny informants, she has to outmaneuver a man whose wealth and power make him nearly untouchable, all while racing to avoid becoming his next target.

titles.title: The Mafia Boss Made Me His Maid
titles.titleEn: The Mafia Boss Made Me His Maid
titles.description: Elena, a gifted young scientist, finds her life upended when she is seized by Riccardo Bellini, a merciless mafia boss, to settle a debt owed by her brother. Held in his mansion and forced to serve as his maid against her will, she clings to the goal of breaking free and rebuilding the future she fought for. Yet with rivals circling and a lethal plot endangering Riccardo's criminal empire, the boundary between captor and guardian starts to fade. Torn between the life she lost and the perilous man who won't release her, Elena faces a choice: whether to risk everything she once wanted for love. In a realm of power, treachery, and fixation, freedom could demand the ultimate cost.

titles.title: The Lost Heiress They Cherish
titles.description: Ye Sheng comes home to the Ye family as the daughter they lost years ago, only to face constant provocation from Ye Yuqian, the adopted sister. Along the way she develops feelings for Qin Wuwang, not realizing he is the very man she has been betrothed to by arrangement, and each of them is looking for a way out of that engagement. As she gradually earns the affection of her parents and her five brothers, Qin Wuwang ends up proposing to her.

titles.title: The Doctor Mother-in-Law
titles.description: Helen awakens in a feudal era, finding herself inside a family on the verge of collapse. Armed with modern medical knowledge and little tolerance for convention, she sets out to change her circumstances. She prevents her granddaughter from being sold, locates relatives who have been lost, and lifts the Stones out of poverty. Her efforts extend further: she establishes a clinic, advocates for women's rights, and challenges the rules that obstruct her. Together the Stones endure betrayal and resistance, rising from outcasts to legends, from mere survival to celebration. Yet in a society wary of change, the durability of their revolution remains uncertain.

titles.title: Possession Is Not Love
titles.description: Claire Shaw and Adrian Stone entered a marriage of convenience, keeping their union hidden for four years. Everything shifts when Adrian's first love reappears, prompting Claire to seek a divorce—only to learn she is expecting a child. As jealousy and miscommunication mount between them, Adrian comes to understand that what he felt was not obsession but genuine love. The question remains whether he can reach Claire before he loses her for good.

titles.title: Forgive? No Mercy
titles.description: Ethan has walked in on his wife Claire Whitmore with his foster brother ninety-nine times. In a previous life, he let fury take over and exposed their affair, which cost him his marriage, his child, his family, and eventually his life, dying penniless of cancer. Given another chance on that same day, he chooses the opposite path and simply leaves. To him, love means nothing now; money is what counts. Yet Noah and his own mother are counting on him to lose control, so they bring back a woman from his past to set him up once more. This time he intends to keep the child and the fortune, and offer no forgiveness.

titles.title: The Nobody Patch Notes
