titles.description: Born with no standing, Cole Hawke returns as a Hellwarden. He enters the Ascendant Legion’s trials and defeats Soul Beasts, humbling every gifted rival who stands against him. With each battle, realm, and war he endures, his power grows. Before long, the same world that once laughed at him will bow to the legend it unknowingly brought into being. For those who want to follow this series, its episodes can be watched on Dramzio.

titles.title: Leah Qi's High School
titles.description: When a girls' boarding school reopens its doors after being abandoned for three years, newcomer Leah Qi sets her sights on leading group 316. Yet her real identity carries secrets she never expected.

titles.title: Vengeance of A Reborn Hostess
titles.description: Betrayed by the very family she had served for years, a woman who devoted herself to running the household and raising the children meets a bitter end. Yet death is not the finish: she wakes to find herself reborn on the very day she first took the boy in. Armed with the knowledge of what is to come, she resolves to stop sacrificing herself for others and to set a plan of revenge in motion. Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Seductive Black Rabbit
titles.description: The Seductive Black Rabbit is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold gradually. Viewers can discover its world and follow the drama as it develops. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Unloved Wife, Unstoppable Heiress
titles.description: For three years Kinan has lived a double life: secretly married to Bagas while presenting herself to the world as his secretary. Bagas carries on an affair with his ex, Kayra. After Kinan survives an accident, she ends the marriage and learns that she is the granddaughter of Sugi, a billionaire. She comes back as the heir, determined to take revenge. By then Bagas's regret arrives too late.

titles.title: Go Ahead, Ghouls, Hit Me
titles.description: An office worker drowning in debt is attacked by a ghoul, yet instead of perishing he gains a system that turns every injury from a ghoul into added strength. His guiding principle shifts from working harder to begging for harder hits. A raise arrives from his boss, power arrives from the ghouls, and the pain itself begins to appeal to him.

titles.title: Married a CEO, Reclaimed My Legacy
titles.titleEn: Married a CEO, Reclaimed My Legacy
titles.description: After being cast aside by his ex, Nathan finds himself suddenly married to Claudia, a striking CEO who is escaping her own arranged union with the womanizing Lex Norrington. Through Claudia's support, Nathan discovers that he is in fact the Norrington family's long-lost legitimate heir. Thrust into a battle over the inheritance, he stuns everyone by revealing himself as Cipher, a brilliant AI mind, while piecing together the truth of the past that was taken from him.

titles.title: His Only Exception
titles.description: Sylvia finds herself pushed into a marriage devoid of affection, treated more as a bargaining chip than a person. What she never anticipated was ending up in the embrace of the very man who wields power from behind the scenes. Certain indulgences are meant to stay off-limits, particularly once they begin to resemble genuine love.

titles.title: Portable Space Activated: From Humiliation to Total Domination
titles.titleEn: Portable Space Activated: From Humiliation to Total Domination
titles.description: Trisha Greer finds herself inhabiting the role of the most reviled military spouse in a story, with a husband who cannot stand her. The source material ends there, leaving the rest of her journey unexplored. Those wanting to follow how this premise develops can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Love Strikes the Stoic Mogul
titles.description: To fund treatment for her sick sister, Alena Spike made a desperate choice: she sold her virginity to a man she did not know, Jeffrey York. A year passes before their paths cross again at a gathering, where he recognizes her and leaves her shaken. Her suitor, Justin Standish, then reveals that Jeffrey is the only person who holds the cure her sister needs. Though Jeffrey resists, Alena pleads with him for the medicine, all while dreading that he might drag her back to the night she wants to forget. Follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Lucky Star in the Village
titles.description: Stella is left in the care of the Lang family by her parents, but she is treated badly there and eventually cast out. Her gentle nature and the good fortune that seems to follow her then bring her to the Johnson family, who welcome her into their home. Supported by the affection of this new family, Stella faces down the hardships in her path, finds her way back to her birth parents, and ends up offering fresh hope to the family she has found. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: [Dubbed]The Substitute Heart
titles.description: Following the end of a past relationship, Sienna turns to Adam—a man who closely resembles her former partner—and marries him largely as a way to cope emotionally. Three years into the arrangement, she decides to walk away, determined to rebuild her own identity and professional path. It is only after she is gone that Adam, a detached and strategic CEO, comes to understand that his feelings for her had deepened into love well before she left.

titles.title: Disguised as a Rogue:Marked by the Lycan King
titles.titleEn: Disguised as a Rogue:Marked by the Lycan King
titles.description: Five years back, Zephyrine suppressed her true nature for Nyroth, joining his pack only to be treated as an outcast. After enduring countless seasons of contempt, she finally broke their bond when his former love reappeared. Destiny then brought her to Lycannar Blood, a cursed king whose deadly Eye of Death proved powerless against her. Two wounded souls found each other, and she took up her weapon once more. But plots, remorse, and royal bloodlines threaten to unravel everything.

titles.title: The Bewitching Wine
titles.description: Zhong Ajiao, considered unattractive, is the one who makes the highly valued wine, while her beautiful twin sister Zhong Ahui handles the customers. After drinking some of Ajiao's wine, Ahui loses consciousness and later wakes up with bruises and pain across her body. Her boyfriend, Qiao Yuan, then goes to confront Ajiao, yet once he too has tasted the wine, he ends his relationship with Ahui. Left confused and hurt, Ahui sets out to discover the truth behind these strange events.

titles.title: Falling for My Tomboy Alpha Roommate
titles.titleEn: Falling for My Tomboy Alpha Roommate
titles.description: Linnea, a princess of the Silver Moon clan, is determined to avoid a forced marriage. Her solution is to ask Riley, her tomboy roommate, to pose as her mate. The two begin on hostile terms, bickering and provoking one another at every turn. Yet as Riley shields and looks after her, the pretense gradually gives way to genuine feeling. What Linnea remains unaware of is that Riley is both her destined mate and the Alpha of the Night Wolf Pack, the very family her own clan has sworn to oppose.

titles.title: The Basement Door
titles.description: A single mother and her seven-year-old daughter take up residence in an aging Victorian mansion, where one instruction governs their new life: the basement door must stay shut. Over time, they come to understand that the warning was never about protecting them from what lies below. The door exists to hold something else in.

titles.title: My Wives Are She-Demons

During his imprisonment, he learns extraordinary kung fu from a reclusive master. Once released, he waits patiently while planning his revenge. Armed with formidable skills, he defeats his adversaries, brings the truth to light, and forces everyone who dismissed him to regret it, ultimately establishing himself as a king.

Her path becomes entangled with this enigmatic pontiff as she navigates loss, coercion, and the fight to reclaim what is rightfully hers. Working together with Margaret, their partial mother, Ada further intends to sell Elena to a cruel lord. The story follows this conspiracy against Elena as it unfolds. titles.title: The Untamed Queen of Nine Beasts
titles.titleEn: The Untamed Queen of Nine Beasts
titles.description: In the Therian Empire, Emma—transported from Earth—awakens dual lightning and water abilities and ends up with nine alpha therian mates. Because of her lowly origins, she is looked down upon, so she takes the payouts from their breakups and devotes herself to hunting beasts in order to gain strength. The same haughty lords who cast her aside soon find themselves consumed by regret, hurrying to win back the fearless queen they had once left behind.

titles.title: My Beast Mates' Billion-Dollar Mistake
titles.description: After enduring years of savage monster hunts across the Therian Empire, Emma finally finds herself matched to arrogant beast lords—who promptly demand a divorce. Rather than plead with them, she takes their enormous buyout payments and leaves without looking back. What they fail to grasp is that Emma is far from a fragile human; she carries a deadly power kept carefully hidden. When that strength at last breaks free, the same men who discarded her come to see their rejection as the gravest error they have ever made, and they are prepared to go to any lengths to reclaim her.

titles.title: (Dubbed)The Most Beautiful Mom
titles.description: Grace Reed, a mother who was not considered beautiful, struggled to bring up her two sons. When her younger boy, Lorenzo Slater, fell into the water by accident, her elder son Xavier Slater turned his back on her, choosing instead to marry into a wealthy family. Lorenzo survived, however, and grew up to become a CEO. He finds his mother again and ensures that everyone who mistreated her faces the consequences. Grace's own warmth and decency eventually win her the affection and esteem of those around her.

titles.title: Thor：Thunder Returns
titles.description: Two decades after the Abyss brought ruin to the world, Mjölnir fell from the sky and gave humanity divine runes, letting them command thunder to protect the mortal realm. Iven was born in that storm, but the rune destined for him was taken by his uncle and given to his cousin. Twenty years on, Iven answers the call of the Trial of Thunder, yet without his rune he is treated as incomplete. His scars are mocked, his claim rejected, while his cousin, who stole his power, is hailed as the rightful heir of thunder and even uses that might to judge Iven and his family. When the Abyss breaks the seal, Iven regains his memories and awakens Thor's true name. Those who worshipped and wielded the thunder then grasp that its authority and protection had always belonged to the man they dismissed as bro

titles.title: Battle for the House

titles.title: Second Chance with My Secret Lover
titles.titleEn: Second Chance with My Secret Lover
titles.description:

Everything fell apart when Michael became engaged and pushed her aside. At the same time, she received a devastating diagnosis: advanced heart failure, leaving her just three months to live.

Emma wants nothing more than to slip away quietly and spend her remaining days in peace. That wish is quickly shattered. Michael's fiancée, a scheming suitor named Ashton Wills, a protective figure known as Mr. X, and her former boyfriend all re-enter her life one after another, pulling her into a perilous storm of romance, treachery, and buried secrets. titles.title: System Alert: Catastrophic Slime

Whether he can reverse his fortunes becomes the central question.

titles.title: Web of Deceit

A trama acompanha esse conflito entre a busca por cuidados adequados e as intervenções do sogro, cujas soluções trazem consequências fatais. A série pode ser acompanhada no Dramzio.

titles.title: Mom-in-Law Fought For Me
titles.description: When her husband let his assistant's disrespect go unchallenged, his wife found an unexpected ally in her mother-in-law, who defended her without hesitation. Armed with shares and evidence, she brought the pair's misconduct into the open, then divorced her husband. She went on to secure full custody of her son and take back both her company and her dignity.

titles.title: Office Romance [Portuguese] (2026)
titles.description: Jackie, who serves as President and CEO of Air Cruz, is known for running her company with strict discipline. titles.title: The Forbidden Love Of Young Master He

In the present, Shen Xingzhi sets aside Liu Xiyin's fatal heart ailment and decides to go after Meng Ying, who has come back from abroad. What follows is an inescapable tragedy of a husband's pursuit ending in ruin.

titles.title: Medical God, Martial King

Those interested in following this series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Witness to an Ancient Empire I
titles.titleEn: Witness to an Ancient Empire I
titles.description: Li Qing is transported back to the early Ming dynasty, where he becomes an apprentice to Zhang Lata. After his master flees, Li Qing is called upon to treat Empress Ma. Across the reigns from Hongwu to Renxuan, he serves as an Imperial Guard and Grand Secretary and forms friendships with Wang Yangming and Tang Bohu, living as a figure whom history has forgotten.

titles.title: Threads of Destiny
titles.description: A skilled but reclusive embroiderer named Zhou Chuxi suffers memory loss while protecting her country. Once she is saved and encouraged to start again, she returns to her needlework, faces down determined competitors, and, with the backing of Gu Hansheng, the man she loves, takes first place in a major contest. When the new year arrives, the two commit themselves to safeguarding their relationship as well as the centuries-old tradition of embroidery.

titles.title: Bleeding Spring
titles.description: Van True het in sy vorige lewe vir Rosalind Shane liefde gevoel, maar sy het hom verraai. Die reeks se episodes kan op Dramzio gevolg word.

Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: (Dubbed)A Broken Blade Still Kills
titles.description: För tio år sedan räddade Eliot Howard, äldste sonen i familjen Howard, ett begåvat föräldralöst barn vid namn Jacob – ett beslut som skulle komma att förstöra hans liv. Jacob tog över familjens kärlek, högg av honom armen och såg till att han blev anklagad för mord, vilket ledde till tio år i fångenskap. Till och med hans trolovade svek honom, och Eliot sökte sig då till Solar Sect. Tre år senare återvänder han som dess nya ledare, precis när familjen Howard står på randen till undergång. titles.title: The Dragonlord's Twin Cubs
titles.description: Framed by classmates, Elowen is thrown into a dragon's lair and spends one night with Dragon Lord Orion, bearing his twins. Six years later, she takes a job at his estate to pay for their surgery, only to discover he's their father. As enemies strike, her Dragon Queen blood awakens, uniting their family for a wedding—and a third dragon baby.

titles.title: Road Trip (2000)
titles.description: Four college friends set out on a road trip after an incriminating tape is accidentally sent to a female friend, and they need to get it back before any damage is done. The journey becomes the driving force of the story as the group travels together with that urgent errand hanging over them. Road Trip (2000) follows this premise of a trip sparked by a mailing mistake and the friends' attempt to recover the tape. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Cleaner Is Actually a Billionaire!
titles.titleEn: The Cleaner Is Actually a Billionaire!
titles.description: A billionaire CEO disguises herself as a market cleaner to assist vendors who are struggling. That proves to be a serious mistake, and her patience for being kind runs out. Having betrayed the one person capable of bringing about his downfall, he faces the consequences of his actions.

titles.title: Fired, But Her Skills Hired Her Back
titles.titleEn: Fired, But Her Skills Hired Her Back
titles.description: Veteran worker Angelina climbs from scavenging to becoming an industry hero. Her long-overlooked skills, once forgotten, now earn global respect and drive a powerful comeback.

titles.title: My Thoughts Are Louder Than Your Schemes
titles.titleEn: My Thoughts Are Louder Than Your Schemes
titles.description: Wendy Trent lost everything in her previous life: Holly Trent, the false heiress, framed her, those around her turned against her, her family fell into ruin, and she ended up drowning in the sea. Given a second chance, she returns to the moment before the Trent family acknowledges her and resolves to rewrite her destiny—only to discover that her relatives can now hear what she is thinking. Drawing on what she remembers from her earlier life, she strikes back at Holly one move at a time, gradually stripping away her pretenses and revealing who she really is, while also finding love along the way.

titles.title: My Boyfriend Can’t Know I’m a Mermaid
titles.titleEn: My Boyfriend Can’t Know I’m a Mermaid
titles.description: Marina faces a deadline: without a kiss from her true love, she will dissolve into sea foam in thirty days. She sacrificed her tail for Damien, yet by day twenty-seven he still hasn't kissed her. Instead, he kisses another woman and hands over Marina's soul-scale to Vanessa as a necklace, along with her heart-pearl—the only route back to the sea—as an anklet. Marina retrieves what was taken. On opening night, she clears out every case of his stolen jewels, recovering the tide-bracelet, the soul-scale, and the life she had stolen from death on his behalf. Damien turns to white foam and is carried off by the tide. Eli, who surrendered his voice to find her, speaks again with the words: "Welcome home."

titles.title: Fake It Till You Love Me
titles.titleEn: Fake It Till You Love Me
titles.description: Orphaned Sylvia and Evelyn devise a scheme: they will pass themselves off as stand-ins for a "First Love" in order to get inside the Mitchell family. As part of the plan, the delicate yet fierce Sylvia becomes the wife of Jasper Mitchell, heir to Mitchell Group. What begins as a marriage of convenience soon turns into a volatile mix of hidden truths and mutual attraction. The arrangement starts to fall apart when the genuine "First Love" reappears and the deception is exposed. Sylvia then realizes that Jasper was the boy she admired in high school, and that his feelings for her have grown genuine as well. Against a backdrop of peril and treachery, the pretended romance develops into real love.

titles.title: Passion's Dangerous Dance
titles.description: One night of passion with Ethan Duncan is meant to stay in the past, a fleeting encounter she resolves to put behind her. Yet Ethan refuses to let her disappear, and when he finds her again, the truth lands like a blow: he is her fiancé's uncle. Complicating matters further, she is pregnant with his child. Desire reignites, hidden truths come to light, and what began as a forbidden attraction swells into a turbulent mix of love and obsession.

titles.title: Ice Was Coming, I Built My Safehouse(Dubbed)
titles.titleEn: Ice Was Coming, I Built My Safehouse(Dubbed)

titles.title: Code Queen

Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: I Can Hear the Dragon Cub's Thoughts
titles.titleEn: I Can Hear the Dragon Cub's Thoughts
titles.description: After nurse Ella loses her life while saving an infant, she awakens on a dragon continent as a collared slave. At a selection event, those who are chosen survive while the cage claims the rest. Her sister Vivian is carried off by a gold dragon.

titles.title: Cursed Mate ng Alpha
titles.description: Lila is rescued from werewolves by a guardian, who reveals that she is the daughter of the Serpent Queen. Together with Marcus, her fated mate, she takes on the Council and fights back against those pursuing her.

titles.title: The Wolfless Alpha Queen
titles.description: Thirteen years back, a betrayal shattered the Bloodwolf Clan. Its rightful princess, then only a child, was abandoned in the wilderness and forgot everything about her origins. Now nineteen, she suddenly awakens the immense Progenitor's Power. When she comes back, she discovers her mother has been tortured and her father left paralyzed, while the traitors work hand in hand with an enemy to bring the clan down from within. Can the true-born princess take back her throne and rescue her people?

titles.title: The Master Chef... But He Can't Taste?
titles.titleEn: The Master Chef... But He Can't Taste?
titles.description: Noah was once celebrated as a Master Chef, but losing his sense of taste pushed him into a quiet, unremarkable existence. That changes when a merciless businessman sets his sights on the restaurant and the people it protects. To defend it, Noah has to step back into the role he lost. Without a working palate, he can depend only on years of training and the passion that never left him. As time runs short, the question is whether he can save what matters most to him and rise once more to the stature he once held.

titles.title: I Bought the Deadliest Dragon Slave
titles.titleEn: I Bought the Deadliest Dragon Slave
titles.description: Betrayed when the man she loved tore out her heart to save another woman, she awakens reborn at the very underground auction where her fate once turned. This time she leaves the crippled former Dragon King to her sister and instead purchases the silent black killing machine. For forty-nine days the fallen king kneels and begs for her heart's blood, but she gives him demon chicken blood instead. Her new dragon kills him in the arena, takes the throne, and becomes her feral, unhinged king, devoted only to worshipping her. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Stepson I Shouldn’t Want
titles.description: Erin, twenty-eight, endures a loveless marriage to the wealthy Arthur. The arrival of his defiant son Jett sets off a dangerous attraction: Jett initially pursues her as payback, yet the affair soon becomes genuine. Meanwhile, Arthur plots to incriminate Erin and take control of her family's wealth. Together, Erin and Jett expose his plan and bring him down by exploiting a gap in the family trust.

titles.title: Stock Queen
titles.description: Riko, ett geni inom trading som utvecklade kärnsystemet NOIR CLAW åt Washida Securities, avskedas orättvist av Washida – den illvillige vd:n som styr företaget med hård hand, med hjälp av en falsk utvecklare. Riko, som känner sig förfördelad, går till Shinsung Securities, ett bolag som köpts av miljonären Kasimiro Ken, och sjösätter en utstuderad hämndplan för att krossa det korrupta Washida Securities. Serien och dess avsnitt kan följas på Dramzio.

titles.title: Miss Schemer vs. Mr. CEO
titles.description: Two best friends—one struggling financially, the other having lost her wealth—decide to take on the city's wealthiest man and a cruel stepmother. Bella relies on every scheme she can devise, setting off a bold contest built on cleverness and danger. As the tension grows and romantic feelings become tangled, the question becomes whether her intelligence can carry her through the ultimate struggle for power and keep her alive.

titles.title: Wrong Devotion Took My Kids, I Severed This Doomed Bond
titles.titleEn: Wrong Devotion Took My Kids, I Severed This Doomed Bond
titles.description: For a decade, Valentina Cross has loved Everett Whitlock, and for five of those years she has been secretly married to him, giving him all her devotion. Yet her loyalty is met with deceit and cruelty. Everett’s heart belongs to Elara, Valentina’s closest friend, and when Elara’s son Theo falls ill, Everett makes a devastating choice: he gives up his and Valentina’s twins to save the other boy. The betrayal shatters the bond she once treasured. Those who want to follow this story of love turned bitter can watch it on Dramzio.

titles.title: (Dubbed) From No. 1 Slacker to Dragon Lord!
titles.titleEn: (Dubbed) From No. 1 Slacker to Dragon Lord!

Armed with a Devouring Evolution System and improbable good fortune, he climbs the ranks by consuming his way upward, transforming from a worthless fish into a dragon. Along the way he humbles those who worship bloodline purity, takes command of the banquet, and changes the destiny of the lake itself. Yet once the throne is within reach, the question remains whether a onetime slacker can finally admit he cares.

titles.title: The Luna Awakens, Severing Our Five-Year Mate Bond
titles.titleEn: The Luna Awakens, Severing Our Five-Year Mate Bond

Though he knows she is innocent, Damon still commands that the ritual fire be lit so that the pregnant Healer Chloe can take her place. Months of wolfsbane drugging, expulsion from her suite and false accusations drive Freya to despair, until she awakens the Silvermane silver wolf bloodline within her and brings the conspiracy to light.

titles.title: Divine Vase, My Family's Hope
titles.description: After being killed by betrayal, Lucas Hayes is reborn into a village suffering from famine. He comes into possession of the Miracle Flask, which gives him the means to change the fortunes of his family. The story follows his efforts to use this power to improve their lives and overcome the hardships they face. Those interested in the series can follow it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Bought by the Cold Billionaire Season 1
titles.titleEn: Bought by the Cold Billionaire Season 1
titles.description: Elena Rowan finds herself stuck in a place called Velvet Trap, where she strikes a bargain with Lucian Noir: her body in exchange for her freedom. Lucian keeps a tight hold over her, yet her heart still belongs to Julian Vane, the love she thought she had lost. When Julian reappears, Elena faces humiliation, betrayal, and the burden of her mother's illness. Lucian shields her even as his fixation grows more intense. Then Elena learns a startling truth—there are two Julians, and one of them is a fraud. She attempts to investigate, but Lucian brushes her concerns aside. Caught between the two men, Elena fights to break away and carve out a life of her own. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Awakening: No More Silence
titles.description: Abigail Mercer believed she was marrying Ethan Mercer for love, but her pregnancy became a season of relentless cruelty at the hands of his family. She endured their bullying without complaint, hoping to preserve harmony in the household. Once Ethan learned what was happening, he chose to stand with his wife and confront his mother and sister directly. Rather than backing down, the two women intensified their attacks, eventually directing their malice at Abigail's infant daughter. That final provocation shattered her patience, and she resolved to stop absorbing the abuse in silence.

titles.title: Is the General Really Impotent? Let My Cleavage Find Out
titles.titleEn: Is the General Really Impotent? Let My Cleavage Find Out
titles.description: Curvy maid Freya is discarded by her jealous mistress and handed over to Gunnar, the dreaded black serpent warlord. Battle lore holds that a poisoned arrow shattered his serpent core, leaving him impotent and near death. Their forced union starts in reluctance, but it soon exposes a startling secret: Gunnar's apparent frailty is a deliberate ploy to draw out traitors. With royal conspiracies tightening around them, Freya's concealed healing ability turns out to be his lifeline, and what began as a cold arrangement grows into fierce, enduring love.

titles.title: Becoming a Superstar Starts with Breakup
titles.titleEn: Becoming a Superstar Starts with Breakup
titles.description: After enduring 99 days of kneeling before his ex-wife, he gets a second chance at life and sets his sights on becoming a superstar. Confronted with many obstacles and openings, he takes part in "The Voice," composes songs on the spot during performances, and demonstrates his abilities at a distinguished family banquet. Meanwhile, his tangled ties with his ex-wife, his friends, and his competitors bring emotional weight and tension to his rise toward fame.

titles.title: I'm pregnant, it's not yours
titles.description: Iris's husband has always favored his secretary, a woman who resembles his idealized first love, leaving his wife in the background. Rather than fight for his attention, Iris quietly files for divorce and drops a bombshell: the child she is expecting belongs to another man. Five years on, she comes back with real influence and a new partner at her side, while her ex-husband finds himself consumed by remorse over what he lost.

titles.title: Marry the Hidden Pirate King
titles.description: Penniless after being betrayed by the fiancé she sailed across an ocean to wed, Isabelle agrees to a whirlwind marriage with Lucian, the enigmatic sailor she has just rescued. What she does not realize is that her new husband is actually Lord Drak.

titles.title: Madam Gu Is Playing Dumb Again
titles.titleEn: Madam Gu Is Playing Dumb Again
titles.description: Five years after a fire killed her whole family and left her closest friend mentally shattered, she has spent that time pretending to be foolish and unhinged. Her deception eventually gains her entry into the Gu household through marriage, where she serves as a walking blood supply for the family's sickly young master. Behind this act, she is quietly investigating what really happened on the day of the fire and hunting down the person responsible, determined to settle the score. Madam Gu Is Playing Dumb Again can be followed on Dramzio.
genres: Pretending to be weak to deceive others

titles.title: Shoot Your Heart
titles.description: Five years back, Darren lost his sister because she didn't receive treatment within the critical first hour, and he himself was hurt while attempting to shield her. Frances, carrying guilt and expecting a child, walked away. Now, half a decade later, she works as an assistant to a reporter and raises her child alone. When a well-known celebrity comes back to town, she poses as his spouse to slip into a hotel. Yet at her most desperate point, she runs into the very person she hoped never to face again. She attempts to flee, but fate keeps pulling them together. Will Darren discover the child they share?

titles.title: The Day I Was Cast Out, My Powers Awakened
titles.titleEn: The Day I Was Cast Out, My Powers Awakened

Olivia then takes her in and gives her the affection she had been denied. At school, she must contend with privileged and hostile classmates. After someone sabotages her, Serena walks onto the stage carrying a trumpet. The solo she performs leaves the entire hall in stunned silence, showing that she had never truly been shattered.

titles.title: Math Prodigy from Nowhere

With the support and mentorship of her teacher Zhang Zhenzhong, she confronts the barriers and prejudice standing in her way. Her perseverance ultimately carries her to victory at an international mathematics Olympiad, where she proves her ability, gains the respect she was denied, and transforms the future for herself and her family. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.description: A young man takes a new job and enters into a contract relationship with a young woman there, a pretend romance that gradually turns into genuine love. Their bond faces obstacles along the way, and everything changes when his hidden identity comes to light.

titles.description: Ann Stone and Caleb Zane were childhood sweethearts who married at a young age. Their relationship is tested when her career falls apart and the strain of a long-distance arrangement sets in. The story follows the couple as they confront the fallout from these pressures and reckon with what remains between them. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Oops! Grandpa's the Godfather, Daddy's a Billionaire
titles.titleEn: Oops! Grandpa's the Godfather, Daddy's a Billionaire
titles.description: When the granddaughter of a mafia godfather, GiGi, travels to New York, her goal is to rescue her biological father, Logan, a former tech genius left homeless and without legs. After pulling him out of his predicament, she equips him with an exoskeleton, and together with the godfather's forces they take down the villain Richard and recover the company that was taken from them. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Merlin's Last Heir: The Broken Covenant
titles.titleEn: Merlin's Last Heir: The Broken Covenant
titles.description: Elara Pendragon, Merlin's final descendant, wakes after a hundred years of magical slumber to discover that the wealthy old dynasties have broken the blood oath on which their fortunes were founded. Accompanied by her devoted steward, she takes back the Philosopher's Stone that was stolen from her, deals out consequences to those who proved disloyal, and presents the next generation with a stark decision: submit, obey, or pay what magic demands.

titles.title: Scarlet Throne
titles.description: Betrayed by his fiancée Ivy Young, Imperial Heir Mason Shaw barely survives, reduced to life as a beggar. In that lowest state he crosses paths with Zoe Stone, a courtesan whose past is shrouded in mystery. The two draw closer, and through her Mason begins to see the shape of a conspiracy that reaches to his own brother, Miles Shaw, and to foreign allies working alongside him. With Zoe at his side, Mason sets out to win back his throne and to clear the name of her father. Yet the more secrets come to light, the harder their bond of love and loyalty is pressed, leaving open whether they can overcome the betrayal and deceit around them and build a future together.

titles.title: He Faked Illness To Betray Me
titles.titleEn: He Faked Illness To Betray Me
titles.description: For three years, Ava thought her husband was dying—a slow decline she blamed on the sacrifice he made to save her father. As her family pleaded for help on Brooklyn's frozen streets, she drained every dollar she had to keep him alive. Then, on a snowy night, a tracking chip led her to a penthouse where she found him in perfect health, entangled with another woman and mocking how simple she had been to deceive. Yet the con man slipped up in one reckless way: he picked the wrong woman to cross.

titles.title: Needle's Vengeance
titles.description: Tattoo artist Ava Carter endures a decade of betrayal in her marriage to billionaire Ethan Blackwell. The breaking point comes when his pregnant mistress, Jessica, takes control of Ava’s tattoo studio, and Ava then loses both her unborn child and her grandmother in quick succession. She walks away from it all, wins top prize at an international tattoo expo, and goes on to build a successful career. Ethan eventually comes to regret his actions deeply, but by then Ava has moved on for good.

titles.title: Road of Lust
titles.description: Every jolt of the car sent my eighteen-year-old stepson's hand creeping further beneath my skirt, and I sank my teeth into the blanket to stay silent. My fifty-year-old husband sat just ahead, driving as though nothing were happening. Had I foreseen what that backseat would turn into during our road trip, I would have taken the secret to my grave. Viewers can follow this story on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Affair at CAMP
titles.description: Ritsu n’aurait jamais pensé que son mari se servirait d’un séjour de camping en famille pour dissimuler une liaison. C’est en repérant des dépenses suspectes sur le compte bancaire de celui-ci qu’elle commence à douter. Sans rien dire, elle le suit à la trace grâce au GPS et le retrouve au camping, où elle le surprend en compagnie d’une autre femme. Dès lors, une question demeure : comment Ritsu fera-t-elle payer l’homme qui a trahi sa confiance et brisé l’équilibre de leur famille ? Les péripéties de cette série peuvent être suivies sur Dramzio.

titles.title: Regret's Bitter Harvest（Dubbed）
titles.description: Natalie saves Caleb and breaks her leg in the process, yet as his wife she is misunderstood and made to suffer deeply. With Aaron's support, she starts taking her revenge. Caleb comes to see his error only after it is too late; Natalie builds a life with Aaron, while Caleb remains by himself, eaten up by regret. The story deals with love, betrayal and vengeance. Regret's Bitter Harvest can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Framed God: Heavens’ Deadly Conspiracy
titles.description: When a celestial lord collapses dead during the peach banquet, a young warrior becomes the prime suspect in Heaven's first murder. Pursued across the three realms, he seeks refuge with the Monkey King, and together they embark on a perilous search for the truth. Each new clue reveals an ancient and concealed horror lurking beneath the surface. As the accused transforms into the sole hope against this threat, the question becomes whether one rebel can alter the destiny of all creation.

titles.title: Rejected but Chosen: The True Alpha's Mark
titles.titleEn: Rejected but Chosen: The True Alpha's Mark
titles.description: Tristan, an arrogant heir, brings about a conflict beyond his control when he rejects Vesella, the mate fate chose for him. She goes on to become the fearless Alpha of Silver Crest, overcoming those who stand against her. Her strength draws Kaelen, Tristan's honorable brother, who proves to be her genuine second-chance mate. Together they navigate love, treachery, and lingering conspiracies, eventually forming a new family—only for their adopted son, Leo, to be taken by their foes. Those wanting to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Daddy's Little Secret
titles.description: Chloe agreed to act as a surrogate for Alexander, a powerful underworld figure, in a desperate attempt to save her dying father. After the child was born, she was compelled to disappear. She later comes back under a changed appearance and a new identity, taking a job as a housekeeper so she can remain near her daughter. Alexander grows suspicious that she is hiding something and begins testing her, while the child forms an instinctive bond with her, gradually drawing Chloe toward embracing her role as a mother.

titles.title: After My Diagnosis, I Made the Scumbag's Family Pay
titles.titleEn: After My Diagnosis, I Made the Scumbag's Family Pay
titles.description: Lu Xiaomei sells stinky tofu from a street stall near her daughter's school to supplement the family income, yet her daughter treats her with contempt. The strain and resentment overwhelm her, and after fainting she learns she has advanced breast cancer. At home her mother-in-law and brother-in-law dictate her every move, and her husband is carrying on an affair with a neighbor. A quarrel with her in-laws sends her back to her parents, where her own mother berates her instead of offering comfort. Close to taking her own life, she is rescued by Xu Lingchen, an old classmate. She spends the night at his place, and when he brings her home the next day, her mother-in-law spots them. Seeing her in a man's clothes, her husband accuses her of infidelity and rains insults on her. Remembering how e

titles.title: One Night Had Hades Begging for More
titles.titleEn: One Night Had Hades Begging for More
titles.description: A single forbidden night with Hades leaves Persephone pregnant and carrying his stolen death essence. Enraged, Demeter hands the child over to Hades, strips Persephone of her memories and powers, and banishes her to the mortal realm. Years pass before Hades tracks her down, only to discover she now lives an unremarkable life as a florist.

titles.title: The Blazing Heiress's Revenge
titles.description: Reborn with fierce determination, Xia Ye—formerly a pampered heiress whose life was shattered by betrayal—works her way into the world of the very people who brought down her family. Climbing steadily through their ranks, she becomes the chief assistant, outmaneuvering her rivals along the way while unearthing hidden and dangerous secrets.

titles.title: I Planted Grapes — And My Entire Family Wept Bitterly With Regret!
titles.titleEn: I Planted Grapes — And My Entire Family Wept Bitterly With Regret!
titles.description: For three years Ethan managed his stepbrother’s vineyard, generating $5 million in returns while being paid just $5,000 and dismissed as a pruner living on charity. He then took out a lease on the abandoned Devil’s Ridge. When his stepbrother’s careless over-production destroyed the vines, Ethan’s restoration of the old plants produced the finest grapes in the region.

titles.title: One Night of Power A Lifetime of Foes
titles.titleEn: One Night of Power A Lifetime of Foes
titles.description: Lucian wakes without warning into a world where rival factions see him as the ultimate prize. To stay alive, he must endure brutal trials and deadly encounters that test him at every turn. The story follows his struggle against forces determined to claim him for their own purposes. For those interested in following this series, Dramzio offers a place to watch it.

titles.title: We Never Moved On
titles.description: Seven years have passed since Emma and Erwin's breakup, which was never explained. Their paths cross again when Emma takes a teaching position for Erwin's sibling. Old feelings remain, yet Erwin keeps his distance, held back by the social divide between them. Haris, a rival, tries to destroy Erwin by getting him fired. Once Emma hears the full story from Erwin's mother, the decision about what comes next rests with Erwin. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Daughter-in-Law's Secret Killed Me—Now I'm Back
titles.titleEn: My Daughter-in-Law's Secret Killed Me—Now I'm Back
titles.description: My Daughter-in-Law's Secret Killed Me—Now I'm Back is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold gradually. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Heiress Returns to Teach a Lesson
titles.titleEn: The Heiress Returns to Teach a Lesson
titles.description: Betrayed in a previous life in a way that brought her family to ruin, the heroine is reborn with a resolve to take back everything that was once hers. The story follows her return and her determination to reclaim what belongs to her. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Doomsday Harem System: Kiss, Spank, Level Up
titles.titleEn: Doomsday Harem System: Kiss, Spank, Level Up
titles.description: In a world facing doomsday, one man gains a harem system that lets him grow stronger through intimate actions like kissing and spanking, turning each encounter into a path to leveling up.

titles.title: Lethal Vows: Married to My Rival
titles.titleEn: Lethal Vows: Married to My Rival
titles.description: Betrayed and sold into a black-market arena on the very day she planned to retire, top assassin Elena finds an unexpected rescuer in Dominic, a mafia boss. The two strike a six-month agreement, binding the skilled killer to the man whose world operates on the opposite side of the law she once served. What begins as a pragmatic arrangement between two dangerous figures soon complicates as their alliance deepens.

titles.title: Daddy Makeover Vom Playboy zum Imperator
titles.titleEn: Daddy Makeover Vom Playboy zum Imperator
titles.description: Betrayed by her own imperial relatives, Maisie met a bitter end. Given a second chance at life, she chooses the disgraced prince of Cael as her father. While the nobles mock the arrangement, she secretly trains him. Years later, the once-disgraced prince ascends the throne.

titles.title: Midnight Bus
titles.description: Night-shift bus driver Hannah has devoted a decade to a carefully concealed plan of vengeance, exploiting the rule against pregnant passengers as her pretext. She draws onto her bus the very people responsible for her sister's death, then stages a sequence of crises through illusion, pushing each of them to expose the selfishness beneath their surface. Once the police arrive, those who are guilty are brought to justice, and Hannah at last finds peace for her departed sister.

titles.title: The Tyrant's Sacrificial Bride
titles.description: The Tyrant's Sacrificial Bride is a series whose story, characters and episodes are best discovered directly. Followers can explore the unfolding narrative at their own pace. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Above All Immortals
titles.description: Following the war between immortals and demons, the Celestial Lord is reborn as a masseur named Jiang Yun. When the Demon Lord seizes his sister Jiang Meng, Jiang Yun sets out to rescue her. Doing so requires him to gather three artifacts—the Emperor Bone, the Soul Pearl, and the Sky Ruler—so that his dormant power can be reawakened. His path is further complicated when the Zhang family launches an attack against him.

titles.title: Careful, this Princess Bites!
titles.description: Princess Pearl was cast out on the very night of her birth, branded an Omen of Jinx. Eighteen years passed before she came back to settle the score. Her return brought down both the plotting Consort and the Crown Prince, yet a startling revelation awaited: Pearl was in fact the child of the true heir who had been murdered. Once the Emperor fell from power, she turned her back on the palace and chose a quiet existence with the one she loved. Dramzio is where this series can be followed.

titles.title: A Relationship Kept in The Dark
titles.titleEn: A Relationship Kept in The Dark
titles.description: Jane, a celebrated photographer, becomes romantically involved with Hector, a novice model, not knowing that he is the successor to a vast business empire. Hector conceals his background in order to earn her affection, yet envy and miscommunication eventually separate them. After Jane’s life unravels, Hector quietly intervenes to assist her, and he subsequently discloses who he really is through an elaborate declaration of love and a marriage proposal.

titles.title: The Ruthless Heiress and Her Broken King
titles.titleEn: The Ruthless Heiress and Her Broken King
titles.description: The world’s deadliest assassin is killed after being betrayed, only to wake up as Margaret, a maltreated heiress who has been handed over to a fight to the death. That proves to be a serious error. She slaughters everyone in her path to escape, then fixes her mismatched eyes on Andrew, a merciless billionaire bound to a wheelchair who commands terrifying, world-shattering abilities. Their shared instability pulls them into a deadly partnership. While Margaret exacts a violent reckoning on the upper classes, the king she sees as frail and broken stands prepared to destroy everything in order to shield his queen.

titles.title: My Husband Hears My Thoughts
titles.description: Reborn after her sisters drove her to her death, a woman now has the chance to choose a husband for herself. Her sisters eagerly compete for the same man, unaware that the success they enjoyed in their previous life had actually been her doing all along.

titles.title: Cat Unleashed: Ascension
titles.description: In a world overrun by monsters, high school senior Dustin Chaplin is publicly humiliated during his summoning ceremony when his girlfriend falsely accuses him, leading to his expulsion with only a low-grade F-rank Spectre Cat. Fate, however, has other plans: he awakens the Divine Beastmaster System and transforms the Spectre Cat into a mythical Essence Devourer of catastrophic power, one capable of effortlessly suppressing Country-Destroyers. His journey soon surpasses mere strength, as even the legendary Void Devourer bows to him as a guardian beast. Meanwhile, Anya Lyall, hailed by the alliance as the century's greatest prodigy, remains unaware that the "loser" she mocked now walks the path of world destruction. Yet Dustin's ambition reaches beyond dominance—his true goal is to ascend to

titles.title: The Dragon King Craves His Chubby Nanny
titles.titleEn: The Dragon King Craves His Chubby Nanny
titles.description: Ilara, a human nanny, takes a position at the Northern Dragon Palace caring for young dragon Rowan so she can afford treatment for her ailing daughter, Ivy. Her full figure draws mockery from the slender dragon-women around her, and she has no idea that she once nursed the gravely wounded Black Dragon King Kael back from the brink with her own breast milk in a forest during a storm. Kael lives under a curse that makes him flinch from any woman's touch—except Ilara's. Their forbidden bond deepens even as Red Dragon noble Rebecca and Elder Cassian conspire against them. Through body-shaming, false murder accusations and public trials, Kael eventually exposes Cassian's betrayal. In the same hall where Ilara was once humiliated, he kneels and proposes to her as his equal, and with Ivy at her s

titles.title: The Dragon Queen They Lost
titles.description: In the Solis Empire, where winter never ends, the sun can only be restored through a union between a princess of untainted royal lineage and the Abyss Dragon. Princess Diana spent a joyful childhood with her three brothers until Lorelei appeared. Wielding a stolen Dragon's scale, Lorelei took from Diana both the affection she was given and her place in the family. Fooled by the deception, the brothers turned against Diana and gave her up as an offering meant to kill the dragon. The truth only came to light once the dragon had already carried Diana away, and by that point nothing could be undone.

titles.title: Eliza Vance on the Run
titles.description: Eliza Vance has spent years working tirelessly, driven by both her own ambition and the hopes her parents placed in her. Her dedication pays off when she earns a place at the university she has long dreamed of attending, and the whole family shares in the joy and pride of that achievement. Yet the happiness proves short-lived. Just as Eliza is preparing to begin this new chapter, an earthquake strikes her remote mountain village without warning, shattering its calm and upending the future she had worked so hard to build. The series follows the consequences of that sudden turning point, and viewers can follow Eliza Vance on the Run on Dramzio.

titles.title: Spoiled by My CEO Hubby
titles.description: A single night with a CEO changed her life, though she chose to walk away and bring up their child by herself. Years afterward, a DNA test confirms that her son is the CEO's rightful heir. By then she has become the man's assistant, and she is pregnant with another child. Dramzio is where this series can be followed.

titles.title: The Masked Wolf Heir's Redemption
titles.description: Thorne has spent a decade posing as a worthless playboy, all while secretly investigating the circumstances behind his mother's death. As the heir to the Black Wolf Clan, he hides a formidable truth: he has been trained in secret as the legendary "Wolf God." His covert path leads him to rescue Lion Cl... Those following the series can find it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Leaving The Toxic Family Behind
titles.description: When she comes home for the holidays, a young woman learns of her father's hidden affair, and both she and her mother are thrown out of the house. Rather than collapse under the blow, the two choose to fight back. They confront uncaring relatives and build a large livestream business of their own, gradually taking back control of their lives. Along the way, she helps her mother discover a renewed sense of purpose and stumbles upon a secret that changes everything. In the end, the toxic father is left with nothing but regret.

titles.title: (Dubbed) Sweet Destiny with You
titles.description: Nicole Smith takes drastic measures to avoid the marriage her mother arranged for her: she spends a night with a man she does not know and leaves home, later discovering she is pregnant. Five years on, she is raising her son Danny Smith on her own and facing daily hardships. That is when Marcus Jansen enters her life and sets out to win her over. His childhood sweetheart, Zoey Reeves, is consumed by jealousy and repeatedly stirs up problems for them. Neither Nicole nor Marcus realizes that he is Danny's father, and Nicole's real identity conceals further revelations.

titles.title: Omega's Vow：Blood for Blood
titles.description:
For three years, Quinn Kane has kept her bond with Alexander Kane, the supreme Alpha of the Kane Pack, hidden from everyone. She conceals her mate mark under a collar, shielding herself from the pack's vicious political conflicts. When she at last becomes pregnant with the Alpha's child—something extraordinary for an Omega with her delicate scent—she hurries to Alexander's workplace with a lunch she made herself, eager to tell him the news.

She never makes it to his office. Olivia Reed, Alexander's merciless chief secretary, takes her for an Omega scheming to seduce the Alpha. Inside a soundproof conference room, Olivia inflicts horrifying werewolf brutality—broken bones, silver blades, and an execution carried out before employees who watch in silence. By the time Alexander realizes the

titles.title: I'm Actually the Demon Ancestor
titles.description: Ethan Blackwood finds himself transmigrated into a fantasy realm as the notorious Demon Ancestor at the very moment the righteous sects begin their crusade against him. Called upon to fight, he quickly realizes he has inherited none of the original Demon Ancestor's strength—he is entirely ordinary. With death closing in, Ethan relies on two things to survive: his acting ability to bluff his way through the ancestor's fearsome reputation, and, when that proves insufficient, the System that finally activates.

titles.title: Coaching His Heart
titles.description: A misunderstanding drives Kate and Tom apart after a single night together. A month later, their paths cross again when Kate takes a job as assistant coach for a men's hockey team and Tom arrives as its new captain. Working side by side forces them into constant proximity, and the attraction they never resolved starts to resurface. Kate, however, is carrying a secret she must keep hidden to protect her position: she is pregnant with Tom's child, and the truth, if it comes out, could upend everything between them.

titles.title: Blade Or Bride?
titles.description: En gravplundrare mördar en hel familj för att komma över en guldbegravningsdräkt. År senare gifter sig den överlevande sonen utan att veta sanningen med kvinnan som en gång högg honom – hennes ansikte har förändrats. När lögnerna till slut avslöjas drar han sitt svärd mot sin egen hustru. Tillsammans besegrar de sedan den verkliga fienden. Frågan som kvarstår är om ett äktenskap byggt på lögner någonsin kan förvandlas till kärlek. Serien och dess avsnitt kan följas på Dramzio.

titles.title: The Saltwater Clause
titles.description: Disgraced captain Nikolas sees his life collapse in a single night when his wife and cousin betray him. In one stroke he loses his marriage, his fleet, his license and his good name. Left drowning in debt and barred from the sea that defined him, he must find a way forward from the ruins of everything he once had. The series follows his struggle to rebuild after such a devastating fall. Viewers can follow The Saltwater Clause on Dramzio.

titles.title: Lihim na Pag-ibig: Swimming God Stepbrother Ko
titles.titleEn: Lihim na Pag-ibig: Swimming God Stepbrother Ko
titles.description: A transfer student named Noah juggles work to cover his mother's medical expenses, while constantly butting heads with Ethan, a gifted swimmer who happens to be his stepbrother. What begins as friction between the two gradually shifts into something deeper, and their bond grows as they confront abuse and the barriers created by class differences.

titles.title: My Pets Turn Into GODDESSES
titles.description: Mocked for a class others deemed worthless, he now finds himself surrounded by something far beyond ridicule. A stray cat on the verge of death has become a goddess of lightning. A wounded fox has transformed into a nine-tailed seductress. Every legendary creature he encounters shifts into a beautiful woman prepared to battle the world on his behalf. The ex who once dismissed him as worthless is about to witness what that word truly means when seen from the top. Those who want to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love
titles.titleEn: Heiress Returns: Boss's Defense and Love
titles.description: Wealthy beyond measure, Ava still finds herself betrayed by her husband's infidelity. Rather than tolerate the deception, she walks away and weds a man she barely knows. What she cannot yet see is that this impulsive match has delivered her something far more valuable than the marriage she abandoned.

titles.title: My Cold Boss Feels My Pain
titles.titleEn: My Cold Boss Feels My Pain
titles.description: Eliana is an optimistic, hardworking secretary whose life takes an odd turn when she becomes mysteriously connected to Orlando, her arrogant and emotionally distant CEO. Whatever pain or fatigue she endures is passed on to him, so while she keeps pushing through her job without complaint, he quietly bears the consequences. A secret marriage forces them to share a home, and their daily life together swings between comic mishaps and friction. Gradually, affection develops, the once-merciless boss becomes a caring partner, and Eliana learns the truth about her own family. A strange twist of fate thus grows into a tale of love, recovery, and finding where she belongs.

titles.title: Careful, I'm My Sister's Keeper!
titles.description: Shirley Ryder has her sights set on Ryan Anderson, the brother of her sister Yvonne's husband Zack, and her reason for pursuing him has nothing to do with romance. Marrying Ryan would simply allow her to remain near Yvonne. Trouble arises when Zack becomes entangled in a scandal, prompting Yvonne to weigh the possibility of divorce. She turns to Shirley to find out where she stands. Shirley's answer comes without a moment's doubt: should Yvonne walk away, she would do the same.

titles.title: The Little One Melted His Cold Heart
titles.titleEn: The Little One Melted His Cold Heart
titles.description: Nuonuo's life begins in hardship, and she is sent out to locate her father. Through a mix-up, she ends up clinging to the feared and merciless Third Master Feng, believing him to be the parent she seeks. Rather than turning her away as onlookers anticipate, Feng Mohan welcomes her into his care. Over time, Nuonuo's sweet and gentle nature softens his frozen heart.

titles.title: Awakened Legends: The Nation’s Duel
titles.description: When the Blue Star mutated, historical heroes were awakened around the world, and nations began settling their fates through battle. Kunzhou, a land with thousands of years of glorious history, had endured a century of humiliation and was close to ruin because its people had forgotten their past. In the final battle, the reborn Chen Yi steps forward, awakens heroes who had been forgotten, and shifts the course of the fight. He goes on to recover lost territories, uncover the truth behind the gap in history, and restore Kunzhou to its former glory.

titles.title: The CEO Hates to Love Me
titles.titleEn: The CEO Hates to Love Me
titles.description: Daphne gives birth to Simon’s child while she is in prison, then is forced to give the baby up in order to keep the child safe. Five years later, she and Simon cross paths again. Simon remains unaware that the child is his, while Daphne struggles to conceal the truth—though the secret is on the verge of coming out.

titles.title: The Woman Destined to Save the King
titles.titleEn: The Woman Destined to Save the King
titles.description: King Lee Hwon discovers that the poison threatening to end his life before he turns thirty can only be cured through a union with Yeonhwa, a Moon Maiden who bears a peach blossom mark on her collarbone. He installs her in the palace under the guise of a dancer, yet the arrangement soon reveals a harsh reality: saving him could mean losing her life. The two are drawn into a painful struggle between love and the instinct to survive.

titles.title: The Reaper Made Me Reborn
titles.description: After enduring heartbreak and professional collapse, Lin An tries to end his life, only to be sentenced by Death to nine cycles of rebirth. His first incarnation places him as Su Zeqing, the brother of Su Zeming, where he spends his days without restraint until a sudden death cuts him down. Once revived, he confronts Death directly, calling out the cruel joke behind this punishment.

titles.title: Seraphina 'Sera' Vance: Black-Bellied Queen Strikes Back at the Transmigrator
titles.titleEn: Seraphina 'Sera' Vance: Black-Bellied Queen Strikes Back at the Transmigrator
titles.description: Seraphina "Sera" Vance, the general's eldest daughter in the Yan Dynasty, falls victim to a plot orchestrated by her own maid, Xuanxuan Zhou. She spends a decade tempering herself along the border before returning to settle scores with those who wronged her, operating under the alias Cynthia "Cyra" Greene. Through this campaign of vengeance, she steadily rises to become the most powerful woman of her time. Those who wish to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Weakling Wolf, Hidden Alpha
titles.description: For a decade, Lucas Blackwood has kept his extraordinary wolf soul concealed from everyone around him. That changes during the Moon Trial, where he overpowers opponents from the north and earns the rank of Grand Commander. Acting as the Night Shadow Alpha, he later confronts a corrupt elder within the court and turns down the princess, driven by his determination to safeguard the realm. Those wanting to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Grandmaster in Heiress's Guise
titles.description: Maeve Winslow, a supreme master of the Dao, fails her tribulation and is reborn as the true heiress of a wealthy family—a young woman who shares her name but whose life was swapped at birth. Confronted with her adoptive father's murderous plot and the machinations of the fake heiress, she retaliates with thunderous force, steadily stripping away the impostor's facade. Reborn a second time, she vows that anyone who wrongs her will pay a hundredfold.

titles.title: Betrayed by seven fiancés, Married to the king
titles.titleEn: Betrayed by seven fiancés, Married to the king
titles.description: Margret, a duchess, was raised in the same household as seven adopted brothers her father had taken in. Her stepsister, however, schemed until each of the seven came to view Margret with loathing and contempt. One by one, all seven engagements collapsed, leaving her deserted by every fiancé she had. Rather than remain broken, Margret chose a different path and wed Gabriel, a young and striking king. Only afterward did the seven discover how they had been deceived. Overcome by remorse, they dropped to their knees and pleaded with her to forgive them.

titles.title: Christmas Catch [Original]
titles.description: A detective finds herself drawn into an unexpected romance while pursuing a case during the holiday season. Emily Alatalo, known for her work on Workin' Moms, leads the cast alongside Andrew Bushell of Designated Survivor and Franco Lo Presti of Bad Blood. The film is directed by Justin G. Dyck, whose previous credits include A Very Country Christmas. Blending mystery with festive charm, the story follows the detective as professional duty and personal feelings become increasingly intertwined. Those interested in the series can follow it on Dramzio.

titles.title: Trapped In a Lover’s Game With My CEO
titles.titleEn: Trapped In a Lover’s Game With My CEO
titles.description: A safety disagreement costs maintenance worker Ethan his job when hotel CEO Vanessa dismisses him. Yet the two are soon imprisoned together in a lethal escape room designed for couples, engineered by an unseen adversary. To stay alive they must work through a string of intimate, high-stakes trials, and the class divide between them slowly erodes as they depend on one another. The person behind it all proves to be Julian, Vanessa's fiancé, who wants power and their destruction. Facing death, neither will flee alone; together they gather proof of his wrongdoing and reveal the scheme. They ultimately escape, leaving class barriers behind and choosing each other.

titles.title: The Fallen Lord's Three Fierce Brides
titles.titleEn: The Fallen Lord's Three Fierce Brides
titles.description: After losing his memory, he lived for three years beside a street stall, enduring humiliation from the woman he called his girlfriend. Everything changes when three formidable seniors arrive: a governor, a CEO, and a superstar. They help him recover what he has forgotten, and with his memory restored, he takes revenge on the one who betrayed him. Yet the return of this godlike figure to power brings a new dilemma, as the three fierce women each lay claim to his heart, leaving open the question of whether he can ever settle on only one.

titles.title: Betrayed on My Wedding Night, I Summoned a Demon
titles.titleEn: Betrayed on My Wedding Night, I Summoned a Demon
titles.description: Delilah, long ridiculed as a magicless failure, is betrayed by her fiancé and killed by her sister on the eve of her wedding. Death does not hold her, however. As her blood spills, it wakes Samuel, an archdemon who has been sealed away for a thousand years. Their pact is a deadly one: Samuel is bound to deliver her complete revenge, and only afterward may he consume her soul. Yet Delilah's own magic, hidden until now, erupts with unexpected force, leaving open the question of whether the demon will collect his due or end up kneeling before the witch he was meant to destroy.
