titles.description: After three decades without contact, Veronica’s estranged husband suddenly reappears, bringing a new wife and son with him and asking for a divorce. Yet the woman he abandoned is no longer the person he once knew. Her sons have become national heroes, while their wives hold influential roles that shape global affairs. What he expects to be a simple separation turns into something far more complicated than he anticipates. The series follows this confrontation as Veronica faces the man who left her behind, now backed by a family whose standing he clearly failed to consider. Divorce Me If You Dare can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Undercover in the Dead Zone
titles.description: A remote stretch of lawless territory has long been the hunting ground for a gang of drivers who prey on women traveling through. Chu Qing arrives there under the guise of a fresh graduate, but her real identity is that of a young reporter looking into how her sister died. To get at the truth, she embeds herself inside the very vehicles used by the killers.

titles.title: Watch out! I am the Creator of Universe (Season I)
titles.titleEn: Watch out! I am the Creator of Universe (Season I)
titles.description: After being called back from a sleep lasting hundreds of millions of years by her devotees, the Creator God rises once more. Her task is to mend three shattered planets, and with her unmatched divine strength she brings the avaricious rulers to heel without difficulty. During this journey, four exceptional male leads join her, each seeking her favor.

titles.title: Veterans Who Refuse to Kneel (English-dubbed)
titles.description: After their military service ends, Joseph and the other veterans launch a produce venture, hoping to earn a living with integrity. Trouble arrives when a ruthless manager, supported by an influential tycoon, begins targeting the widow and daughter of a comrade who has passed away. Joseph intervenes, but the company is then deliberately damaged. Pushed into a corner and publicly shamed, the veterans still will not submit. A surprising ally brings the corruption to light, and together they strike back, recovering both their self-respect and the future they had worked for.

titles.title: Every Note Leads to You
titles.description: Amelia Hart leads a double life at Westbridge, where she is known simply as ECHO, a globally celebrated musician whose real identity stays hidden. Her feelings grow for Noah, a folk artist, and she steps in to protect his club using a brilliance no one expected from her. As envy and deliberate sabotage close in, Amelia reaches a point where concealing her true self is no longer possible.

titles.title: Emerald Eyed Luna
titles.description: Sa kanyang ika-labingwalong kaarawan, nawala ang lahat sa anak ng Beta. Una, natuklasan niyang magkapareha pala ang kanyang kababatang kasintahan na tagapagmana ng Alpha at ang kanyang matalik na kaibigan. Pagkatapos, winasak ng isang marahas na pagsalakay ang kanilang pack at napatay ang kanyang mga magulang. Nang puntahan niya ang tagapagmana ng Alpha upang magpaalam, nadatnan niya itong nakikipagtalik sa kanyang kaibigang traydor. Iyon na ang huling dagok. Tinalikuran niya ang pack at naging rogue. Ngunit binago ng pagkatapon ang lahat. Sa paglalakbay, nagising sa loob niya ang isang pambihirang kapangyarihan na nagbunyag ng kamangha-manghang maharlikang pinagmulan. Hindi na siya walang magawang lobo; kailangan na niyang wasakin ang isang walang awang sindikato ng human trafficking at i

titles.title: Triplets Fighting to Be My Sons Daddy
titles.titleEn: Triplets Fighting to Be My Sons Daddy
titles.description:
Charlotte’s life changed after a one-night stand left her pregnant six years ago. Her father and stepsister threw her out, and she has since worked as a chef to fund treatment for her son Stefan’s congenital blood disorder, giving up her university degree in the process.

When the wealthy Wills family holds Mr. Wills’s birthday party at the hotel where Charlotte works, all three sons attend: James, a CEO; William, a doctor; and Jackson, a popular star. As Mr. Wills wishes for a grandchild, Stefan tumbles into his arms. The boy’s striking resemblance to the brothers as children leads Mr. Wills to order paternity tests, which show a biological link to all three. Each man becomes convinced the child is his, and Mrs. Wills orders a search for Stefan. Charlotte then joins the household as a nut

titles.title: The Third Letter Is My Goodbye
titles.titleEn: The Third Letter Is My Goodbye
titles.description: Diagnosed with terminal cancer and given only a month to live, Eleanor presents Ethan with divorce papers. She asks him to grant five final wishes so their poisonous marriage can end. Yet Ethan's emotional distance, combined with the manipulative schemes of Sophia, his first love, steadily wears her down. After Eleanor collapses, the truth about how her family was ruined comes to light, forcing Ethan to confront the reality that he has destroyed the one woman who genuinely loved him.

titles.title: My Princess, Return to Me
titles.description: Gloria Cooley gets a second chance at life, waking again on the day she wed Alistair Payne. Her first existence had brought her his loathing and ended with her nation in ruins. Now she takes a different path, marrying Alvin Walsh, the King of Sabulon, and discovers that he comes to love her. Alistair, for his part, only grasps the depth of his own feelings for her once it is far too late. Those curious about how this reborn romance unfolds can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: (TV Series) The Witching Season [Original]
titles.description: This horror and suspense anthology presents original stories of terror, each crafted to evoke the atmosphere of the Halloween season. Across its tales, the series builds an eerie mood rooted in the spirit of that time of year, offering viewers a collection of chilling narratives designed to unsettle and thrill. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Colosseum: Rise of the Dino Chicken
titles.titleEn: Colosseum: Rise of the Dino Chicken
titles.description: A villager manages to hatch a T-Rex chick using blood. To settle his debts, he enters cockfights and wins, but a crime boss becomes determined to claim the creature and resorts to blackmail. Joining forces with the crime boss's daughter, the villager sets out to resist the boss's demands and protect the dinosaur.

titles.title: My Truck, My Rules
titles.description: My Truck, My Rules is a series that invites viewers into its own world, with its story, characters and episodes ready to be discovered. Those who wish to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Flavors of Love
titles.description: A young chef with a warm personality ends a toxic relationship on her own terms, making a clean and stylish break from her ex. Soon afterward, she meets a wealthy young man whose cold demeanor sets him apart from anyone she has known. Their unexpected encounter marks the beginning of a connection that unfolds from these very different starting points.

titles.title: The Princess Who Walked Away
titles.description: Gretta Ely, hurt by Crown Prince Hades Maverick's plan to marry another woman, asks for a diplomatic marriage decree while Qianrin's borders face attack. The emperor hesitates but ultimately names her Princess of Qianrin, and she is set to wed in seven days. The crown prince, meanwhile, has no idea she has made this choice and stays certain that his childhood sweetheart would never walk away from him.

titles.title: The Untouchable Wife of Mr. Fu
titles.titleEn: The Untouchable Wife of Mr. Fu
titles.description: Xu Muqing agrees to marry Si Tengye as a way to help her father’s company settle its debts, yet the wedding day takes an unexpected turn when Si Tengye flees. As time passes, her feelings shift, and she comes to love Fu Ningze, the son of the Fu family. The story follows this emotional turn and the complications created by the broken marriage arrangement.

titles.title: Fleeing After Bearing Dragon King’s Twins
titles.titleEn: Fleeing After Bearing Dragon King’s Twins
titles.description: Mia, an innocent snake spirit, rescues what she believes is an injured little snake. After a single passionate night together, she later gives birth to twin dragon cubs, unaware that their father is Caspian, the Dragon King himself. She conceals herself as a servant within his palace, determined to protect her secret, not knowing that Caspian is already aware of the truth. When danger threatens her children, Mia's dormant dragon abilities emerge, setting her on a path that could lead to becoming his Queen.

titles.title: Runaway Bride, Prince in Pursuit
titles.description: Su Yuyao is the intelligent and attractive daughter of a concubine, mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, so she feigns muteness to survive. She is compelled into marriage with a merciless prince and ends up expecting twins. Determined to escape, she runs away, but he gives chase, and a blood test ultimately traps her.

titles.title: No Mercy for the Cheaters
titles.description: Shi Lan, heiress to Canglan Group, had handed over both her company and her wealth to her husband, Meng Cheng'an. The truth began to surface when she noticed that the designer bag he gave her was a counterfeit, while his mistress, Yun Rou, carried the genuine one. Her suspicions hardened into certainty at the hospital, where she came upon the two of them together with the child they had outside their marriage. Faced with a betrayal that touched every part of her life, Shi Lan strikes back: she brings the affair into the open and takes back everything that had been taken from her.

titles.title: The Mercenary Mom Is Back
titles.description: Eight years after losing the person she loved most, elite mercenary Evelyn Cross leaves the battlefield behind. She settles into a quieter life, raising her young daughter and running a small shop. That peace is shattered when the ruthless Sterling Group targets her family. To protect them, Evelyn returns to fighting—and along the way she begins to uncover a truth that has stayed buried for eight years. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Love in the Dust
titles.description: Cheng Huinan, a daughter-in-law of the affluent Su family, was coerced into exchanging her infant daughter Liuliu for an orphaned boy named Su Mubei. As the years passed, Liuliu earned her living as a bartender, while Su Mubei became the heir to the family's wealth. A chance encounter brought them together, and they fell in love. Cheng, believing her adopted daughter Song Yasi to be her biological child, pushed Su Mubei toward marrying Song. Once Liuliu learned of her real parentage and became pregnant, Song attempted to murder her. Su Mubei then revealed the truth, allowing Cheng to be reunited with Liuliu, her actual daughter.

titles.title: I Am the Real Ultimate Boss
titles.titleEn: I Am the Real Ultimate Boss
titles.description: Retired Major General Sean, secretly the power behind the investment giant PEACE RS, finds himself discarded by his girlfriend Rosa, who leaves him because she believes he has nothing to offer. The synopsis breaks off at that point, so the consequences of her decision and the full arc of the story remain unclear from the available material. What is established is the contrast between Sean's hidden standing as a major financial figure and the dismissive way Rosa treats him. Further developments beyond this setup cannot be described without inventing details. Viewers curious about how the story unfolds can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: I Wanted the Wrong Brother, and He Knew
titles.titleEn: I Wanted the Wrong Brother, and He Knew
titles.description: Iris has long harbored secret feelings for Nate, the admired golden boy. Everything shifts when she unintentionally witnesses him in a forbidden affair. To ensure her silence, Nate—fully aware of her feelings—uses the situation to his advantage. The story follows Iris as she becomes entangled in a complicated dynamic shaped by desire, secrecy, and manipulation. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: After my rejection I reveal my dual identity godfather of light and dark
titles.titleEn: After my rejection I reveal my dual identity godfather of light and dark
titles.description: Before his death, the protagonist's father instructed him to deliver a marriage agreement to the Whitmore family and see it honored. At the engagement celebration, however, he found Elena on Julian's arm, accepting congratulations from the guests. She ripped the agreement apart in front of everyone and set the value of his father's life at eight hundred thousand dollars. Julian then destroyed the obsidian badge the father had left behind and made him crawl out of the hall on his knees. He chose not to argue. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Celebrity Boyfriend Killed Me
titles.description: Claire Evens dreams of an acting career and carries on a hidden romance with producer Mitch Sterling. When she becomes pregnant, his reaction turns violent and he pushes her toward an abortion. Cast out and devastated, she finds support in Alex, a screenwriter still struggling to make his name. A threat to tell the press about the pregnancy makes Mitch soften, and Claire mistakes this for a reconciliation, going out with him even though Alex warns her against it. Mitch then betrays her, attempting to kill both her and the unborn child in horrifying fashion. Alex sees it happen and collapses before help arrives. Two decades on, Alex has become a celebrated screenwriter, while Claire's orphaned daughter Clara has grown into a famous actress. Both are in demand across the industry, and both i

titles.title: Sister, Thanks for Dumping Him!
titles.description: John, known as the legendary Master Dragoni, conceals his fortune and lives as a disabled street vendor. When his sister-in-law Shirley spots him, she proposes marriage—this after her sister Mary has already turned him down. What John doesn't know is that Shirley is actually the formidable Netherlord, keeping her true identity under wraps so as not to wound his pride. The story turns on the moment these two hidden selves come to light.

titles.title: Belated Filial Devotion Is Worthless
titles.description: Lucas and Audrey Hayes, both preoccupied with their own lives, send their father Jonathan 20,000 USD every month and bring in Diane Jenkins to look after him. What they fail to see is that Diane and Derek Vance are working together against the old man, mistreating him, keeping food from him, and scheming to take his property. When a fall leaves Jonathan with amnesia, Diane exploits his confusion to pass herself off as someone he trusts, coming close to seizing his entire fortune. Once the siblings learn what has really been happening, they contact the police and promise to look after their father in person from then on. The story makes the point that sending money is no substitute for family presence, and that genuine devotion to one's parents means showing up. Dramzio is a place where thi

titles.title: Sacrificed to the Sea King
titles.description: Elena agrees to marry a sea monster believed to be cursed, stepping in for her sister so that her ailing father might be saved. What she does not know is that her harsh husband is in truth the Deep Sea King, a being with the power to heal.

titles.title: Wrongly Raised
titles.description: Nina Chase spent years sacrificing everything to bring up two sons, trusting that they would care for her in her later years. On the day the family celebrated the boys' college admissions, her husband Harry Smith reappeared after being presumed dead, accompanied by his mistress Paige Young, and demanded custody of his biological children. Only then did Nina learn that the sons she had devoted eighteen years to raising were in fact the offspring of Harry and Paige. The shock triggered a fatal heart attack, killing her instantly. Granted another chance, she wakes on the day she gave birth, resolved to take revenge in this second life. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Edge of Control
titles.description: Alessandra, a hopeful romantic, takes a job as assistant to Vittorio Lombardo. His brother Dominic, a billionaire playboy, becomes fixated on her when she rejects his advances—something no woman has done before. To keep Dominic at bay, Vittorio pretends to date Alessandra, which only fuels Dominic's jealousy. When a vengeful ex-lover frames her, a heartbroken Alessandra leaves London and raises their child on her own. Dominic is determined to do whatever it takes to win back both her and their family.

titles.title: Love You, Always A Mistake
titles.description: Sold by her boyfriend to fund her blind sister’s treatment, she finds herself drawn into the schemes surrounding a wealthy family’s heir. Just when the situation grows more complicated, a billionaire unexpectedly offers her a marriage contract.

titles.title: Betrayed Heiress
titles.description: Exiled for five years from a post-apocalyptic sanctuary after Celeste, a false heiress, frames her, Elaira Valen comes back marked by her ordeal. She cuts herself off from her family and enters a marriage she did not choose with Kael, a commander of Blackridge. As Kael comes to respect her, she pieces together what really happened, restores her reputation, and shapes a future defined by her own choices. Betrayed Heiress can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: As A Fake Eunuch, Win It All
titles.titleEn: As A Fake Eunuch, Win It All
titles.description: Aaron Clark, a man from the modern world, finds himself transported into the body of a eunuch serving in the Crown Prince's Palace. His path forward lies in assisting the Prince in claiming the throne, and through this effort he gains the affections of the women around him, ultimately rising to become the most prominent figure within the Palace.

titles.title: Never Hire Relatives as Housekeepers
titles.description: Caroline Sterling has built a successful life, but trouble arrives when her mother, Diane Sterling, brings in someone they once knew, Brenda Jenkins, to work as a housekeeper. Brenda moves in with her daughter Jessica Jenkins, and the household quickly falls into disarray. The two wreck the home, destroy treasured possessions, take cash, invite men over, force open the safe, and in the end abduct Abby, demanding five million dollars for her return. Caroline keeps giving them second chances, yet each act of forgiveness is met with an even deeper betrayal. Ultimately, Brenda and Jessica are taken into custody for kidnapping and extortion. Diane comes to regret her decision, and calm returns at last.

titles.title: The Heiress Demands Blood
titles.description: After her father pushed her mother to suicide and immediately brought his mistress into the family mansion, an heiress hides her intentions behind the role of a dutiful daughter while quietly plotting a merciless payback. She joins forces with a brilliant lawyer to bring down her poisonous relatives and take back the empire that was taken from her. Amid the conflict and vengeance, she also faces the question of whether genuine love can still find a place in her life.

titles.title: Reborn: Swallow the World
titles.description: Given a second chance in the apocalypse's second year, he gains a system that turns devoured monsters into strength. Yet the serpent mark on his arm binds him to the hidden truths of the Blood Moon. As he becomes the monstrous thing people dread, he must decide whether he can control this sinister force and rescue the world, or whether it will consume him entirely. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Divine Blood in Dust
titles.description: Hebe, a goddess, comes down to earth to wed the driven Jason, only to endure mistreatment at his hands—cruelty that persists even through her pregnancy and is fueled by the sorceress Medea's magic. When her brothers Ares, Apollo, and Hermes step forward to disclose who she truly is, Hebe takes back her godhood, removes Jason's authority entirely, and ascends to Olympus in victory. Those who wronged her are left to waste away in suffering. This story blends divine vengeance with a powerful rebirth.

titles.title: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight
titles.titleEn: Love Trap with My Dashing Knight
titles.description: Emily White, a wealthy heiress, married Tim Carter for love and used her family's resources to help him become a CEO. After a decade together, Tim betrayed her with his secretary, Laura Green, leaving Emily powerless and trapped as a housewife in a loveless marriage. To secure her place, Laura hired a male escort to seduce Emily and gather evidence of infidelity, hoping to force her out with nothing. But she mistakenly approached Ryan Clarke, the illegitimate son of the powerful Clarke family, assuming he was an escort. Ryan recognized Emily as the woman who had unknowingly saved him years before. Driven by hidden feelings, he took the chance and entered the White household.

titles.title: Reborn Romance & Vampire Kids Home Alone
titles.titleEn: Reborn Romance & Vampire Kids Home Alone
titles.description: Reborn as a mercenary who had once been sacrificed, Anya comes back to her vampire household with her elite fighting abilities intact. She gradually earns the trust of her guarded vampire children and is reunited with Lord Keanu, who has been mourning her loss. When a lethal toxin and attacks by hunters threaten the family, Anya puts herself in danger to secure the antidote. Standing together in battle, they ultimately attain eternal life and a lasting reunion.

titles.title: A Will, a Wedding, and a Big Mistake!
titles.titleEn: A Will, a Wedding, and a Big Mistake!
titles.description: Summer was raised to think her family had nothing, a story her sisters maintained to honor their late father's final request. Everything shifts when she marries a wealthy businessman in order to rescue his struggling company. What she still doesn't realize is that a sizable inheritance is actually hers, and her sisters now have to keep up the pretense of poverty while quietly watching over the money she has no idea exists. The arrangement leaves them guarding both a secret and a fortune as Summer's new marriage unfolds.

titles.title: A Bitter Spring
titles.description: Wat aanvanklik net ’n onverwagte saamgestelde gesin is, bring ’n vurige meisie en ’n saggeaarde seun bymekaar nadat hulle deur hul ouers verwaarloos is. Aanvanklik bots hulle gedurig, maar dié botsings word uiteindelik begrip, en sodoende help hulle mekaar om kinderwonde te verwerk. Net wanneer liefde begin posvat, dryf die noodlot hulle uitmekaar. Die vraag bly of hulle ooit weer na mekaar sal terugvind. Die reeks se verloop kan by Dramzio gevolg word.

titles.title: The Fatal Wife of Gotham's Big Shot
titles.titleEn: The Fatal Wife of Gotham's Big Shot
titles.description: Five years have passed since Viola was pushed from a cliff by the siblings who had taken her in, leaving her for dead while she carried a child. Her survival stayed hidden until her son's chocolate, flavored with mint and rosemary, brought mob boss Luca back to the wife he had lost. Though scarred and unable to speak, Viola endures one last assault. Luca steps in to rescue her, eliminates those who betrayed them, and is finally reunited with both his queen and his true heir.

titles.title: The Mech God Just Wants to Chill
titles.titleEn: The Mech God Just Wants to Chill
titles.description: The Mech God Just Wants to Chill is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold gradually. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Puck Perfect My Sex Education Tutor
titles.titleEn: Puck Perfect My Sex Education Tutor
titles.description: A famous hockey player with a rowdy reputation goes to great lengths to protect his hidden life as a masked adult content creator. When a timid art student needs help with intimacy, he offers to teach her in private. Their arrangement soon becomes more intense than either expected, turning a risky bargain into something far more complicated. The story follows the tension between his public image, his secret career, and the growing connection he never planned on. For viewers who enjoy this kind of romantic drama, the series can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Lion King’s Prisoner
titles.description: Evan, a young white man, is suddenly pulled into a brutal continent inhabited by beastmen, where Kellen, the lion king, takes him captive. Though Evan tries repeatedly to break free, every attempt fails, and over time he is touched by the intense yet gentle care Kellen shows him. Ultimately, Evan gives up the chance to return to his own world, and the two of them defy the boundaries between their kinds to become lifelong companions, jointly governing the lion tribe.

titles.title: My Live Stream Saved an Entire Village
titles.titleEn: My Live Stream Saved an Entire Village
titles.description: My Live Stream Saved an Entire Village is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold over the course of its run. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Second Turning
titles.description: On her eighteenth birthday, the High King calls together the heirs of the four great clans—the Vampires, the Werewolves, the High Serpents, and one more—setting in motion events that will shape the fate of these powerful bloodlines. The gathering of the heirs marks a pivotal moment for the young woman, whose coming of age coincides with the High King's summons. The series follows what unfolds when the heirs of these four great clans are brought together at the High King's command. Viewers can follow Second Turning and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Secret Side of My Rich Husband
titles.titleEn: The Secret Side of My Rich Husband
titles.description: Nancy, kind and resilient, agrees to marry Gene—the wealthy family’s notorious “black sheep”—in place of her stepsister, hoping to fund treatment for her gravely ill mother. The man’s scandalous reputation precedes him, but married life reveals a different truth: Gene proves gentle and attentive rather than the rogue gossip suggested. When Nancy lands a position at the company she has always dreamed of joining, a string of coincidences slowly exposes her pretend husband’s real identity. He is the firm’s elusive billionaire founder, operating behind the scenes and quietly pursuing a plan for revenge.

titles.title: Her Life Rebuilt in Love
titles.description: In 1969, Taozi endures assault at the hands of Luo Han and, under the weight of gossip, raises her younger brother Xiao Bao. Qiangzi stands by her even though his mother disapproves. Moved by his sincerity, Taozi falls in love with him, and she goes on to care for his mother as well. The couple welcome a daughter, Manman. When Qiangzi's father finally accepts them, the family finds its footing and begins to prosper.

titles.title: His Luna Ran Away with Eight Pups
titles.titleEn: His Luna Ran Away with Eight Pups
titles.description: Sera, a she-wolf isolated in her marriage to the distant Alpha Caden, discovers she is carrying eight pups. Soon after, she receives both a sum of money and instructions to end the relationship, prompting her to abandon the harsh pack. In time, Caden, filled with regret, sets out to find her and seek forgiveness. Meanwhile, Sera locates her own influential family and begins building a calm new existence, torn between the wounds of her past and the possibility of reconciliation.

titles.title: The Defense Never Rests
titles.description: Qin Zhengshu has earned the nickname "Grim Reaper of the Law" thanks to an unblemished courtroom record. When Duan Chengzhou, the son of Longcheng's richest tycoon Duan Hairong, faces rape charges, he retains Qin Zhengshu to win an acquittal. After learning that Qin has agreed to take the case, Duan Chengzhou encounters Qin Hao, Qin Zhengshu's son, and his pregnant wife Li Qing at a hot pot restaurant. Acting with arrogance and a sense of entitlement, Duan Chengzhou harasses and humiliates the couple. Qin Zhengshu shows up at the crucial moment and identifies himself, yet Duan Chengzhou dismisses him and keeps up the attack, departing only when the trial is about to begin. In court, as the defense attorney comes forward, the once-smug Duan Chengzhou is stunned—the man he insulted is the ve

titles.title: The Don's Daughter Doesn't Kneel
titles.description: Claire spent her childhood in a boxing gym, and at eighteen she is reclaimed by the wealthy biological family that had lost her. Acceptance never comes, though. The girl they present as their daughter repeatedly casts herself as the wronged one and engineers traps for Claire, who each time manages to reverse the situation. Matters come to a head at a family banquet, where everyone has turned against her and a mysterious man arrives without warning. Only then does the truth surface: the Mafia stands behind Claire.

titles.title: Thanksgiving-Poker
titles.description: At Thanksgiving, millionaire Robert humiliates the family of his poor cousin Jack and wagers his Porsche in a poker game. Jack calls with his old truck, turning the match into a battle over dignity. Jack's family puts their house and store on the line. With help from relatives, Jack scrapes together 600,000 dollars, exposes Robert's bluff, and takes everything.

titles.title: Marry First, Love Later
titles.description: Joyce agrees to marry the reclusive heir of the Lorenz family out of a sense of indebtedness, but the sight of her masked groom sends her running in fear. Silas Lorenz then puts her loyalty to the test through a series of harsh deceptions, while Joyce pursues her own mission as a journalist determined to bring corporate corruption into the open. His efforts to protect her gradually give rise to an attraction neither of them expected, yet long-hidden secrets put their already fragile relationship at risk. The central question becomes whether love can take root in a marriage that was built on a lie.

titles.title: Crawler Knight: Dragon sa Lupa
titles.description: Kael exposes the fabricated history maintained by the Flying Dragon Council and its enslavement of the Earth Dragons. The revelation follows his discovery of the truth behind the council's account of the past, which had concealed its treatment of the Earth Dragons. The synopsis breaks off at the point where Kael, having brought the deception and the enslavement to light, faces the consequences of that act. Crawler Knight: Dragon sa Lupa can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Brothers in Arms
titles.description: Nick Gallo, a hardened veteran, teams up with two comrades in Las Vegas after a fellow soldier is presumed dead. Their mission is to shield the fallen man's wife and daughter from a ruthless local crime syndicate. As Nick grows closer to the family and develops romantic feelings, his bond with them is upended by an unexpected reappearance.

titles.title: Trapped Between Two Monsters
titles.description: Ketki is stuck in a marriage that has long since lost any affection, and her life takes a turn when she reconnects with Vedika, a friend from her childhood. What begins as a reunion gradually becomes something far more intense, as Vedika's feelings for Ketki deepen into an obsessive love. The story follows the tension between Ketki's unhappy married life and the increasingly possessive pull of her old friend, leaving her caught between two difficult situations.

titles.title: Diamonds Beat Moonlight
titles.description: Betrayed and killed by Sophia, the woman he loved, Archer Howard gets a second chance at life as a wealthy businessman. He chooses a marriage of convenience with Ethan Chase, the heir to a competing empire. Though the union starts as a calculated business deal, genuine feelings gradually develop between the two men. Their hard-won happiness is put at risk, however, when Sophia reappears with the power to tear it apart. This story blends revenge, redemption, and an unforeseen romance. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: I Worked While a Thief Watched My Family
titles.titleEn: I Worked While a Thief Watched My Family
titles.description: After his wife passed away, Chen Kai shouldered the responsibility of raising his daughter Duoduo and looking after his paralyzed father, all while holding down a demanding job. He brought in Lin Qiaoyun as a nanny, a woman whose gentle manner concealed a cruel streak: she mistreated the elderly man, who could not speak up for himself, and set her sights on the household's money. Duoduo managed to capture the abuse using her phone watch, and once Chen Kai learned what had been happening, he joined forces with the police to bring down the nanny and the accomplice working with her. With justice done, the family was able to settle back into a peaceful life. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: One Night with My Stepfather
titles.description: Stephanie has endured years of abuse and manipulation at the hands of her stepmother Sara. Everything changes when she learns that Damian, with whom she shared a single impulsive night, is in fact Sara's newly wedded husband. Seeing how much her stepmother has invested in this union, Stephanie sets out to win Damian over, using seduction as a weapon for both liberation and payback. Yet the scheme she launched with a cold heart gradually gives way to genuine feelings. Once Sara catches on to what is happening, her fixation grows increasingly unhinged, pulling all three of them toward a devastating conclusion.

titles.title: Endless Devotion
titles.description: Lorna Glover’s half sister orchestrates a scheme that poisons her feelings for Horace Naylor, transforming her affection into resentment. In the aftermath, Horace is involved in a car incident that leaves him enraged and causes him to lose his memory. Seven years pass before Lorna comes back, and she does not return alone—she brings the twins with her. The story can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Husband's Colleague
titles.description: Sarah, a gentle housewife, becomes the target of Diego, a colleague of her husband, who drugs and assaults her before using blackmail to force her into stealing company secrets. Over time, she endures ongoing abuse at his hands. Without revealing her plan, she begins working with the police to arrange a trap aimed at dismantling the criminal network behind it all. In the end, Sarah breaks free from the trauma she has suffered and rediscovers who she is.

titles.title: (Dubbed)My Light Within the Dark
titles.description: After rescuing an elderly woman, Lila Monroe lost her sight but gained a million-dollar fund for surgery. Before she could use it, her mother took the money and tried to push her into a loveless marriage. Fleeing that arrangement, Lila was saved by the old woman's grandson, Eagon Clark, a strikingly handsome billionaire heir.

titles.title: (TV Series) American Heiress [Original]
titles.description: Elizabeth Wakefield, a wealthy debutante, senses an immediate connection upon meeting Capt. JD Bruce. Any hopes for romance are upended, however, when their plane goes down over Guatemala, forcing the two of them to fight for survival in the aftermath of the crash.

titles.title: The Don's Daughter Is Off-Limit
titles.description: For eighteen years, Arthur kept his criminal history buried, devoting himself to raising his daughter in peace. That quiet life shatters once she becomes the target of bullying and threats, forcing him to expose the man he used to be. The underworld bows, and adversaries from his past are shaken. In the aftermath, he closes accounts that have waited nearly two decades, discovers the son he never knew he had, brings his family back together, and finally gives his wife the wedding she has been denied all these years.

titles.title: The Emperor’s Doomed Obsession
titles.description: Betrayed and killed in her former life by her own sister, Winona Simpson, and her husband, General Eden Richter, Natalie Simpson was born to a noble family and met a grim fate. Given another life, she sets out for vengeance, drawing the King close so she can use him as her instrument. What she failed to foresee is how far his feelings would go beyond her design, leaving her stunned when he decides, whatever the obstacles, to make her his queen.

titles.title: Fake Boss, Real Trouble
titles.description: To satisfy his uncle, Duan Xu, who chairs Shenghua Group, brought Sun Fanghua on board. Once in position, she misused her authority by dismissing employees and installing incompetent family members in their places, actions that brought the company to the brink of being sold off. Duan Xu made it back in the nick of time, drove her out, saw both her and his competitor put behind bars, and took the business public. Fake Boss, Real Trouble can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Kicked Out, I Took the Company
titles.titleEn: Kicked Out, I Took the Company
titles.description: At the Lowe family's Coming-of-Age Ceremony, Chase Lowe is publicly revealed to be a fake heir. Jason Lowe seizes the credit for himself, and Clara Sullivan ends her relationship with Chase. Cast aside by those around him, Chase activates the Market Oracle and departs with the company's most valuable personnel. He then sets out to build a fresh empire with the aim of bringing down everyone who wronged him. His plan is complicated, however, when the Market Oracle begins to demand its own price.

titles.title: The World Shall Tremble Before Hades
titles.titleEn: The World Shall Tremble Before Hades
titles.description: Hades rules over Hades's Hall, the organization that once held dominion across the globe. Countless people fell under its control. Those who followed him did so in their millions, bound to the power he commanded. The world that had once bowed to his authority now faces the question of what comes next under his shadow. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Public Divorce: The Tycoon's Mad Pursuit
titles.titleEn: Public Divorce: The Tycoon's Mad Pursuit
titles.description: Evelyn Moretti, heir to a mafia empire, was secretly married to Damian Cole, an underground syndicate kingpin. For seven years she concealed her identity, quietly using her family’s wealth to pull him out of repeated crises and build his empire. Then, on a family trip, Damian brought his first love, took Evelyn’s seat, and abandoned her by the roadside. Heartbroken, she shed the housewife role and began freezing investments, revoking privileges, and pulling the hidden strings that had kept the Cole family afloat. Damian dismissed her as powerless until his empire collapsed without her support. Piece by piece, he understood that his wealth and status had always been hers. Evelyn filed for divorce and returned to lead the Moretti Consortium, taking back what was never his rather than destroy

titles.title: The CEO's Secret Baby Mama
titles.description: Eight years have passed since Su Yao and Li Yanci first crossed paths, a meeting that left her raising twins alone. One of the children, a son, was taken and brought up within the Li household, while Su Yao kept their daughter, Su Qingyan, by her side. When their paths cross again years later, Su Qingyan becomes the target of a scheme orchestrated by people pretending to be someone they are not. The deception eventually falls apart, the real circumstances come to light, and Li Yanci asks Su Yao to marry him, bringing the scattered family back together.

titles.title: Medal for a New Recruit
titles.description: Alexander Bennett, a fresh recruit, springs into action when a bus plunges into a river, rescuing passengers and triggering the Super Soldier System, which grants him a "Dragon in Water" ability. His remarkable performance in live-fire exercises allows him to bring down an enemy reconnaissance aircraft through "ballistic calibration," guaranteeing his fellow soldiers a spot in the unit. For his courage, he is awarded a First-Class Merit, capturing the true essence of military valor.

titles.title: Once a Pawn, Now a Queen(Dubbed)
titles.titleEn: Once a Pawn, Now a Queen(Dubbed)
titles.description: Li Zhao grew up in an orphanage before her father, Li Zhengye, brought her into his home—not out of care, but because he wanted her late mother's shares and intended to use her as a tool against Rong Ce, the man she loved. In her previous life, she understood the truth only when it was too late, and Rong Ce lost everything. Given another chance, she resolves to shield Rong Ce from harm and reclaim what rightfully belongs to her.

titles.title: Time with You: Our Turbulent Affair
titles.titleEn: Time with You: Our Turbulent Affair
titles.description: Lin Yang is persuaded by her closest friend to take an overseas trip, and on the flight home she crosses paths with the famous actor Huo Tingshen. Her awkward behavior creates a string of misunderstandings and complications for him, leaving their relationship tense. Back in Haicheng, Lin Yang learns that her villa has been sold, and the new owner is Huo Tingshen himself. Eager to reclaim the property, she fabricates a story about being Lu Yanming's ex-girlfriend, which persuades Huo Tingshen to let her stay. In exchange, she agrees to help him express his feelings to Song Jianing. Yet when the confession takes place, Song Jianing mocks Lin Yang. Angered by the turn of events, Huo Tingshen proposes a contract marriage with Lin Yang, pledging to give the villa back to her afterward. Their tu

titles.title: Borrowed Sperm
titles.description: Sophia is determined to hold on to her position within the Anderson family. Her husband, Brandon, is dying, and the inheritance she hoped to secure is slipping away from her. Faced with the prospect of losing everything, she takes drastic measures to protect her place in the family. The story follows her efforts as her husband's condition worsens and her grip on the future she planned grows more uncertain.

titles.title: Doted Love: First Priority
titles.description: In public, Mr. Fu comes across as refined and impeccably proper, but behind closed doors he is known as Fu San Ye—cunning and calculating. His gentle, harmless appearance conceals a sly and shadowy nature. Over time, he develops a domineering yet fiercely loyal character, devoted to his wife with boundless affection and indulgence. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: My Alpha, Please Forget Me
titles.description: Reborn on the very day her nightmare started, Layla is determined not to become the mate of her cruel ex, Eric. To ensure her own survival, she instead selects Kane, Eric's powerful Alpha father. What she does not anticipate is that Eric also carries memories of their previous life. With betrayal, revenge and forbidden love all colliding, Layla must safeguard the family she has found and take back control of her own destiny.

titles.title: My Mischievous Blessings in Disguise
titles.description: Rachel Couls finds herself pregnant without warning, and Bernard Souls responds by taking her back to his home. As they spend time together, affection slowly develops between them. Their growing bond is threatened by Sadie Cheshire, a celebrity who wants Bernard for herself and sets out to hurt Rachel. Bernard stands by Rachel as she copes with the fallout from online gossip and difficulties within her family, while also confronting Sadie's plots. At the same time, the Souls family observes that Rachel bears a striking resemblance to the late wife of Jack Lane. In a twist, the Lane family mistakes Sadie for Jack's missing daughter because of their similar looks. With Bernard's help, Rachel works through the Lane family's internal disputes, recovers her true identity, and sees those who wro

titles.title: Gigolo Mistaken for Plumber
titles.description: A simple mix-up over a phone number sets the whole story in motion. Someone asks a friend for a plumber's contact, but the number passed along does not belong to a plumber at all. The husband ends up far from pleased when the truth comes out. The series builds its comedy around this mistaken identity and the awkward consequences that follow from one wrong contact. The details of how the confusion unfolds can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Weakest Ship, Ocean Domination(Dubbed)
titles.description: In a seafaring age, Jiang Yuan faces mockery after awakening an F-class vessel regarded as the weakest of all. What others fail to realize is that this boat is in fact an invisible one. The story follows his path as he turns that hidden advantage into a means of rising above those who dismissed him. Dramzio is a place where the series can be followed.

titles.title: My Fake Marriage With the CEO
titles.titleEn: My Fake Marriage With the CEO
titles.description: Burdened by heavy debts, Eliana juggles several jobs until a chance late-night encounter leads her to Shattock, a CEO. Their one memorable night together results in a covert marriage agreement, and they start sharing a home. While affection develops between them, Selena, who is fixated on Shattock, plots against Eliana. Eliana's concealed background as the Qu family's missing daughter eventually comes to light, and she endures numerous hardships, gives birth to triplets, and at last discovers genuine love and a family.

titles.title: Gold Digger's True Love
titles.description: For å hevne søsteren sin gir Juliet seg ut for å være arvingen til Hayes-familien. Planen er å forføre Victor, men i stedet vekker hun interessen hos hans halvbror, Jasper. Det fører til en kjærlighet som ikke er tillatt. Serien kan følges på Dramzio.

titles.title: I hear the alpha cub’s cry for help
titles.titleEn: I hear the alpha cub’s cry for help
titles.description: Nora, a nurse given a second life among wolves, can hear the unspoken calls of every pup. Though she is an Omega without a wolf of her own, she rescues the dying brother of King Kael and earns a place in his guarded heart. She uncovers poison schemes, brings five clans together, and reveals an uncle who is poisoning his own heir. When she is taken captive, the pups she once saved come to her rescue, and the icy king kneels to claim her as his mate. Audiences can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Heir’s Wrath
titles.description: After serving ten years behind bars for a crime his father committed, Desmond Kensington finally returns home. His purpose is simple: to rescue his mother from the hardship she has endured. Yet the homecoming brings no relief. Instead of peace, he finds himself subjected to unrelenting torment that threatens everything he hoped to rebuild. The series follows his struggle against those who continue to make his life unbearable, even after he has already paid a decade-long price for someone else's actions. Dramzio lets viewers follow this story of family sacrifice and the cruelty that greets a man seeking only to protect the person he loves.

titles.title: This Love Was Not Programmed
titles.description: Genius engineer Laura Taylor takes in a defective robot and saves it from its fate. What begins as unwavering devotion gradually transforms into suspicious fixation, and the two are drawn into a love that is not permitted. As questions of destiny and human fragility surround them, Laura has no idea that the robot holds a profound secret about love, one that remains locked away from her. The story traces how a bond of loyalty can shift into obsession and how much Laura does not yet understand about the machine she rescued. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Dragon's Ascent: Path of the Elite Assassin
titles.titleEn: Dragon's Ascent: Path of the Elite Assassin
titles.description: A camping trip turns dangerous when a gang seizes a tour group as hostages. Jake "Dragon" Riley refuses to stand by while the bullies hold the captives, so he intervenes to rescue them. His master then reveals a crucial lead: answers about his father's whereabouts lie within the highest assassin organization. Driven by that knowledge, Jake commits himself to the demanding path of becoming a high-level assassin. The series follows that journey and can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Dragon King She Dumped
titles.description: For three years, he endured being ridiculed as a worthless live-in husband, while his wife's family gave credit to the wrong person for her rescue. When she insists on a divorce so she can pursue the "Dragon King," the truth about who really saved her begins to surface.

titles.title: Blood of the Phoenix Maiden
titles.description: Hai Sangsang, a psychologist from a lineage of Fengming Saints, can detect lies through the sound of phoenix cries. During the Tang Dynasty, the Long clan wronged the Fengming clan, and the emperor punished the Longs with a deadly poison. When Long Wenyu learns that Hai's blood can counteract the poison, he joins forces with her to create medicines.

titles.title: The Day My Mom Stood Up
titles.titleEn: The Day My Mom Stood Up
titles.description: At his graduation ceremony, Leon brings his paralyzed mother onto the stage, an act that draws mockery and harsh insults online. What the public does not realize is that the man they dismiss as a loser is in fact a medical genius, the creator of Starlight AI, a technology able to repair nerve damage. Confronted with ridicule and challenged by others, he stuns the crowd by enabling his mother to stand once more, silencing doubters and revealing his real value. The series and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Let my blood absolve your sin
titles.titleEn: Let my blood absolve your sin
titles.description: Renata goes undercover within the mob, driven by a desire to avenge her family. In the course of her mission, she confesses her sins to a priest, not realizing that he is both the godfather and a member of her own bloodline, a man who has been searching for her across centuries. The source material ends at this point, leaving the tale of Ta... unresolved. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Daddy, How Much for a Hug?
titles.titleEn: Daddy, How Much for a Hug?
titles.description: Daddy, How Much for a Hug? is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold gradually. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: Eighties Mountain Life
titles.description: After being sent three decades into the past, Ignacio discovered his stepfather stirring up trouble and made up his mind to keep his family safe. He left with his mother and little sister, settling into an aging house on the outskirts of the village. Bit by bit, through determination and sheer effort, he turned their fortunes around and lifted them toward a more comfortable existence.

titles.title: Loving the Man History Hated
titles.description: A college student named Bai Qiushui is transported back to the early nineteenth century, where she arrives in the body of a ten-year-old. There she takes Lin Runsheng under her protection and looks after Bai Yu, a beggar. Over time, her feelings for Bai Yu deepen, but her world is upended when she discovers that he is in fact Shen Yujun, a warlord with a notorious reputation. The revelation forces her to weigh her love for him against her sense of duty.

titles.title: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King
titles.titleEn: Bound by Honor: Kidnapped by the Mafia King
titles.description: Harper is handed over by her father to a virgin auction, a transaction he uses to settle the gambling debts he owes. Just as her future appears fixed, events take an unexpected turn. The story follows what becomes of her after this point. Viewers can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Yes, Mr. Knight
titles.description: Mason Knight is a billionaire whose striking appearance turns heads wherever he goes. Jamie has always insisted she would never become one of those women who fall for their boss. That resolve is tested, however, when she finds herself the object of Mason's attention, something she has never experienced with anyone like him.

titles.title: The Heir's Daily Confession
titles.description: After discovering her fiancé's infidelity, Faith is involved in a car accident and taken in by Grandma Zimmer, who trains her to become Vice CEO of Zimmer Group. Sam, the family's pampered heir, is immediately drawn to her, and their arranged marriage sets off a mix of turmoil, humor, and an unforeseen romance.

titles.title: The Mafia Wife's Revenge
titles.description: Isabella saw Salvatore as her rescuer. He ended her abusive father's life, constructed a mafia empire on her behalf, and vowed that their union would end only in death, never divorce. Everything shifted when she found 1,800 photographs of another woman. After the mistress took everything Isabella had fought and suffered to safeguard, she retaliated not with tears but with violence. Yet as his treachery comes to light, a far more brutal reality emerges: the child she mourned, the family they had envisioned, and the marriage she was willing to die for had all been shattered by the very man she cherished above all others.

titles.title: The Banished Alpha Dragon Rider
titles.description: Arthur, an Alpha Dragon Knight, is unjustly exiled through the actions of the haughty Princess Serafina. After a thief makes off with his dagger and assumes his identity, Princess Isabella brings Arthur into her service. The deception collapses when the horde attacks and the impostor's formation fails, laying bare the truth. Serafina is left to rue everything she has done.

titles.title: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother
titles.titleEn: A Hamptons Summer Affair with My BFF's Brother
titles.description: Olive Parry strikes a deal with her best friend Sam: she will pose as his girlfriend, and he will cover her costs so she can rescue her younger brother from a cruel foster mother. There is one rule attached—she must not develop feelings for Sam's elder sibling. The arrangement runs smoothly until Olive realizes that the man she has quietly longed for since a one-night stand is none other than Sam's forbidden older brother. Dramzio is a place where viewers can follow this series.

titles.title: They Thought I’d Go Broke
titles.description: At harvest, they attempt to corner Mason Chandler by tripling the buyback price and tacking on “grass fees” for free-range chickens. Rather than negotiate, he tears up every contract then and there. The village assumes ruin is inevitable, not knowing that his sprawling automated operation in Neighboring County is already dispatching shipments. What they fail to see is that his decisive move has long since been set in motion. Those following the series can watch it on Dramzio.

titles.title: In the Dark, A Mother's Light
titles.titleEn: In the Dark, A Mother's Light
titles.description: When Zhang Meng was five years old and blind, her life took a devastating turn: her father, Zhang Lei, sold her to human traffickers, while her mother, Wang Shufen, wounded him in a fit of rage and then disappeared. Twelve years on, Wang Shufen crosses paths with Zhang Meng again without knowing it at first. The young woman now goes by Li Meng, having endured mistreatment from her adoptive sister Li Fei and humiliation at the hands of Chen Haotian. A birthmark reveals the truth, and Wang Shufen understands that Li Meng is the daughter she lost. Li Fei, unwilling to accept the reunion, resolves to murder Li Meng, and Wang Shufen gives her own life to protect her child. Li Fei's plans collapse one after another until she is taken into custody. Wang Shufen dies at peace, hearing her daughter

titles.title: Three Years as a Simp to Activate the System
titles.titleEn: Three Years as a Simp to Activate the System
titles.description: A man finds himself inhabiting the body of Leo Smith, a general's son in the Empire of Flame, with only three days left before his whole family faces execution. Just as despair takes hold, the system shifts his mission toward Layla Sanchez, the fiancée he once had, and he learns her feelings for him are already at their peak. Armed with modern weaponry drawn from the system's store, Leo ultimately takes the capital, brings down the emperor, and crowns himself ruler. Those interested can follow the series on Dramzio.

titles.title: Frozen Fortune: The 360K Revenge Toast
titles.description: She spent a decade growing their fortune, yet her husband's family dismissed her as nothing but a burden. So she filed for divorce. The very next day, they threw a lavish celebration costing 360,000 dollars, and he reached for her card to cover it. What they didn't know was how carefully she had mapped out her departure. The party meant to crown their triumph instead collapsed into a public humiliation. When a wife finally refuses to play along, the question becomes who truly stands to lose everything.

titles.title: He Fixes Cars, Then Fixes His Legacy
titles.titleEn: He Fixes Cars, Then Fixes His Legacy
titles.description: Adrian, once celebrated as the Racing God with three titles to his name, sees his world collapse when his own brother betrays him. The loss of his father then breaks his spirit entirely, leaving him working as a mechanic at a racing club. Gloria urges him on, and he throws himself into keeping the club afloat through one crisis after another. Side by side, the two push past every barrier in their path. In the end, Adrian rises back to the top, taking victory at the Bashilik Grand Prix. Those who want to follow this story can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Dumped? My X-Ray Vision Made Me Rich
titles.titleEn: Dumped? My X-Ray Vision Made Me Rich
titles.description: After being betrayed and left with nothing, a dock worker living in poverty bonds with an alien artificial intelligence, gaining Absolute X-Ray Vision. This power lets him spot hidden value at blind auctions and win big, then outmaneuver rivals on Wall Street. Using what amounts to a godlike advantage, he takes on billionaires and rises to global dominance.

titles.title: The Trillionaire Bodyguard
titles.description: She is adored across the nation, while he exists as the silent figure always near her. The public sees only a bodyguard, yet behind that role lies a name so powerful that nobody ventures to say it aloud. He goes into the arrangement convinced he is the one doing the hunting. Only later does it dawn on him that he has stepped directly into her trap.

titles.title: Heiress Ki Wapsi(डब्ड)
titles.description: A CEO's wife travels with her daughter to visit her mother. During the visit, a young woman mocks them, but the protagonist refuses to stay silent and responds. The story follows this confrontation and its aftermath.

titles.title: One Song, One Comeback: “Boundless Seas and Skies”
titles.titleEn: One Song, One Comeback: “Boundless Seas and Skies”
titles.description: Masked singer Ye Feng, at the height of his career, steps away from the entertainment world to be with his true love, An Ya, and takes on the alias Ye Qiu so he can support her as she builds her own singing career. Over the years An Ya becomes a star while the couple stays close, but her agent Xue Li pushes Ye Qiu to divorce her, arguing it would help her career, and the manipulation eventually breaks the marriage apart. Ye Feng comes to see An Ya as someone consumed by ambition and power, and to reclaim his dignity he abandons the Ye Qiu identity and returns to the top of the charts with the song "Sea of Clouds and Sky." Once An Ya learns the truth, she is filled with deep regret.

titles.title: Rise of the Dune Savior
titles.description: Betrayed by the Empire, Savior Lenn escapes death by transferring his soul into a clone living in the slums. While concealing his formidable strength, he watches over his wife, whose scars serve as a constant reminder of what was taken from them, and quietly lays the groundwork for revenge. His hidden power and his secret plans set the stage for a reckoning with those who wronged him. Viewers can follow this series on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Scent That Made Him Mine
titles.titleEn: The Scent That Made Him Mine
titles.description: He believed she had betrayed him, while she was convinced he had died. Everything changes when he catches the scent of her perfume, and the memories of their past come rushing back. The misunderstanding and presumed loss that kept them apart begin to unravel through that single, powerful fragrance.

titles.title: [Dubbed]If Leaving Me Was Your Wish
titles.description: Two princesses faced a duty to marry for alliance. Aurora was the one sent away, while Madeline wed Sean, only to receive his hatred in return. Even when Sean gave his life shielding Madeline, his final wish was to be with Aurora in the next life. Fate now offers them another chance. This time, Madeline takes the step of marrying into the Northlands herself.

titles.title: She Asked Him to Die
titles.description: Caspian, posing as a cleaner at a martial arts school facing hard times, looks on as the merciless Zhao Qingcheng pushes Yuna into a wager that will end in death within seven days. When the school's elderly janitor reveals a hidden power, an unexpected fighter steps forward, only to be defeated by Zhao's most formidable asset, the War God. Those who want to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Echo of Day and Night
titles.description: Echo of Day and Night is a drama presented under this title. Further details about its story, characters, and setting are not included here. Viewers interested in the series can follow it on Dramzio.

titles.title: The West's Gun Queen
titles.description: Rebecca works as a stable girl while secretly carrying the reputation of the West's most feared gunslinger. The cowboy she helped lift out of poverty turns on her, but her marriage to Sheriff Jack sets off a chain of revelations when a silver necklace identifies her as the Wilson family's long-missing heiress. With her name and authority restored, she takes down those who betrayed her, uncovers schemes within the family, withstands attempts on her life, and finally makes her identity known to all. Standing firm against an assault on the manor, she secures her place as a Western legend.

titles.title: Three Days Before the Wedding, My Fiancé Gave My Wedding Dress to His "Girl Bro"
titles.titleEn: Three Days Before the Wedding, My Fiancé Gave My Wedding Dress to His "Girl Bro"
titles.description: Just three days ahead of her wedding, entrepreneur Scarlett made a shocking discovery: Liam, her fiancé, had handed over her custom-made wedding gown—valued at half a million US dollars—to his close friend Riley without asking. Riley needed it for a last-minute red carpet appearance, but instead of returning it intact, she cut the dress into pieces. The betrayal leaves Scarlett facing a ruined gown and a fractured relationship right before her big day. For viewers who enjoy such dramatic turns, Dramzio is a place where this series can be followed.

titles.title: Deaf Trash? I'm the Music God!
titles.titleEn: Deaf Trash? I'm the Music God!
titles.description: Leon, a gifted composer, sacrificed his hearing to rescue his girlfriend Yuna, yet he continued composing in secret so she could climb to stardom. After overhearing her ridicule his disability, he walked away without a word. He now reappears under the title of Music God, leaving everyone stunned. Yuna, meanwhile, attempts to draw near him, never realizing that the man she once looked down on stands directly in front of her.

titles.title: Fighting For Her
titles.description: A former boxing champion returns to the underground circuit after taking a bullet meant for her coach. Her world shatters when her girlfriend is shot in her place, and something in her gives way. Cutting ties with everyone around her, she enters the cage to confront the king of the underground, a man convinced she is already broken. What he fails to see is that she has become something else entirely, a phantom he cannot read. The story follows her descent into a ruthless fight world where loss and vengeance blur together. Fighting For Her and its episodes can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Moonlight Academy: The Silent Alpha
titles.description: Saint Lunar Moonlight Academy operates on a merciless hierarchy built around blood purity. Ava, a student with little money, conceals the fact that she is an Omega and cannot shift, spending her days in constant fear of exposure. Ethan, a servant who suffers regular bullying, bears his hardships in silence. Dramzio is where the series can be followed.

titles.title: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
titles.titleEn: Resisting Mr. Lloyd: An Age Gap Romance
titles.description: Clarisse is under pressure from her family to leave college and get married, but her situation shifts after she comes to the aid of an elderly woman who has been scammed. That woman's grandson is Austin, the head of Lloyd Group. Once he learns about Clarisse's money troubles, he proposes a deal: he will provide financial help if she agrees to a sham marriage that would satisfy his grandmother's wish. She accepts, and the two enter into an arrangement neither expected, all while Austin hides who he really is from her.

titles.title: If Love Had Stayed
titles.description: Helen Gray saw Benjamin Green as the one bright spot in her life, until the truth came out: he had only drawn close to her to make his ex, Janet Gray, jealous. Wounded by the deception, Helen turns her back on that cruel game and instead weds Bobby Hall, an heir who lies in a coma. Yet the past will not remain quiet, as love, treachery, and hidden truths keep surfacing, leaving her tale unfinished. Those who wish to follow the series can do so on Dramzio.

titles.title: Accommodations [Original]
titles.description: A married woman raising children in downtown Manhattan decides she can no longer keep putting everyone else's needs ahead of her own. Determined to leave his contract wife with a perfect future, he stages a breakup and transfers all his assets to her. The little girl herself asks Vivienne to stay. To everyone around her, ending a happy marriage over something so minor seems inexplicable, and Vivienne offers no justification. In her flustered panic, she lets slip the words "No, I didn't use protection," which only deepens his suspicion. He is left angry and jealous, and he refuses to accept the truth she tries to explain. A mortifying mishap has turned into a major misunderstanding between the two of them, and neither is prepared for where it leads.

Crystal, however, had prepared for this moment and stood ready to pursue justice and reverse their roles.

titles.description: After dying under unexplained circumstances, a onetime celebrated detective named Shattock gets a second chance at life and joins the force again, this time at the bottom as a rookie. A mix-up on a blind date introduces him to Officer Melissa, and the pretend romance they arrange draws him into a savage killing at a warehouse. Relying on the instincts he carried over from his previous existence, he solves cases others deem unsolvable and climbs the ranks quickly. What began as a convenient arrangement deepens into genuine feeling, and along the way he identifies Blackbone, the criminal network responsible for his death. He ultimately dismantles the syndicate, gaining justice and love together. Dramzio is where the series can be followed.

titles.title: Stealing the Sun
titles.description: Sloane endured a childhood marked by her mother's poisonous quiet and a stepfather who preyed on her, leaving her trapped in relentless gloom. Rescue came through Oliver, her stepbrother, who pulled her from that abyss and shielded her with a devotion that was itself delicate. Convinced she was destroying him, she ran away, thinking distance would release him from her weight. What she failed to see as she left was that Oliver never regarded her as a burden at all; she was the very pulse that kept him alive.

titles.title: Her Canvas, Her Revenge
titles.description: Emma is the eldest daughter of the Hayes family, but her life is upended when Audrey, her adopted sister, frames her. Her brothers believe Audrey without question and have Emma committed to a psychiatric hospital, where Audrey bribes the director to mistreat her, and Emma develops schizophrenia as a result. Once she is out, Emma sets about taking apart the schemes Audrey built against her. She adopts the name Anna and leaves her family behind to follow her ambition of becoming a successful artist.

titles.title: Hands Off My Girl's Dreams!
titles.description: A prodigy from a remote mountain village enters an elite university only to face brutal bullying that shatters her future. Just when all seems lost, a powerful man steps in with an unthinkable pledge: full access to his influence and resources to help her reclaim what was taken. But can borrowed power truly rebuild a broken life?

titles.title: When I Meet Another Alpha
titles.description: A decade ago, she pleaded with him not to go. His response was that she would eventually come back to him on her knees. She never gave him that satisfaction. In the years since, she has risen to command every pack across the South. Meanwhile, the Alpha who dismissed her for ten years now finds himself facing the woman he once took for granted.

titles.title: (Dubbed)She Slept, They Waited a Lifetime
titles.description: The beloved youngest daughter is framed by a wicked actress and loses her identity as the real heiress. Shunned and mistreated, she quietly protects her family. She joins her brother’s sleep project and enters a capsule. Only after she sleeps do they realize the truth. Regretful, her brothers wait 30 years—until their hair turns gray—to see her again.

titles.title: Billionaire From Midnight Hot Dogs
titles.description: Framed by the very protégés he had mentored, veteran investigative journalist Ethan lost his job at the newspaper. He then found himself tethered to the Nightlight System, which restricted him to operating a hot dog stand solely between midnight and 4 a.m. Through genuine dedication, he built Midnight Hot Dogs into a late-night institution. His former subordinates, now running the upscale Gilded Night Feast, repeatedly plagiarized his work, smeared him, and sabotaged his business. Eventually, Ethan used solid evidence to clear his name and stood firm against capital pressure. His rivals fell apart under their own falsehoods and accumulating debts. Ethan continues to appear punctually at his stand, open just four hours each night, content in the life he has chosen.

titles.title: Yellowstone: King of Montana
titles.description: Henry Conrad is the man behind the Yellowstone Ranch and the figure known as the King of Montana, yet he has spent years concealing who he really is by working as a school janitor. After a decade away, he is ready to return to his throne. Before he can reveal his true identity, however, his son is bullied, beaten and humiliated. Henry resolves to shield his son, see that the bullies answer for what they did, and correct the wrongs of the valley as a true King would.

titles.title: I Hired the Real Zeus
titles.description: Five years after losing his family, Roman comes back under the identity of Zeus, the Temple's unseen Lord. Elira, a defiant heiress, takes him for a mere performer and hires him to pose as Zeus, hoping this ruse will free her from a marriage she never wanted. Roman goes along with the deception, until twelve Temple Guardians bow down before him and expose the truth: the man she believed to be a counterfeit deity is in fact the genuine Zeus. For those who want to follow this series, Dramzio is one place where it can be watched.

titles.title: One Bride, Two Surprise Kids
titles.description: One Bride, Two Surprise Kids is a series whose story, characters and episodes unfold gradually. Viewers can follow the series and its episodes on Dramzio.

titles.title: The Young Master's Forbidden Butler
titles.description: Driven by a burning desire to avenge his parents' deaths, Simon takes a position as butler in the wealthy household where his grandfather had once worked. In this role, he deftly turns the master against his wife, draws the young heir Allen into a seductive entanglement, and steadily removes each adversary standing in his way. When his vengeance is nearly complete, a stunning revelation surfaces: Simon is in fact the master's biological son and the legitimate heir to the family fortune. What he had not counted on was genuinely falling in love with Allen. Bound together by love and hate, the two are ultimately separated by an endless cycle of revenge, trapped in a fate they cannot break free from. The Young Master's Forbidden Butler can be followed on Dramzio.

titles.title: Dragonfire and the Sacred Sword
titles.description: Princess Aelia Aelin, long disregarded by those around her, pulls the Sacred Sword from its resting place. This act binds her to Silvermoon, a young dragon, through a Lifebound Covenant. Together they set out to liberate the dragons held in bondage and to bring down Mordes, the tyrant responsible for their suffering. In the end, Aelia takes the throne as Queen of Aelin. Dramzio is a place where this series can be followed.

titles.title: He Killed Our Baby and Lost Me Forever
titles.titleEn: He Killed Our Baby and Lost Me Forever
titles.description: Nora Bennett, a brilliant architect, has spent five years married to Adrian Sterling, a tech CEO, under the impression that he merely isn't ready to become a father. That illusion shatters when a recalled baptism invitation reveals Adrian already has a son with influencer Sienna Blake. Nora also discovers she is six weeks pregnant. During her birthday celebration, Adrian pushes her into broken glass to keep his secret son hidden, and she loses the baby. She files for divorce, but Sienna abducts her and throws her off a cliff before she can leave. Though everyone assumes Nora is dead, six months later Adrian spots a woman he recognizes walking onto the stage at an international architecture awards ceremony.

titles.title: Vampire CEO's Moonblood Wife
titles.description: Ella Thorne, heir to the Thorne Group, faces a crushing betrayal on what should have been her wedding day. Just as she reaches her lowest point, Cull enters her life. Dramzio offers viewers the chance to follow this series and its episodes.

titles.title: She Kissed Him With My Lipstick On
titles.titleEn: She Kissed Him With My Lipstick On
titles.description: Zara appears to have it all: a billionaire boyfriend named Dylan, a best friend in Megan, and a fashion empire she built herself. That picture shatters on her birthday when she walks in on the two of them kissing in her own bedroom. The betrayal looks deliberate rather than impulsive—Megan is wearing Zara's dress, her perfume, her lipstick, part of what seems to be a calculated plan to replace her. Into this wreckage steps Kade, a dangerous stranger who knows far more than he should, leaving Zara to work out what he actually wants.

titles.title: Contracting SSS Mech Girls
titles.description: When the Insectoid Race launches its invasion, every person gains an awakening: women become Mecha Girls, while men develop Mecha Handler abilities. Noah also undergoes his own awakening.

titles.title: Boss, Your Wife Is Super Cool!
titles.titleEn: Boss, Your Wife Is Super Cool!
titles.description: Aurora, the second Miss Shi, lost her life on her wedding day after her sister falsely accused her of unchastity. In a different world, a warrior also named Aurora met her end through betrayal. The Ocean Heart pendant becomes the bridge between them, allowing the warrior's soul to awaken within Aurora's body. Restored to life, she dedicates herself to exacting revenge, setting in motion a campaign of vengeance that spans across time. Those who wish to follow this series can do so on Dramzio.
